name: Customer_6016
comments: I've been here twice now, and the food is always great and the service is decent. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the food takes a while to come out, even when it's not super busy. I've gotten the fish tacos (they are HUGE), burgers, fries (also huge portions), and goat cheese and pistachio guacamole. Like I said, the food is always very good, but if you're coming on a weekend, be prepared for a very long wait. It has a super hip atmosphere and you'll find a lot of twenty-somethings there.

name: Customer_6386
comments: The atmosphere is very clean, modern, and slightly upscale. They offer a brunch and a large selection of drinks. They are very packed for brunch though. Their brunch runs pretty late. I got there around 2pm and they said brunch was ending soon. Their brunch menu items cost around $10 each. Their normal dinner menu gets a little pricier, but you don't have to spend a lot of money here.

name: Customer_5230
comments: Decided to try this place after our Airbnb host recommended it. Total miss! Way too overpriced for what we got. We ordered guacamole because they were out of cauliflower. The guacamole was too plain, lacking salt and spice. The size was ridiculously small and disproportional to the amount of chips you get with it. We also had chicken skewers, that were described as "sesame, garlic, ginger...". It literally tasted like chicken with some super sweet teriyaki sauce. The rice with it was totally plain too. We had kale salad with ahi tuna. Also was lacking taste, and the size of kale and tuna was disproportional. Not worth the money at all.

name: Customer_3685
comments:
I don't get it. 4 and 5-start reviews abound, and the weekend brunch line is absurd, but I'd have to describe my experience at Tavern as "just okay."

I went here on a Sunday morning ambigudate a month ago. We managed to get bar seating after waiting about 10 minutes, which seemed pretty good compared to the lengthy wait for a real table. The place was bustling, but we didn't have to wait too long to get in our drink orders. That said, while I love deals--and 2-for-1 mimosas and the like qualify--I wasn't bowled over. It tasted like a cheap cava and was heavy on the orange juice.

I ordered a burger while my dining companion decided to go with the traditional brunch. My burger was decent but not mouthwateringly amazing, which makes it a far cry from many of the reviews claiming this to be the "best burger in Nashville." Similarly, despite the attempts to make the brunch fare a bit fancier, I wasn't bowled over by any of the flavors.

While the prices aren't crazy expensive, they aren't cheap either. Overall I'd describe Tavern as "fine." I'd have no qualms about returning, but the foodie within me doesn't get the hype. 

Nashville, just because something is dressed up to look fancy and act fancy doesn't mean it's *actually* fancy.

name: Customer_2989
comments: We came here because of all the great yelp reviews, I can't believe this is 4-stars.. Good beer selection, good atmosphere, and decent service.  The food, however, was bla.. We really wanted to try the fried chicken skins, they came out very hard and very stuck together.  The sauce had good flavor but the skins came in a clump that we could hardly break apart. Our food came out about 4 minutes I into our attempt to chisel the skins apart. Kaya toast was weird and really lacked anything to bring the dish together.  After scraping off the sauce it was basically Texas toast and an egg.  The 2 sets of tacos we ordered were both overcooked and VERY dry. Come here for drinks, skip the food!

name: Customer_5559
comments: I at least have to give this restaurant two stars due to the decent food. But while on a dinner meeting and after spending $100 on entrées and appetizers, I had to flag down the assistant cook, (the guy in bright red baggy pants watching TV), to see if I could get more avocado for my tuna entrée.  He made it very apparent and direct that he could not help me with that situation and I would have to flag down my  waitress so she could bill me for the four dollar avocado.

name: Customer_9934
comments:
So happy we found this cool little spot in the heart of West End during a one-night stay in Nashville. To be concise, here's a rundown of pros/cons:

Pros:
- My boyfriend and I went here around 7 PM on a Tuesday night. It was decently busy, but not overly crowded. We were seated right away. Like.
- The kale salad was life-changing. I waffled for a long time on what to order, and I was NOT disappointed. I couldn't stop eating it! Best salad I've ever had in a restaurant. Get it topped with salmon too. mmm!
- The bf got the fried chicken skins and the beef short rib tacos. He said the tacos were small and not much to them, but overall good flavor and tasty.
- Wine list is great! I got some bubbly and it was reasonably priced.

Cons:
- Service was a bit lacking in my opinion - I get that this is the trendy area, but the vibe seemed a bit pretentious and not very welcoming. [NOTE: If you're from/have spent a considerable amount of time in Chicago, this is a very River North-esque bar. End of story.]
- Beer menu needs some SERIOUS attention. I was shocked there wasn't more quality stuff on that list, hence my choice for wine. Bud and High Life? Come on, man.

Notes:
- A little loud and dark in general - not the best for conversation.
- A lot of TVs all around, so might be fun for gameday, but I can't say for sure.

name: Customer_6757
comments: Went for brunch on Saturday and was extremely pleased to discover 2-for-1 drinks! Our group tried pretty much one of each drink and were extremely happy with each, particularly the Wicked Bloody Mary. The atmosphere was great-- trendy but very relaxed. I had the Singapore Stir fry, which was so flavorful and a wonderful change from the usual breakfast fare. As I dont eat meat or cheese, breakfast can be a little boring and standard, but this was a delicious option that strayed from the ordinary. Others had two different omelet varieties and the eggs benedict uno, all of which made the table very happy and satisfied. Would definitely recommend for brunch.. My only wish would be that they had more vegetarian options. The bloody marys by far made up for that though!

name: Customer_7593
comments: I could eat the blue cheese fondue on almost anything. I bet liver would taste good in that fondue. Fortunately I had some really good buffalo cauliflower to go along with and I hasten to say it was a top 5 all time appetizer ever.People rave about the fries and they were good but not the best I have had. The Tavern burger on the other-hand may be the best burger I have ever had. Made from ground rib-eye and filet makes me believe God made the burger lol The lobster sliders were really good but 22 bucks not that good. The mushroom soup had to be made by Angels it was amazing. Its a little pricey but you definitely get what you pay for, for the most part. As a whole it may be the best lunch ever. I give very few 5 stars on average and this was well earned. The place is nice and cozy and the staff were great. It was a religious experience involving food.

name: Customer_4262
comments: What a fabulous new place to dine! The staff is extremely friendly, the food is creative and they have the BEST burger in town! Not only is the food great, but their use of social media is as well. I sent a tweet out about how great their burger is and received a nice card and gift certificate for my next dining experience. Nicely done, guys!

name: Customer_7103
comments:
The food here is outstanding. I generally get the Tavern Burger, which is legitimately one of the best in town. The desserts are great as well; for instance, they let you make s'mores at your table. Furthermore, the beer selection is fairly robust, usually with several local breweries on tap. 

The downside here is the service. First, it's usually quite slow, even when the dining room is not too busy. It's taken over an hour to get my lunch before, and not during peak hours. However, the pace does not bother me as much as some of the staff's snooty demeanor. The hostesses in particular are generally a bit condescending, which is off-putting. The wait staff themselves are usually a bit better; you can tell they work for tips, whereas the hostesses quite clearly do not. All in all a good spot for lunch or supper, though.

name: Customer_6582
comments:
What I liked:
1. White Trash Hash- With a name like that, what's there not to like?  While I'm sure I could re-create this for about $2 (smashed fried hashbrowns smothered in cheese), it was well worth the extra cost to enjoy at brunch.  YUM!
2. Brunch Menu- There were too many delicious options to choose.  I went with a salad, but everything (especially the burger and french toast) looked and smelled fantastic.
3. Bloody Marys- They served my favorite, Zig-Zag mix and you get 2 for the price they charge.

What I didn't like:
1. This place gets VERY crowded on the weekend during the brunch rush.  We were quoted at hour+ wait shortly after they opened and ended up just snagging a seat at the bar.
2. Service- The bartender was understaffed and a bit slow to respond to requests.  They also forgot about part of our order and had to be reminded.

Overall Verdict: Make a reservation or show-up early and prepare to wait.  Get the white trash hash and enjoy delicious brunch!

name: Customer_7973
comments: Everything is wonderful at The Tavern!!!!. The service is outstanding. The seafood choices are plentiful. The skillet bread is  so so good! I love the portion size..just right. The Chocolate chip cookie skillet dessert is super super delicious! We have gone on a Sunday night a few times a it's semi- quiet and it's a delightful Sunday meal.

name: Customer_2218
comments: The Tavern have the best burgers and the service was great. Atmosphere was nice and family friendly. I will definitely be back if I visit Nashville again.

name: Customer_9868
comments: Service was ok, but the food was excellent. Nothing against our sweet server, but she was alone on a 20 person table - really? I completely blame that one on management! Buffalo cauliflower was awesome and the chicken skewers were so so good! Everyone had a wonderful time! Ambiance was so fun!

name: Customer_1065
comments: Came in for lunch while in Nashville in business. The waitress sold me on their Bloody Mary, so I ordered that and the lettuce wraps. The bloody was ridiculously watered down. It tasted watered down and looked like the glass was about 85% water/ice. When I commented on the look and taste, the waitress proceeded to tell me that if it looked watered down, there was probably extra vodka in it, which I couldn't taste because it was "infused" which cuts down on the vodka taste. What a load of BS. It was one of the most disappointing bloodies I've had. I should have sent it back, but she was adamant that I was wrong. Lettuce wraps had a nice spicy kick, which I liked, but it failed to redeem the dry, canned-tasting chicken. Very. Under-impressed.

name: Customer_2701
comments: This place has a great vibe and lots of energy! Being an out towner, we were recommended the tavern by our hotel staff at Hutton hotel. The tavern is in walking distance and has a very friendly wait staff. Their food was great and the wine made our night before walking downtown to enjoy the live music on the strip. And we are back for another round the next day! :)

name: Customer_8040
comments: Looks, from the street, like it would be good, but it was just okay. Our waitress pretty much forgot about us the entire time we were there. Not sure what that was all about. We tried practicing mindfulness to make the time pass while we were waiting for her to come back out and take our order. My nachos were disappointing--basically felt like a slice of cheese was melted over chips with globs of black beans. The kale salad was a warm mound of wilted kale mixed with parm cheese. My son liked his burger, so that was good.

name: Customer_1023
comments: Solid brunch spot! Got there at peak time and the wait was less than what they thought. In the interim we sat on the padded benches outside. The place was packed but they seemed to turn it over and get people in and out quick. The bazooka guacamole was very good but the star of the show was the chorizo gravy on the biscuits. The spicy chicken sausage is aptly named as it packs a punch. I love hot food so it was perfect for me. My fiancé said it was at the limit of her spice scale so normal people may find it too much. She has the pretzel pancakes which are pancakes with pretzels on top covered in syrup. It wasn't what we expected but was good. Something about biting into a pretzel and it not having any crunch doesn't feel right but that may just be us. The girl with us had the pain Perdu and couldn't finish it but said it was good. We will for sure make our way back here as we each tried to decide between 3 different dishes so I look forward to having tried them all.

name: Customer_2965
comments: I usually love this place, but stopped in tonight to place a take out order, and the hostess shewed me off to the absolutely PACKED bar, to try to hail a bartender, on my own, to place an order. This is seriously how you are doing business? We walked out... Ridiculous...

name: Customer_8264
comments: Great place to watch sports and try the good food selection. Brunch is great on the weekend and have something special always. Just get ready for the line so my ght as well get a spot on the bar or wait forever.

name: Customer_4977
comments: Good fun place, appetizers are fun, and different! Place is always full of nice people, good energy. Great for large or small groups. Fun times!

name: Customer_3598
comments: Waited 1.5 hours in the bar next door to eat at this overhyped egg factory. Not worth it what so ever. Go to Hattie bs or princes and skip it.

name: Customer_2069
comments: Had a very pleasant dining expereince at Tavern tonight. We arrived at 5 pm and it was pretty dead. It's a big place with a nice outdoor patio and a side patio that can be indoor/outdoor depending on the weather. The vibe seems pretty cool and laid back. Rock music and low lighting get a thumbs up in my book. I decided to try a sangria while I browsed over the menu. It did not disappoint. Very fresh and tasty. I decided on The Tavern burger with sweet potato fries. The burger was deliciuos! It's served on a "meltaway" bun which basically is just a really soft and yummy bun. The sweet potato fries were good as well. Not soggy at all which seems to happen a lot with sweet potato fries. The boyfriend really enjoyed his meal as well but I'll let him tell you about that in his own review. :) Because the dinner was so good, I decided to order a dessert, too. I opted for the cinnamon bread pudding with vanilla gelato on top. It was also delish! It was the perfect amount of sweetness and comfort to end my meal. Service was quick and friendly, food was good, and the atmosphere was relaxing. We will defintely be back.

name: Customer_5515
comments: I have never been so insulted and talked down to in my life. Michelle, I think that's her name it's on my receipt but she never introduced herself, was the rudest person I have ever given my money to in my life. When we sat down she was talking about personal issues with the barback loud enough for us to hear and I thought that was odd in and off itself. When she gave us our menus she said a few times "these menus are good for the next 30 seconds."  Sorry but either give us brunch or give us dinner menus and explain that the kitchen is in the midst of a shift change, don't make us feel pressured because you dropped menus that have an extremely short time limit. Instead of eating we decided to just get drinks. She let us know that the brunch menu libations were, her words, 2 for 1. We ordered a mimosa off the list and hung out. When we got get drinks they set two wooden tokens down but didn't reference the at all, so we didn't know what they were for.  Eventually ordered some food off the dinner menu to go. She was very non existent the whole time we were sitting at the bar, not attentive at all. When we asked for the bill I saw that both our drinks were on there. I asked about them and let her know about the 2 for 1 statement she said. She then proceeded to tell me it was buy one, get one and that's what the tokens are for. I told her that "buy one get one" and "2 for 1" are different and if we knew it was BOGO we would have ordered another drink (if she would have even paid attention to us).  After a little back and forth she said she would take care of it and that "they weren't trying to screw us."  She talked to us like we were the worst people on earth because she doesn't know how to explain her own restaurants policies. I work in an industry that has me visiting 10-15 bars/restaurants/hotels a day and I have never had a worse hospitality experience in my life. Tavern Management - this employee is losing you revenue left and right.  Not only is she not taking care of customers and grabbing reorders, she is turning people away for good. This treatment was so horrible and off putting that I am going to go out of my way to recommended against going to Tavern due to the disrespect we felt. Hopefully your floor managers recognize how bad she is and theyo do something about it because she is taking money out of your pocket every shift she works.

name: Customer_3187
comments: Great food, great atmosphere.  I had the mac and cheese, which was a special and it wasn't on the menu, but it was AMAZING.  I also highly recommend the egg rolls.  Not your normal egg rolls.

name: Customer_9350
comments: We came here based off a recommendation from our hotel.  The food was fine but nothing impressive.  It was basic bar food.  The music was way too loud.  Impossible to have a conversation and we were there at 5:30 on a Saturday.  If you're in from out of town, try another place for dinner.

name: Customer_9682
comments: I like Tavern a lot. The food is very good. I went here for lunch with a friend from work. I loved the vibe, the dim-ish lighting, and the music, and would definitely like to come back at night time. The fish was very good, fresh, and the batter was light and perfect. I loved the sauces that came with my meal. I shouldn't have gotten the sweet potato fries. Didn't care for them. Next time I'll get regular ones. Also loved the fact that they have all of those hot sauces at the table. Any place with an abundance of hot sauces is awesome to me. I would like to go back and try other food. The only negative thing was it took far too long to eat here on our lunch break. The service was very slow, but maybe the server was new. We had an hour break and we are late coming back. However, will go back again, definitely.

name: Customer_7876
comments: This place has a great vibe and lots of energy! Being an out towner, we were recommended the tavern by our hotel staff at Hutton hotel. The tavern is in walking distance and has a very friendly wait staff. Their food was great and the wine made our night before walking downtown to enjoy the live music on the strip. And we are back for another round the next day! :)

name: Customer_7960
comments:
I love Tavern. They have exceptional cocktails, killer food, and an ambiance that can't be beat! I foresee many a dollar of mine being spent here....

It gets VERY busy, and on Sunday when I stopped in with a friend it was no exception. Luckily, there were two seats at the bar, so we snagged them and sat down. After drooling over another customer's plate of mussels, I decided I had to get them. White wine with bacon, leeks, and a piece of "dippy" bread? Um score. My friend had the chicken chimichanga, and it was cheesy but still full of flavor and amazing! 

But let's talk cocktails, something that really gets my engine running and Tavern hit the mark.

The red sangria was pre-mixed and topped off with some bubbly. It was a good sangria, but not over the top good. However, my balsamic martini with stoli, strawberry puree, and a splash of balsamic syrup?? Creative and delicious! I will be ordering the drink again and again! The bellini sparkle was not in a tiny champagne flute, it was in a tumbler and was refreshing. My friend couldn't stop ordering the cucumber, apple, and elderflower cocktail. Be warned, it is very strong! 

I was worried our service would be poor because they only had 2 bartenders for the entire bar, but it wasn't. They were attentive and sure to check up on us and get our orders in. They also have some incredible outdoor seating areas, and enjoying a cocktail on a nice day here is heaven. 

Thanks for the good times Tavern, I can't wait to see you again!

name: Customer_6847
comments: Awesome atmosphere and great food. You have to go here if your in Nashville!  Make sure you try the Buffalo Cauliflower, Beef short rib tacos and the Horseshoe. We tried the fried chicken skins.....not a fan.

name: Customer_4358
comments: Chose the Tavern based on an article I read on the internet that many chefs in the area head to here for brunch and now I know why. My my my.... Perfect brunch on a gorgeous day.... Mimosas on the patio, pretzel pancakes that were scrumptious. Tehren was spot on with the service we received. Highly recomend this place to anyone in Nashville or traveling through. Will certainly be back!

name: Customer_8229
comments: Burger was great. Cooked perfectly, but nothing special. Packed for brunch specials. Seem to have awesome election of cocktails and awesome bartenders. Was there for food, don't really drink. Def would go back. Atmosphere was great too.

name: Customer_2531
comments: I've never been to an M Street restraunt before, for those of you who are not familiar with M Street they are the zany people who bring us resturant concepts such as Kayne Prime (on my bucket list,) Virago and Moto (also on my bucket list.) So on Wednesday night we visited Tavern, which is self-described as "a pub for chefs." Valet parking at this location is a must and they were prompt and efficient. There was plenty of porch seating available as well as being used - Nashvillians do love their porches. The inside of the restaurant had a rustic feel and it seemed as though the bar top was inhabited by business class regulars. That having been said I could easily picture the bar at 12 midnight being inhabited by waitrons and people with checkered pants, it would be a great place to have some concept drinks and small plates after a busy restaurant shift. I ordered the Korean short rib tacos - I definitely got the red pepper forward taste as well as the cool of the cucumber and cilantro. I would order it again. Delivery time was about 13 minutes, a good ticket time. It's very evident that these people are "on their game," I will be returning to try other items on their menu. And one day I will visit Kayne Prime, I might splurge for that on my father's birthday. Visit Tavern, have fun!

comments: Great food!! Everything we ordered was good. Wait was long for Saturday brunch. My fave were the red velvet waffle and Singapore eggs.

name: Customer_6847
comments: Great food!  The menu is full of interesting, and unique items.  I tried the smoked salmon eggs benedict, and it was phenomenal.  The interior is very well decorated, and the servers were helpful and prompt.  Though it was a little on the expensive side, it was well worth the cost for such a great experience.

name: Customer_8550
comments: Best brunch in Nashville. Amazing lunch. During brunch drinks are 2 for 1 and they are delicous. The wicked Bloody Mary and blood orange mimosa are my favorites. Red velvet waffle, white trash hash, cheddar biscuits and gravy, eggs benedicts, and Singapore stir fry are all so excellant it makes it hard to decide what to order each time. The burger and fries are amazing for lunch, as are the Philly cheesesteak egg rolls, and fried chicken skins with honey Sriracha sauce as apps. They also have a midtown quickie on the menu that changes every day. Tavern never gets old and never disappoints.

name: Customer_4345
comments:
Great staff, service and food!

I ordered the kale salad (OMGosh - good!), short ribs tacos and the fried cauliflower- a MUST - even if you don't finish it all.

name: Customer_3606
comments: After drinking a few glasses of 1920 (the best cocktail in Nashville if you ask me), I am the happiest girl around! I also love the menu, it's fun without being weird. I can't stop eating the Philly cheesesteak eggrolls, brown bag special, all the different fries, and the kale salad.

name: Customer_7887
comments: This place is awesome! We stumbled upon it after checking into our hotel...we wanted to walk around after being in the car for 9 hours and we were starving. We got a table outside, it was loud, but what do you expect on a Friday night in early summer? The food was great....I got the Nuevo Israeli bread salad and my husband got the turkey blt (with sweet potato chips (YUMMMM)--both fantastic. They have an extensive drink/beer list and the staff is knowledgeable about the beer they serve and didn't steer my husband wrong. Would recommend trying this place out if you haven't already.

name: Customer_8120
comments:
Tavern was in walking distance from our hotel, and we had read it was a good place to watch a game, so we were there! I really liked the feel of this place. It was really modern and even the waitstaff complements the look with their matching grey v-necks. We were famished after a long day and got down on so many dishes! 

-grilled artichokes. promised with a "comeback sauce" which we got to help my friend push ahead past her hangover, it didn't really do that.
-lamb tacos and pork tacos. the lamb tacos were great but nothing could compare to the pork tacos. I have never been more sad to see the end of a taco.
-salad of little gems. hello? little gems describing anything? I'm in! It was a great, little refreshment from my all-meat diet, with cranberries and fresh mozzerella.
-chicken and waffle. The fried chicken was great, but the cheddar and jalepeno waffle was almost too overpowering with the sweey syrup.
-loco moco. too much meat but the rice and egg were just what my friend needed to get back on the drinking horse so props for that!

The drink list was also amazing here, great whiskey cocktails and they make a mean martini as well! I also liked the mix of people here. It was the perfect Friday night crowd. Prices were pretty reasonable, unless, of course, you are posted up watching Michigan beat Kansas in overtime, then the bill might be a bit higher to taste victory ;)

name: Customer_9730
comments: Where should I start... Oh yeah, I love this place! Went for the first time this weekend and all the things I've heard about this place are true. Great food, amazing outdoor patios and a great variety of drinks. We started out with the Lobster Hushpuppies and Bazooka Guacamole. The presentation was modern and they most definitely delivered on taste, the only issue I had, was I wanted to order more appetizers! After some self restraint we order our entrees; I took the servers recommendation and had the burger and everybody else had the BLT. Looking back I wish I would have tried something new, don't get me wrong it was good but there are some amazing sounding dishes on the menu. Next time I guess. All in all if you are looking for a trendy spot to have a bite and a few drinks, I definitely recommend this place! Oh yeah, I almost forgot use the hot sauce!

name: Customer_8292
comments:
Tavern is probably one of the better brunch places in Nashville IF (and only if) you go with friends. This is not the place to go for a brunch date or to go with any person that you actually want to have a conversation with.

Both times that my wife and I have gone (once by ourselves, and the other time with some friends) the music has been extremely loud - like to the point where we have been yelling just to hear each other. Not kidding. Look, I like my music loud... and their playlist was actually on point (late 90's/early 2000's hits)... but going out to eat is a social experience. Part of sharing a meal is enjoying the company of the people you're with. Don't blast music in my face and force me to lean in just to hear what the person next to me is saying. C'mon. 

On to the food! It's GREAT. I highly recommend the Benedict Uno - a short rib benedict topped with tabasco-infused hollandaise. Wow. So much amazing flavor in every bite. I savored it right down to the end. I also recommend the maple fondue if you're with a group. It's a fun dish to share and has assorted fruits and some french toast and sausage... all to be dipped in a delicious warm maple syrup mixture. Can't go wrong. Also, don't sleep on the 2-for-1 libations. The blood orange mimosa and the red sangria are my favorites (although the last time I went, I just doubled up on the sangria... easily my favorite).

This place deserves respect for the quality of food they put out and their decent pricing (average about $12-$15 per entree). The only things that keep this from being a 4-star review are the noise level, the lack of parking (bring cash because you will need to use the valet), and the fact that you will undoubtedly have a wait. When we went with our friends, we got their 10 minutes after they opened and were told there was a 20-30 minute wait. We ended up actually waiting almost an hour. Not really a complaint, since you have to factor in a wait at popular places... but still. Just a warning - you will have a wait.

Give this place a shot if you like good food for brunch, just go in knowing that there are some pitfalls with this place.

name: Customer_6556
comments:
Not my kind of place but I think if it was it would be fantastic! 
Loud music, sports on big TV s, huge bar, inside or outside seating. Friendly attentive staff, food artsy. Served lightning fast. Very clean and beautifully decorated. Enjoyed my Burger very much. Micheal loved his Junk Salad... Great place for those who like what I described.

name: Customer_3921
comments: my favorite brunch spot on nashville! the drinks are amazing and they have a wide range of items on the menu. my favorite brunch items are probably the benedicts and white trash hash. my favorite items served all day are the sweet potato fries and tuscan kale salad! the only complaint I would have is that they usually have a long wait, especially for brunch so come early and be prepared to wait! it's certainly worth it. other than that, the atmosphere and food are some of the best in nashville!

name: Customer_6273
comments: We totally blew off all Nashville brunch recommendations just because the menu at Tavern looked so good. Risky move, bucking the suggestions of former residents and frequent visitors, but I'm happy to report it paid off handsomely. I looove the set-up of the restaurant. There's a covered/open air area, a bar area with some booths and high-top tables, then a cozy area "upstairs" overlooking the action so to speak. It basically has a seating location for whatever your mood. Very cool. The brunch menu was almost impossible to choose from. Our eyes went directly to the red velvet waffle with cream cheese drizzle. We're not big sweets for breakfast folks but we do love our desserts. But the inevitable was sure to occur, eat brunch and be too full - rule of thumb - order your sweets at the same time as your meal if you're determined to try something. So we did.... I opted for the benedict uno which was fantastic. Tender braised short ribs on an english muffin with perfectly cooked poached eggs and a Tabasco hollandaise. Soooo incredibly good and the hollandaise was the perfect combination of buttery and spicy. Excellent. I will say, if you don't love hollandaise you would be put off - my plate was literally swimming in sauce (arm floaties and all...) I gobbled it up but it turned my wife off from trying it (note to self, don't bath in hollandaise.) My wife opted for the The Nooner which is an omelet with bacon, fried oysters and a spicy sour cream, served with "white trash hash" (basically a heavily hashbrown casserole.) So back to the red velvet wafftle....we didn't finish it....I know...I know....we tried and we did a pretty good job, but we just couldn't. It was super good although almost not quite done in the middle, but tasty nonetheless. Good service, good food, great atmosphere (would love to watch a game here and snack my way through the day.) Can't wait to return!

name: Customer_1447
comments: Delicious food in a fun setting.  Great helpful and friendly service.  Two levels of seating near the bar.  We had awesome buffalo cauliflower, egg rolls with philly cheese steak and amazing kale salad.  highly recommend the Tavern.

name: Customer_2328
comments: The kale salad is excellent. The rest of the food was ok. Far too expensive I'd you ask me for the sports bar type atmosphere, mediocre food and almost bad cocktail. The waitress come by and asked us if we liked the food about 14 times in our hour dinner and took our plates away the second we finished it which I thought was way too aggressive.

name: Customer_7087
comments:
Food was average and did take a bit to come out Service was good.
Great local beer selection.  Had Chimichanga and burger and fries both were average but not outstanding. Great space/ bar.

name: Customer_2255
comments: Just walked into the Tavern Nashville and was served by the brightest smile in the world. Thank you Heather , amazing server.

name: Customer_9309
comments: Food was great here! I've been here before just for drinks and wanted to come back because I had an amazing pineapple charred mule cocktail. We came back and ate this time. The only thing preventing me from giving Tavern five stars was that the service was slower than it should be and it wasn't an insanely busy night. Our waitress was not the most attentive.

name: Customer_5024
comments: I've only been to Tavern once and it was for Sunday brunch. My friend and I wanted somewhere close to our church (Midtown 12South) and she suggested Tavern because she said the brunch food was good. I wasn't too sure about the meal I ended up ordering...you know how you have those days where you teeter back and forth between what to order and then end up just blurting out a choice and don't really know if you're ok with what you said? Well...this one of those times, so it might have skewed my verdict. The food was good, but it wasn't my favorite. The 2for1 brunch drinks helped a bit. I might would go back and try some lunch food and see how that is. But for now, it's just A-ok in my book.

name: Customer_9684
comments:
I give this three stars because of the service.

We went there on a Wednesday night and it just so happened to be 2-4-1 on select bottles, spirits, and specialty drinks. When she finally came back by we ordered our entrees. I had the Basket of Crispy Little Fish while my boyfriend had the Farmer Rays Grilled Vegetable Muffuletta. The fish were very tender and it came with some very yummy sweet potato fries. The muffuletta came with some house chips that were great. 
  We were almost done with our meal and thought about ordering another beer, but our waitress was too busy to stop by the table. While I was in the bathroom my boyfriend stopped her to ask for some waters and to hear about the dessert menu. She told him she could tell us the dessert specials as they did not have a dessert menu, and would wait until I came back. About 20 minutes after I came back she finally stopped by. Water glasses empty and asked if we still wanted to know about the dessert. We told her we were still interested and chose the DIY smores. The smores were a fun little dessert. They bring you marshmallows, graham crackers, strawberries, hershey's chocolate and reese's peanut butter cups. Its also very messy. name: Customer_7054
comments: The atmosphere is very nice. I always am leery of "hipster" spots but this place is legit. Super friendly and not pretentious staff. Female bartender made one of the best Bulleit neat Old Fashioned's I've had out. Other mixed drinks were also prepared well (well balanced without being boozy). I ordered Korean beef tacos. They were not bad but not one of my favorites either. They were still good. The table over got nachos that looked delicous. I also think if a place has a clean bathroom, their kitchen is usually clean too. This place is spotless. I also was impressed to see the bartenders cleaning bottles and the bar in their down time. Overall, I would definitely visit again when I am in town. I'd actually rate this place a 4.5 stars if I could.

name: Customer_8537
comments: This is an awesome place to come for a boozy brunch and a good time! It is a very lively atmosphere with a lot of TVs so also a great place to watch sports while grabbing a few drinks and some delish food. I would highly recomand the chorizo biscuits and gravy - there is a cheesy goodness to this dish that will cure any hangover and leave you with a happy tummy. They also have a great mix of cocktails and beer that makes for great day drinking!

name: Customer_1769
comments: I usually love this place, but stopped in tonight to place a take out order, and the hostess shewed me off to the absolutely PACKED bar, to try to hail a bartender, on my own, to place an order. This is seriously how you are doing business? We walked out... Ridiculous...

name: Customer_5079
comments:
Food was average and did take a bit to come out Service was good.
Great local beer selection.  Had Chimichanga and burger and fries both were average but not outstanding. Great space/ bar.

name: Customer_3318
comments: Went here for a Saturday morning brunch and it wasn't that bad! Cons: the wait is crazy long (over an hour), the lighting is a bit dark, the music and atmosphere is crazy loud so prepare to scream your conversations, the drinks (specifically the mimosa) wasn't that strong and the food was good but average. Pros: It's a nice trendy spot with fun music that you'll want to sing along to (especially after drinks). The staff was very attentive and friendly! And the prices aren't that bad (for downtown). All in all it was a nice experience, but don't think I'll be in a hurry to go back.

name: Customer_6038
comments: We stopped here for lunch/dinner and wasn't disappointed.   We was seated and served drinks promptly. Had a difficult time deciding what to order cause everything looked delicious.  I ordered the brown bag meal.  Which is a thick cut grilled bologna and over-easy egg sandwich with homemade potato hips, with truffle oil.

name: Customer_5126
comments:
The 45 minute wait was well worth it, especially since you have drinks while you wait! The staff here at Tavern were super attentive and really helpful in giving suggestions on what to order. We got the maple fondue and it was incredible, you got to try a little bit of everything. The red velvet waffles were out of this world, the blueberry cornmeal waffles were a slam dunk, the Frosted Flakes crusted French toast was life changing. The sausages were great, the chicken was very spicy but overall great and the fruit was super fresh and sweet. The eggs benedict were really good but very large. All in all I would come back again in a heartbeat!!

WE LOVE TAVERN BRUNCH

name: Customer_7387
comments:
Stopped by while on a business trip after reading other reviews. I had the salmon and it was really good. Only knock I have is that the portion size was really small (I thought, anyway). Also had the kale salad which was really good. I was trying to be good, but definitely had order envy when I saw the burger and fries. 

Give it a try! I would definitely go back!

name: Customer_5814
comments: We waited an hour and a half to eat at this restaurant for a party of 3. We sat at the bar where they offered 2 for 1 drinks. 2 drinks for the price of 1!! What could be better? Towards the end of our hour and a half wait we began to get to hungry so we ordered some fries. They were very yummy!! Since eating the fries, by the time we got our table and ordered a meal, I wasn't very hungry. So I didn't  eat much of the omelette I ordered. So I don't have much feedback for that.

name: Customer_5584
comments: Nice, upscale bar with your no so typical bar food. The grilled cheese was pretty tasty with truffle oil fries. The lettuce wraps were fantastic! The decor was a neat industrial look and was very tastefully done. We'll be back!

name: Customer_5746
comments: My vegan friend had the kale salad and loved it. I had one of the taco options -- pretty good too. Wine list was short but reasonably priced. Service was friendly. Better than many of the other options near campus.

name: Customer_4183
comments: This joint was recommended by a waiter who served us supper, said the red velvet waffles were to die for....ummm no suicidal thoughts here...totaly not worth the 1hr wait and is extremely loud....forget about conversation. We had the breakfast fondu....where is the fondu pot and skewers? And the $3 coffee was yucky! Service wasn't the best either. I'm getting the feeling that the waiters around here think because they probally won't ever see you again they don't have to give good customer service. You basically have to ask to be waited on.#RoadtripUSA

name: Customer_8450
comments: This place is amazing! In every way! Great location, great ambiance & atmosphere. The people there, especially our bartender Sarah, were super nice and helpful. She was great! But.... the food. Oh wow the food. Best burger I've ever had ever! If they ask you if you want to upgrade your fries to he seasoned ones (for a mere 50¢) say YES YES YES. Those things are sprinkled with crack, I swear. So good. And the garlic aioli is no joke. The beer list is awesome. Lots of local options. And 2-4-1's on Wednesdays of things like Jack Daniels, other liquors, wine, and some mixed drinks (libations). great place! We'll be back every time we're in Nashville.

name: Customer_2497
comments: Great place to grab drinks with friends! The waitresses were super friendly. Go on Thursday nights for the best drink specials. One con is that the food isn't that great, but this place is fabulous for drinks.

name: Customer_4698
comments: The environment is great!  It's a multi-level facility that puts a modern spin on the old "tavern" concept.  I was impressed with the food I ordered as well as the cocktails.  The waitstaff was quite personable and made the experience even more enjoyable.  My only critique was the homemade ice cream I tried for dessert.  It simply wasn't good. Of course, nobody's perfect.  I would definitely go back to Tavern again.  :-)

name: Customer_7671
comments: Meet by a great hostess at the door, Jenna. Her smile was amazing! Drinks at the bar were rather good.  They actually have a loco moco! BOOM!

name: Customer_1481
comments: My friend and I were visiting Nashville and found this place through a quick google search. We were staying downtown, so it was a quick and cheap cab ride away (5 minutes/$7 ride). We went on a Saturday night, so there was about an hour wait. We decided to grab a drink at the bar (no wait there) and stood around chatting/playing a charades game on our phone...which helped pass the time! The drinks were avg. $10/piece. Not cheap, but normal for this kind of restaurant. Once we were seated, we knew we wanted to try their french fries (we had previously scoped out the menu) and quickly ordered the sweet potato ones. She ordered the mahi sandwich and I went with the chicken tikka masala, Both were very good. Would recommend and return!

name: Customer_9583
comments:
First night in Nashville, after a long car ride, ready to get a taste of that night life!!  Great place to start.

Food: Started with the SHISHITO PEPPERS, def glad I did.  These are perfectly charred.  Cooked well, so that they are still a little crisp and not soggy.  Lightly salted.  Greatest part, they give a little pile of sea salt on the side, so you can season to your liking!!  Be careful with these.  Some of the peppers have a super spicy kick.
  
BUFFALO CAULIFLOWER was another starter.  This app was a bit too sour for me.  The tanginess was pretty potent that I could not focus on any other flavors.  Also, the exterior of the cauliflower was not that crispy.  More on the soggier side.  Not a fan.  Pass on this.
  
TURKEY BLT was a good choice.  The pretzel bread was nice and chewy.  Lovely choice of bread for this sammy.  Wonderfully smoked turkey with crispy bacon.  Comes together beautifully with the smooth gruyere cheese, and the creamy avocado aioli.  Great textures and tastes that really comes together in this sammy.  I got it with the Tuscan tavern fries.  Nice and crunchy fries.  Def try.

SMORES on the tabletop.  Even comes with a small campfire.  Classic fix'ns for smores: graham crackers, marshmellows, and chocolate bar.  In addition, some strawberries and reese's peanut butter cups.  Was quite the indoor smores experience.

Service: Drinks were full, food got to the table fresh and hot, server was attentive, and table was cleared away promptly.  All together, I think it was a good experience.

Ambiance: Very casual.  Rustic and slightly romantic.  Nice for a girls gathering, as well as date night. 
  
Dranks: Great selection of beers, wines, and specialty cocktails.  A little something for everyone.  I had wine that night, but def would like to go back and try one of their cocktails.  
 
Overall: A place that I would like to visit again.  Food was good.  Drinks were good.  This is a place that you can go, no pressure, find something to eat, and get your drink on.  Enjoy!!

name: Customer_5323
comments: Just stopped in for drinks.  Staff was great,  never felt rushed. Food passing by smelt and looked awesome. May be coming back tomorrow.

name: Customer_3194
comments: I at least have to give this restaurant two stars due to the decent food. But while on a dinner meeting and after spending $100 on entrées and appetizers, I had to flag down the assistant cook, (the guy in bright red baggy pants watching TV), to see if I could get more avocado for my tuna entrée.  He made it very apparent and direct that he could not help me with that situation and I would have to flag down my  waitress so she could bill me for the four dollar avocado.

name: Customer_3282
comments: Had a wonderful dinner at the tavern I had the chicken skewers, they we're deliciuos, wish they had more veggies in them however. But still they were great! My girlfriend got the Mahi sandwich and said it was perfectly blackened a Cajun tater that paired well with a creamy cucumber garnish, it was all really delicous! I got the house made cocktail "Amerboire". So good I got 2!! Natalie was our server and she was so helpful and great! Made us feel right at home in Nashville! Can't wait to come back

name: Customer_6491
comments: Chose Tavern because I wanted to catch a baseball game on their TVs while eating.  The wait for a table of four was an hour on a Saturday night.  Food was fine but nothing to jump up and down about.  Waitress recommended the Tavern burger...it was ok.

name: Customer_4161
comments: ALERT: A must for brunch spot!!! I have been here several times now. The brunch time is SO busy but SO worth it! I recommend the Red Velvet Waffles and the Blood Orange Mimosa. Another time I went for dinner I had a phenomenal Mahi sandwich with the white Sangria. Holy amazing. The servise is great, just hectic during brunch.

name: Customer_2448
comments:
Oh hell yeah!!  Came in for a simple burger and fries.  

Great food! Even better service!  

Will definitely be a stop on any trip to Nashville.

Make sure you try the Tuscany fries!

name: Customer_6249
comments: Short rib tacos ruled! The sweet potato fries were an awesome starter. Our server Lindsay was amazing. Kept our glasses full the whole time and checked up on us constantly! Good vibe and they had the game on which in the playoffs is always a good thing! I'd go back again! Maybe take mom and dad to this joint!

name: Customer_1852
comments: Great food!  The menu is full of interesting, and unique items.  I tried the smoked salmon eggs benedict, and it was phenomenal.  The interior is very well decorated, and the servers were helpful and prompt.  Though it was a little on the expensive side, it was well worth the cost for such a great experience.
