name: Customer_2062
comments: From service to taste this restaurant had it all. Their mahi sandwich was cooked and seasoned perfectly. Their drink selection was vast and test

name: Customer_7293
comments: My 8 friends and I came here during our visit to Nashville because of good reviews we heard from friends who visited - they did not disappoint.  Tavern was a great brunch spot and they were able to accommodate our large group fairly easily.  The service was awesome, relaxed and friendly staff all around.  The food was phenomenal - We split almost every app on the menu, all very good.  I had the special taco scramble and it was one of the best egg dishes I've had in a while.  The "white trash hash" that came with it was delicious and a twist on the classic hashbrowns.  All in all I would come back here and would recommend to anyone visiting.

name: Customer_3869
comments: I've never been to an M Street restraunt before, for those of you who are not familiar with M Street they are the zany people who bring us restaurant concepts such as Kayne Prime (on my bucket list,) Virago and Moto (also on my bucket list.) So on Wednesday night we visited Tavern, which is self-described as "a pub for chefs." Valet parking at this location is a must and they were prompt and efficient. There was plenty of porch seating available as well as being used - Nashvillians do love their porches. The inside of the restaurant had a rustic feel and it seemed as though the bar top was inhabited by business class regulars. That having been said I could easily picture the bar at 12 midnight being inhabited by waitrons and people with checkered pants, it would be a great place to have some concept drinks and small plates after a busy restaurant shift. I ordered the Korean short rib tacos - I definitely got the red pepper forward taste as well as the cool of the cucumber and cilantro. I would order it again. Delivery time was about 13 minutes, a good ticket time. It's very evident that these people are "on their game," I will be returning to try other items on their menu. And one day I will visit Kayne Prime, I might splurge for that on my father's birthday. Visit Tavern, have fun!

name: Customer_7622
comments: We were staying right down the street from this place and it was recommended by the girl at the front desk of our hotel. We actually went to get a few drinks and bite to eat on a Friday night. The atmosphere is really nice and the bar is really big. Definitely a good bar to watch football game at or any sports game at. My girlfriend and I both had different signature cocktails which were really good. I had the fish tacos which were out of this world! So good I can't even tell you, you'll have to try them for yourself! My girlfriend had the seared tuna which was also great, a little spicy so watch out for that if you don't like spicy. We went back the next morning for brunch. I ordered the Benedict Uno which was eggs benedict with short rib and a tabasco hollandaise sauce. I also ordered a side of the white trash hash. First off all, the white trash hash was out of this world! So different and unique and so good it was amazing. The reason I'm giving this place 4 stars is because of the Benedict. I always order Eggs Benedict and no matter what kind of Hollandaise sauce it comes with I've never thought of ordering it on the side. For this Benedict I should of. It was drenched in the tabasco hollandaise sauce which wasn't bad but just was way way way too much. I couldn't even taste the egg or could see if I was eating egg or just all sauce. It honestly made me sick after we left. I wish there was half the amount they gave me or I should of got it on the side but like I said, I've never had a problem with too much hollandaise sauce. The picture below is deceiving because it doesn't look like a lot of sauce but there really was. Other then that everything was terrific! I just hope they over did my Benedict and don't do that for every Benedict dish they serve.

name: Customer_4737
comments: We stumbled onto this restaurant after seeing the very long line at Hattie B's. The atmosphere seemed really nice and the wait for a table much more manageable-only 10 minutes. The menu choices were appealing and we put in an order for two burgers, fries, a fish sandwich and trail salad.  Then we waited, and waited and waited some more.  Fifty minutes later our food still did not arrive with no real explanation (or apology) from our server.  The manager was pleasant and after she was alerted our food did arrive. The burgers were tasty as were the Belgian fries. The trail mix salad had too many dried cranberries for my liking making it much too sweet.  I think with a different server the experience may have been more positive, but with so many great restaurants in Nashville I won't be going back to find out.

name: Customer_9523
comments: Awesome atmosphere and great food. You have to go here if your in Nashville!  Make sure you try the Buffalo Cauliflower, Beef short rib tacos and the Horseshoe. We tried the fried chicken skins.....not a fan.

name: Customer_3412
comments:
Honesty hour, we went out in Nashville after 10pm. Apparently, there are limited options at that time, when it isn't the weekend. We decided to try out this place after walking to a couple of other places that were not like their descriptions. 
This place has a nice ambience, nice staff, and a ton of beers and ciders on tap. The prices weren't bad for the drinks or beer. Between 5-8 for the beer/cider. Around 10-12 for cocktails. Oh, and the kitchen closes at 11. 

Now on to the food, we got the burger and the chimichanga. We were splitting them so we went for something a little different with the chimichanga. We also got the cheesesteak egg rolls. Sounds fantastic, right? Unfortunately, the burger was the only highlight. Everything else got a HUGE FAIL! The chimichanga was super soggy. The rice and beans were ok. The cheesesteak egg rolls were just BAD! No taste at all.  

Now on to our drinks. We first ordered their take on a margarita. They used silver
Tequila so it had a very heavy tequila taste. It was ok.  He wound up with the punch. It was ok. Mind you, we were traveling all day and ate everything. So, it was edible. 

All and all, if you need somewhere to go late, then try it. Just  stick to very regular things. The staff is nice ,so, that is worth a visit based on that alone.

name: Customer_1244
comments: Went to Tavern for brunch on Saturday morning and fell in love! We got there a few minutes before 10, when they open, and were seated right away. This is definitely the way to do it, because 30 minutes later, there was already a long wait. I ordered the Singapore Stir-Fry ($9.50) and was totally happy with it. Rice stir-fried with bacon and green onion, with a perfectly cooked over-easy egg. My only complaint was that it was a little bit on the salty side, likely due to the stir-fry sauce combined with the bacon. But if you're okay with salty food, I would definetly recomand it! I cannot wait to go back to Tavern and try other brunch menu items because everything on the menu sounded so delicous and creative!

name: Customer_3387
comments: This place has a great vibe and lots of energy! Being an out towner, we were recommended the tavern by our hotel staff at Hutton hotel. The tavern is in walking distance and has a very friendly wait staff. Their food was great and the wine made our night before walking downtown to enjoy the live music on the strip. And we are back for another round the next day! :)

name: Customer_2969
comments: Food was great here! I've been here before just for drinks and wanted to come back because I had an amazing pineapple charred mule cocktail. We came back and ate this time. The only thing preventing me from giving Tavern five stars was that the service was slower than it should be and it wasn't an insanely busy night. Our waitress was not the most attentive.

name: Customer_6091
comments: Tavern is THE Nashville brunch spot. {starters} I have tried a good portion of the starter selections - but the buffalo cauliflower, brussels and tavern fries stand out above the rest. The mussels are also a great option for dinner or happy hour. {entrees} I'm a huge fan of benedicts, and Tavern kills it with each of their 3 options - aptly named uno, dos, and (for some reason) three. Uno is my favorite, with braised short rib and Tobasco hollandaise. It is absolutely delicious. Other great options are the Nooner - which is a bacon scramble with fried oysters and spicy sour cream - and the Singapore Stir-fry, with wok-style rice, a sunny-side-up egg, and bacon. You really can't go wrong with any of the Tavern's fantastic brunch selections, but these stand out for sure. {libations} Possibly the reason that Tavern is so popular among Nashville brunch-goers, is the 2-for-1 deal they offer during brunch all weekend. The selection is fairly standard, with mimosas, a bellini, two bloody mary renditions, and a very sweet sangria. My favorite is the blood orange mimosa, but each drink has its merits. Overall, Tavern is a wonderful place for any brunch occasion and I will continue to dine here often as long as I am in Nashville. The wait is brutal so make sure you arrive early to start off with a beverage in the sun on their outdoor waiting area. Enjoy!

name: Customer_7400
comments: Hmmmmm it's decent. Not sure about the 'rave' reviews to be honest. The prices kind of turned me off. They have a brunch item of Kaya Toast which is to out it bluntly ridiculously overpriced. I can get a jar of Kaya from the Asian market for 1/10the price of the dish. Not impressed.

name: Customer_6265
comments: Burger was amazing.  So juicy, cooked to perfection - ordered it medium rare, and it was!  Fries was delicious as well.  thank you!

name: Customer_7401
comments: Had a wonderful dinner at the tavern I had the chicken skewers, they we're delicious, wish they had more veggies in them however. But still they were great! My girlfriend got the Mahi sandwich and said it was perfectly blackened a Cajun tater that paired well with a creamy cucumber garnish, it was all really delicious! I got the house made cocktail "Amerboire".  So good I got 2!! Natalie was our server and she was so helpful and great! Made us feel right at home in Nashville! Can't wait  to come back

name: Customer_9062
comments: great amosphere and wonderful food! highly recommend but expect a long wait. well worth it though.

name: Customer_9741
comments: Tavern is a great place to grab a late night bite. The menu has a lot of variety. I really enjoy the kale salad and all their fries. The s'mores dessert is also really fun and unique! Definitely worth checking out if you're in midtown Nashville.

name: Customer_6863
comments: Went to Tavern for the first time last night after hearing many of my friends rave about it. Got there at 6 p.m. for a friend's birthday gathering and it was not crowded then. We had a big group and the staff was accommodating about our taking two of the big booths in the bar and spilling out in the aisle. The wine list is very modest but I found something that worked. Service was good. Now, I gotta say, the server didn't seem like she loves her job - she didn't look all that happy about serving us, but she was timely and checked back often, so who am I to complain? I didn't order food myself, but grazed off my friends' appetizers. The nachos with 'angry chicken' were really, really good. I've never met a nacho I didn't like, but these rank in the top two or three I've ever had. I was suspicious about the guacamole - who puts goat cheese and pistachios in guac? Why gild the lily? But once I picked off the nuts and cheese, the guac was also superlative: had a really nice garlicky kick. There wasn't a whole lot on the menu that didn't look appealing, so I am looking forward to going back soon and having a real meal. On the whole, I like it a lot better than its sister, Whiskey Kitchen.

name: Customer_3691
comments: Evan the doorman was as friendly as his beard is burly. Jenna the hostess got us a table wiki wiki even though the place was packed. Amy our server professed her love for us because we ordered 8 items at once and handed her the menus back. Specialty cocktails were fantastic and the fish tacos were off the charts delicious. Well done, Tavern. Well done.

name: Customer_4898
comments: I at least have to give this restaurant two stars due to the decent food. But while on a dinner meeting and after spending $100 on entrées and appetizers, I had to flag down the assistant cook, (the guy in bright red baggy pants watching TV), to see if I could get more avocado for my tuna entrée. He made it very apparent and direct that he could not help me with that situation and I would have to flag down my waitress so she could bill me for the four dollar avocado.

name: Customer_6651
comments: Truly not worth the wait. I've tried a couple dishes and nothing has been great- wouldn't really recommend. Almost everything I have tried has either been too dry or too salty. The ambiance is nice but it's pretty slow. The only good food item is their fries.

name: Customer_5861
comments:
Gonna bust out a cliche and say Tavern is a lot of style without much sustenance. Not a horrid place, mind you. Just not a place I'd actually choose to hang. Silly me, I forgot my LBD to hang out on a patio on a random Wednesday night across the street from a gruesome looking construction site (not their fault). Seriously - even though Tavern is going for a manly man scene there were hordes of cute ladies dressed to the nines (obvs not *this* cute lady) sitting amongst the concrete, dark wood and large chains (!?!?) decor. 

Huh, now that I think about it I guess hordes of pretty ladies do draw men, so ignore that last statement ;D

I personally, didn't eat anything but the food looked alright. I'm not joking when I say there was a $9 bologna sammie on the menu. The catfish and the salmon are also the same cool $15. I was with a larger group that ordered a variety of food. The fish taco was literally a huge fish stick on a tortilla. Weird. Okay, fine I am paying for the honor to look hip. I get it, but I'll stick to your 2-4-1 Wednesday night drink specials. 

I had the 'Tavern Collins' ($7.50) - once again even the drink was style without sustenance. It was very pretty - served with an old school lemon twist, but it was sorely lacking booze. Half priced = half the alcohol maybe? 

Our server was pretty much 3 star as well, she seemed to have a hustle (it was 2-4-1 night after all) and claimed to have a perfect memory, but tell that to my boys who were quite annoyed at forgotten beer orders. I'll let it slide, my service was good enough and she did seem wicked busy!

Either way - if one of my friends recommended we go to Tavern I'd be alright with it, I'll just remember my LBD and stick to a beer special next time!

name: Customer_2548
comments: Great atmosphere. Amazing burgers. The heart of Nashville in food. Would definitely come again and recommend to friends visiting Nashville.

name: Customer_2664
comments:
Stopped in at lunch for THE Tavern Burger.  While it is the only burger on the menu, they provide many options for it.  While I didn't personally order it, a coworker got a cooked egg on it,  You can get it also with Grilled Onions or Bacon.

The burger is pretty sizable and also includes Belgian fries. I'm not sure exactly what they do to Begian-ize them, butt he were quite good.

We arrived at just a bit after 11 AM so it wasn't very busy yet. Parking could certainly be an issue though.

15 dollars for a burger might also be a bit pricier that a regular Joe or Jane is willing to pay, and it would be hard to argue.  It was however, quite delicious and filling.

I'm not sure what the dinner time crowd looks like, but at least for THE Burger I would be back.

name: Customer_9785
comments: We went for lunch today. Service was too slow for anyone on a lunch break (it took nearly an hour). There wasn't a lunch menu, so we paid dinner prices for dinner portions. I saw a little section of "fast plates". I forget what it was called, but none of those items really jumped out at me. We ordered fish tacos, beef tacos with Korean BBQ and fries. It was all good. This might be a better place for dinner.

name: Customer_3811
comments: Great brunch and cocktails! The Nooner, Roasted Peppers and Squash, and Blueberry Waffles were great. Very good Bloody Mary, red sangria, and signature craft cocktails.

name: Customer_4795
comments:
This is an awesome place to come for a boozy brunch and a good time! It is a very lively atmosphere with a lot of TVs so also a great place to watch sports while grabbing a few drinks and some delish food. 

I would highly recommend the chorizo biscuits and gravy - there is a cheesy goodness to this dish that will cure any hangover and leave you with a happy tummy. They also have a great mix of cocktails and beer that makes for great day drinking!

name: Customer_8366
comments:
Overpriced.  

That's the best way to describe it.  Everything was FINE.  Just fine.  But when our bar tab is $60 for a few drinks, and I felt like I needed to go over the menu about 8 times to find something exciting to try (I landed on the burger), I felt let down.  

All of the reviews of this place made me want to come visit.  I think these must all be Vandy kids or tourists who don't know where the better quality places are with better prices.  

I just felt, well... so meh about the whole thing.  

Again, everything was fine, decent, even.  But by the time to pay the bill came, my husband and I thought of at LEAST 5 or 6 different places we could have gone for BETTER drinks with CHEAPER prices and a much better menu.  

Obviously, this is probably for the hip crowd.  So, if you're hip, go for it.  If you were once hip, and you know better... be prepared to be underwhelmed.

name: Customer_2949
comments: Good drinks, good food and a great atmosphere! What more could you want? The drink menu is very extensive, good selection of scotch and cocktails. The food was very impressive as well. I tried the sweet potato fries with jalapeno mayo after seeing it suggested so much and I must say they delivered! This is a great place to hang out with friends and pass some time. Give it a try!

name: Customer_3956
comments: Meet by a great hostess at the door, Jenna. Her smile was amazing! Drinks at the bar were rather good.  They actually have a loco moco! BOOM!

name: Customer_6997
comments:
I have seen various reviews on Tavern.  Some very negative.  Others slightly positive.  Most complimented the food but nothing spectacular. 

So, this past Friday night a few friends and I got together for dinner and I wanted to try some place new.  I put out a list of 3 new places (new to me anyway) I'd like to try - based upon the Menu.  I listed Red Pony in Franklin, Burger Up and Tavern.  I sent my friends links to the restaurants and ultimately we agreed that Tavern would be the place.  

We arrived at 7:30 and ended up having to wait an hour for a table and they don't take reservations.  That was fine.  We figured about anywhere we went on a Friday night at this point we would encounter a wait of similar length.  So, we waited and ordered a couple cocktails while we waited.  

This is probably the biggest downside of the restaurant.  They don't have a place for you to really wait.  The bar was jam packed and there was no seating up front.  There was seating outside on the patio - but no one was out there because it was raining and cold.  So, we stood inside near the door for an hour.  

When we were finally seated the server asked us if we needed any more drinks and if we wanted any appetizers.

We decided to go with the 'Bazooka" Guacamole Appetizer.  I pretty much hate Guacamole and never order it anywhere.  I've tried it several times many different places.  Never liked it.  But, this was supposed to be 'different' with some goat cheese and other stuff in it as well.  The presentation of the appetizer was very cool.  They bring it out in a 2-3" deep round cake pan lined with parchment or wax paper - I don't really remember.  Inside there is a glass jar with one of those hinged glass lids on top and its filled with this guacamole concoction.  They have a few chips out on the pan, however, there is also a small, brown paper bag with the logo of 'Tavern' on it - and it is filled with chips.  We took the small server spoon and each took a dollop of the guacamole and put it on a chip.  Wow!  Absolutely incredible.  I don't know if it qualifies as guacamole or not (I'm sure some purists would say it doesn't) - but whatever it is or whatever you want to call it - it was incredible.  I couldn't get enough.  We were scraping the bottom of the jar trying to get every last ounce of this wonderful, tasty spread.

Moving onto dinner two of us go the Tavern Burger.  This burger is made with Prime Rib and Filet.  2 excellent cuts of meat - ground up and made into a burger.  I had mine with White Cheddar and bacon and was incredible!  Everything was good.  The meat, the bacon, the cheese - even the bun was tasty.  My friend had his plain and loved it as well.  Both burgers were served with fries.  He had the regular fries - I had mine tossed in Parmesan and garlic.  Either way they were good.  Apparently they serve them several different ways.

Another friend got the 'Mama Sans Fried Chicken'.  He was blown away by how much food he got.  He also was surprised at how well the chicken went with the cold noodles he was served as the side.  He said the cold noodles were a good juxtaposition against the hot chicken. 

My other friend got the "Salad of Little Gems".  It looked a bit small to me but he claimed to really enjoy it.  As far as salads go it did look great.

The food was all served rather quickly but the pacing of the meal was on point.  The appetizer was served and finished well ahead of the meal making its way from the kitchen.  Too often I feel rushed and sometimes the appetizers and entree arrive within second of each other.  Sometimes even together!  I think the pacing of the meal was excellent.  Also, our server was great and our glasses were never empty.  She made sure we always had plenty to drink.

4 Cocktails, 4 entree's, 1 appetizer = $94 bucks after tax and everything.  So, around 20 bucks a person for a night out.  

So, to review:

Long wait - no place to really sit.  They DO take your phone number and will call you when your table is ready so you can make your way back to the restaurant.

Service was excellent.  Drinks were never empty.  Pacing of meal was great from the appetizer to the main course.

Price was fine.  We could have eaten for less if we didn't get cocktails, appetizers AND the main course.  If we'd just had water and our meal - we would have spent a lot less.  The cocktails were pricy - but pretty stout.  They didn't skimp on the alcohol for sure.

I think it was wonderful and we are already planning our next trip!  I think you should too.

name: Customer_6363
comments: This place was AMAZING! I found it on yelp and saw the reviews, knew my dad and I had to check it out. We immediately got a killer spot at the bar and was greeted by the nicest bartender we've come across in Nashville this far. I had some white wine and my dad had beer on tap. We split (demolished) the nachos- I highly recommend adding chicken!! I could have ordered everything else on the menu but the nachos were super filling. Very hip place, highly recommend

name: Customer_5399
comments: I came here for my birthday brunch and was pleasantly surprised! Our server was wonderful and she talked a lot with us and made the experience even better! Every single dish ordered from our table was delicious! Definitely one of he best brunch places in Nashville!

name: Customer_6533
comments: We went for lunch today. Service was too slow for anyone on a lunch break (it took nearly an hour). There wasn't a lunch menu, so we paid dinner prices for dinner portions. I saw a little section of "fast plates". I forget what it was called, but none of those items really jumped out at me. We ordered fish tacos, beef tacos with Korean BBQ and fries. It was all good. This might be a better place for dinner.

name: Customer_8403
comments: Food tastes good but not worth the price. Drinks are overpriced as well. $11.50 for a small Moscow mule with stolii vodka. I got the grilled cheese and the grilled chicken skewers. Both tasted fine but nothing to write home about. The chicken came with rice but everything was very plain, nothing that would warrant the price I paid. My tab totaled $61 after tip for grilled cheese, chicken skewers, a beer, and a Moscow mule. For this reason I would not go back.

name: Customer_6848
comments: Went to Tavern for brunch on Saturday morning and fell in love! We got there a few minutes before 10, when they open, and were seated right away. This is definitely the way to do it, because 30 minutes later, there was already a long wait. I ordered the Singapore Stir-Fry ($9.50) and was totally happy with it. Rice stir-fried with bacon and green onion, with a perfectly cooked over-easy egg. My only complaint was that it was a little bit on the salty side, likely due to the stir-fry sauce combined with the bacon. But if you're okay with salty food, I would definitely recommend it! I cannot wait to go back to Tavern and try other brunch menu items because everything on the menu sounded so delicious and creative!

name: Customer_1429
comments: Service was ok, but the food was excellent. Nothing against our sweet server, but she was alone on a 20 person table - really? I completely blame that one on management! Buffalo cauliflower was awesome and the chicken skewers were so so good! Everyone had a wonderful time! Ambiance was so fun!

name: Customer_9879
comments:
Tavern was in walking distance from our hotel, and we had read it was a good place to watch a game, so we were there! I really liked the feel of this place. It was really modern and even the waitstaff complements the look with their matching grey v-necks. We were famished after a long day and got down on so many dishes! 

-grilled artichokes. promised with a "comeback sauce" which we got to help my friend push ahead past her hangover, it didn't really do that.
-lamb tacos and pork tacos. the lamb tacos were great but nothing could compare to the pork tacos. I have never been more sad to see the end of a taco.
-salad of little gems. hello? little gems describing anything? I'm in! It was a great, little refreshment from my all-meat diet, with cranberries and fresh mozzerella.
-chicken and waffle. The fried chicken was great, but the cheddar and jalepeno waffle was almost too overpowering with the sweey syrup.
-loco moco. too much meat but the rice and egg were just what my friend needed to get back on the drinking horse so props for that!

The drink list was also amazing here, great whiskey cocktails and they make a mean martini as well! I also liked the mix of people here. It was the perfect Friday night crowd. Prices were pretty reasonable, unless, of course, you are posted up watching Michigan beat Kansas in overtime, then the bill might be a bit higher to taste victory ;)

name: Customer_3521
comments: Good stuff for brunch if you are drinking. Recommend getting there early as it was packed when we got there around 11 and there was a ton of people waiting when we left.

name: Customer_9718
comments: Burger was amazing.  So juicy, cooked to perfection - ordered it medium rare, and it was!  Fries was delicious as well.  thank you!

name: Customer_4890
comments: Chose Tavern because I wanted to catch a baseball game on their TVs while eating.  The wait for a table of four was an hour on a Saturday night.  Food was fine but nothing to jump up and down about.  Waitress recommended the Tavern burger...it was ok.

name: Customer_7392
comments: Delicious food in a fun setting.  Great helpful and friendly service.  Two levels of seating near the bar.  We had awesome buffalo cauliflower, egg rolls with philly cheese steak and amazing kale salad.  highly recommend the Tavern.

name: Customer_9876
comments: Dark wood, open warm space and welcoming servic. It seems the owners of Tavern have their hand on the pulse of the Vandy area. The patio cushioned banquet seating perfect for people watching. The patio is open and inviting, the interior is spacious and bustling. I had wine, chicken tacos and Yukon truffle chips. I must say the chips were my favorite, perfect for trying all the sauces on the table. They were warm and crispy. The tacos were a bit tough and chewy. I will defiantly be back to conquer that burger! Chow!

name: Customer_4213
comments: Service and food was excellant!! Personal favorite is the beef short rib tacos washed down with a gluten-free beer.

name: Customer_5411
comments: Went today with a group for brunch. We had no complaints. Great-cucumber Bloody Mary, coffee, lobster gumbo, grilled artichoke, white trash hash and service. The decor was tasteful and semi modern. I definitely felt like we left Nashville for a couple hours which was great! Will definitely be back!

name: Customer_2689
comments: Came here during a recent trip to Nashville. Came here a couple years ago for brunch which was amazing but a super long wait so beware. Didn't realize when I picked this place this time that they also do a 2 for 1 drink special from 2-10pm on Wednesday nights. This is a great deal but makes the night a lot busier. I was with an older group of people so they personally didn't like how much noise was going on in the restaurant. In terms of food I do feel like it's a little overpriced for what you get. But I will say the mahi-mahi tacos were tasty. I would definitely come back on future trips to Nashville. And if they take reservations I will do that instead.

name: Customer_4057
comments: Delicious brunch, fabulous service! The buy one get one brunch drinks were a plus! It started getting crowded at 11am, so I suggest getting there when they open at 10am!

name: Customer_9265
comments: Went on a friend's birthday for a birthday dinner and had a very bad experience. A very long wait despite having reservations, and then it took forever just to get a drink from the bar. The food was very, very disappointing--I ordered the lettuce wraps and left hungry. We split a few appetizers, including the crudite/hummus plate--I was just shocked at how overpriced it all was. This is definitely for the yuppie set that doesn't mind spending $ on mediocre food.

name: Customer_9022
comments:
I love Tavern. They have exceptional cocktails, killer food, and an ambiance that can't be beat! I foresee many a dollar of mine being spent here....

It gets VERY busy, and on Sunday when I stopped in with a friend it was no exception. Luckily, there were two seats at the bar, so we snagged them and sat down. After drooling over another customer's plate of mussels, I decided I had to get them. White wine with bacon, leeks, and a piece of "dippy" bread? Um score. My friend had the chicken chimichanga, and it was cheesy but still full of flavor and amazing! 

But let's talk cocktails, something that really gets my engine running and Tavern hit the mark.

The red sangria was pre-mixed and topped off with some bubbly. It was a good sangria, but not over the top good. However, my balsamic martini with stoli, strawberry puree, and a splash of balsamic syrup?? Creative and delicious! I will be ordering the drink again and again! The bellini sparkle was not in a tiny champagne flute, it was in a tumbler and was refreshing. My friend couldn't stop ordering the cucumber, apple, and elderflower cocktail. Be warned, it is very strong! 

I was worried our service would be poor because they only had 2 bartenders for the entire bar, but it wasn't. They were attentive and sure to check up on us and get our orders in. They also have some incredible outdoor seating areas, and enjoying a cocktail on a nice day here is heaven. 

Thanks for the good times Tavern, I can't wait to see you again!

name: Customer_8991
comments: this place was so awesome. we went on sunday so the drinks were 2 for the price of one. they have a great little sitting area outside where you can sit and wait for your table to be ready. I had the Blood & Smoke, im not a huge fan of bloody marys usually but this was amazing. the food was also great, and came out fairly quick after ordering. they also had a DJ playing a variety of music the whole time and I really enjoyed that.  I definitely will visit this place again.

name: Customer_2965
comments: Food was great here! I've been here before just for drinks and wanted to come back because I had an amazing pineapple charred mule cocktail. We came back and ate this time. The only thing preventing me from giving Tavern five stars was that the service was slower than it should be and it wasn't an insanely busy night. Our waitress was not the most attentive.

name: Customer_6465
comments: Great place to grab drinks with friends! The waitresses were super friendly. Go on Thursday nights for the best drink specials. One con is that the food isn't that great, but this place is fabulous for drinks.

name: Customer_6370
comments: I could eat the blue cheese fondue on almost anything. I bet liver would taste good in that fondue. Fortunately I had some really good buffalo cauliflower to go along with and I hasten to say it was a top 5 all time appetizer ever.People rave about the fries and they were good but not the best I have had. The Tavern burger on the other-hand may be the best burger I have ever had. Made from ground rib-eye and filet makes me believe God made the burger lol The lobster sliders were really good but 22 bucks not that good. The mushroom soup had to be made by Angels it was amazing. Its a little pricey but you definitely get what you pay for, for the most part. As a whole it may be the best lunch ever. I give very few 5 stars on average and this was well earned. The place is nice and cozy and the staff were great. It was a religious experience involving food.

name: Customer_9593
comments: You'll defintely have a wait for brunch but grab a drink and buckle in cause it's worth it. Everyone at the table loved what they ordered. We started with the buffalo cauliflower and got the pretzel pancakes, nooner, blueberry waffle and the red velvet waffle and damn if we didn't clean our plates. Also if you don't get the white trash hash you'll regret it for years to come. Service was great and our drinks were perfect.

name: Customer_2787
comments: My 8 friends and I came here during our visit to Nashville because of good reviews we heard from friends who visited - they did not disappoint.  Tavern was a great brunch spot and they were able to accommodate our large group fairly easily.  The service was awesome, relaxed and friendly staff all around.  The food was phenomenal - We split almost every app on the menu, all very good.  I had the special taco scramble and it was one of the best egg dishes I've had in a while.  The "white trash hash" that came with it was delicious and a twist on the classic hashbrowns.  All in all I would come back here and would recommend to anyone visiting.

name: Customer_1985
comments: Very nice place for a white collar after work drink and dinner. I was in town for a football game and looking for a bit of a different atmosphere, but this is a nice spot that I would frequent otherwise. They have a nice whiskey selection at the bar too.

name: Customer_4850
comments: Great food!  The menu is full of interesting, and unique items.  I tried the smoked salmon eggs benedict, and it was phenomenal.  The interior is very well decorated, and the servers were helpful and prompt.  Though it was a little on the expensive side, it was well worth the cost for such a great experience.

name: Customer_6421
comments: My vegan friend had the kale salad and loved it. I had one of the taco options -- pretty good too. Wine list was short but reasonably priced. Service was friendly. Better than many of the other options near campus.

name: Customer_9297
comments:
Tavern is a great brunch place with a good vibe.  I love the sangeria because they top it off with Cava, sortof a sparkling sangeria...refreshing.  I like sitting at the bar because there can be a bit of a wait depending on when you get there.  And in my experience you always get better service at the bar.   
Parking can be hard around midtown so I would valet,  its free, just tip the poor guy!

name: Customer_3264
comments: Great brunch and cocktails! The Nooner, Roasted Peppers and Squash, and Blueberry Waffles were great. Very good Bloody Mary, red sangria, and signature craft cocktails.

name: Customer_2944
comments: The girls and I always go to Tavern for Sunday night dinners. Our favorite waitress Sarah Michelle delivers the best service. She knows our drinks and never steers us wrong on what to try to eat next. The buffalo cauliflower is so yummy but nothing compares to the S'mores for dessert.

name: Customer_1645
comments:

Silly me, I forgot my LBD to hang out on a patio on a random Wednesday night across the street from a gruesome looking construction site (not their fault). Seriously - even though Tavern is going for a manly man scene there were hordes of cute ladies dressed to the nines (obvs not *this* cute lady) sitting amongst the concrete, dark wood and large chains (!?!?) decor. 

Huh, now that I think about it I guess hordes of pretty ladies do draw men, so ignore that last statement ;D

I personally, didn't eat anything but the food looked alright. I'm not joking when I say there was a $9 bologna sammie on the menu. The catfish and the salmon are also the same cool $15. I was with a larger group that ordered a variety of food. The fish taco was literally a huge fish stick on a tortilla. Weird. Okay, fine I am paying for the honor to look hip. I get it, but I'll stick to your 2-4-1 Wednesday night drink specials. 

I had the 'Tavern Collins' ($7.50) - once again even the drink was style without sustenance. It was very pretty - served with an old school lemon twist, but it was sorely lacking booze. Half priced = half the alcohol maybe? 

Our server was pretty much 3 star as well, she seemed to have a hustle (it was 2-4-1 night after all) and claimed to have a perfect memory, but tell that to my boys who were quite annoyed at forgotten beer orders. I'll let it slide, my service was good enough and she did seem wicked busy!

Either way - if one of my friends recommended we go to Tavern I'd be alright with it, I'll just remember my LBD and stick to a beer special next time!

name: Customer_4802
comments:
Best place within walking distance from my hotel.  It's a pretty modern and happening place, with a cool feel to it.

I really was looking for a good salad, and was pleasantly surprised with my Junk Salad (romaine, salami, shrimp, olives, pepperoncini, hearts of palm, grape tomato, cucumber, blue cheese, champagne dijon vinaigrette).  This was a super tasty salad.

I came back 4 days later and had the burger and sweet potato ships.  Burger was pretty good, and my only complaint was that the chips were a little on the salty side.  Brush some of the salt off and it was good.

name: Customer_7974
comments: Great food, great atmosphere.  I had the mac and cheese, which was a special and it wasn't on the menu, but it was AMAZING.  I also highly recommend the egg rolls.  Not your normal egg rolls.

name: Customer_9598
comments: Came in for lunch while in Nashville in business. The waitress sold me on their Bloody Mary, so I ordered that and the lettuce wraps. The bloody was ridiculously watered down. It tasted watered down and looked like the glass was about 85% water/ice. When I commented on the look and taste, the waitress proceeded to tell me that if it looked watered down, there was probably extra vodka in it, which I couldn't taste because it was "infused" which cuts down on the vodka taste. What a load of BS. It was one of the most disappointing bloodies I've had. I should have sent it back, but she was adamant that I was wrong. Lettuce wraps had a nice spicy kick, which I liked, but it failed to redeem the dry, canned-tasting chicken. Very. Under-impressed.

name: Customer_4638
comments: I visited tavern for lunch looking to try their burger.  I had been told they have one of the best burgers in Nashville.  I thought it was a pretty good burger but I can think of several burgers better in a 5 mile radius.  I will say as a dining venue it is top notch.  Staff was excellent and the layout is very cool.  The menu has several unique items that might bring me back to try like the fried chicken skins...    A tip would be you will probably need to valet since parking is scarce in the area

name: Customer_3747
comments: You'll definetly have a wait for brunch but grab a drink and buckle in cause it's worth it. Everyone at the table loved what they ordered. We started with the buffalo cauliflower and got the pretzel pancakes, nooner, blueberry waffle and the red velvet waffle and damn if we didn't clean our plates. Also if you don't get the white trash hash you'll regret it for years to come. Service was great and our drinks were perfect.

name: Customer_4279
comments: Food was great. Sweet potato chips were amazing. Great vibe too. Seating indoors or out and a huge variety of menu options.

name: Customer_1132
comments: Overpriced. That's the best way to describe it. Everything was FINE. Just fine. But when our bar tab is $60 for a few drinks, and I felt like I needed to go over the menu about 8 times to find something exciting to try (I landed on the burger), I felt let down. All of the reviews of this place made me want to come visit. I think these must all be Vandy kids or tourists who don't know where the better quality places are with better prices. I just felt, well... so meh about the whole thing. Again, everything was fine, decent, even. But by the time to pay the bill came, my husband and I thought of at LEAST 5 or 6 different places we could have gone for BETTER drinks with CHEAPER prices and a much better menu. Obviously, this is probably for the hip crowd. So, if you're hip, go for it. If you were once hip, and you know better... be prepared to be underwhelmed.

name: Customer_9724
comments: Went on a friend's birthday for a birthday dinner and had a very bad experience. A very long wait despite having reservations, and then it took forever just to get a drink from the bar. The food was very, very disappointing--I ordered the lettuce wraps and left hungry. We split a few appetizers, including the crudite/hummus plate--I was just shocked at how overpriced it all was. This is definately for the yuppie set that doesn't mind spending $ on mediocre food.

name: Customer_3960
comments: Looks, from the street, like it would be good, but it was just okay. Our waitress pretty much forgot about us the entire time we were there. Not sure what that was all about. We tried practicing mindfulness to make the time pass while we were waiting for her to come back out and take our order. My nachos were disappointing--basically felt like a slice of cheese was melted over chips with globs of black beans. The kale salad was a warm mound of wilted kale mixed with parm cheese. My son liked his burger, so that was good.

name: Customer_5352
comments:
I've been to Tavern three times, and each time this "happy hour" (quotes due to the fact that actual happy hour is only on Wednesdays) location was chosen by or because of guy friends. Why do men love this place?? Maybe it's the industrial concrete or the weird chains on the wall? 

Anyway, the food really is good - I recommend the nachos, guac or lobster hushpuppies, just don't be shocked when you get your pricey check at the end of the night. The drinks are only reasonably priced if you go on 2-4-1 Wednesday - unless you follow the lead of the d-bag at our table last night and walk out on your check. 

If you're going with a large group make sure you get there early since they don't take reservations or let you call ahead. They also charge a $15 cake fee if you bring a dessert on a special occasion, even though they have no desserts on the menu. 

It's not a bad place - it's in a good location, has good food and a cool vibe, I just prefer something a little cheaper and more low key.
If you share my preference for a midtown happy hour, allow me to suggest Brewhouse or Corner Pub instead.

name: Customer_9371
comments:
I finally got to come and experience brunch here! Which is easier said than done. I've attempted to come before and the wait was around 1.5-2 hours. 
On Sunday we came around 1115 for a 45 minute wait which wasn't bad for a group of 5. 
It's two for ones for Sunday brunch and I tried the sangria and the blood orange mimosa. I preferred the sangria hands down!
For food I ordered the huevos rancheros which was pretty good. My gf ordered the Singapore stiryfry and the white trash hash and I liked her stir fry a lot!
I will be back for sure because I keep hearing how good the tavern burger is and I won't make the mistake of not ordering it next time! 
Awesome atmosphere with a brunch of tvs. Can be a little loud though.

name: Customer_4559
comments: The 45 minute wait was well worth it, especially since you have drinks while you wait! The staff here at Tavern were super attentive and really helpful in giving suggestions on what to order. We got the maple fondue and it was incredible, you got to try a little bit of everything. The red velvet waffles were out of this world, the blueberry cornmeal waffles were a slam dunk, the Frosted Flakes crusted French toast was life changing. The sausages were great, the chicken was very spicy but overall great and the fruit was super fresh and sweet. The eggs benedict were really good but very large. All in all I would come back again in a heartbeat!! WE LOVE TAVERN BRUNCH

name: Customer_4507
comments: I usually love this place, but stopped in tonight to place a take out order, and the hostess shewed me off to the absolutely PACKED bar, to try to hail a bartender, on my own, to place an order. This is seriously how you are doing business? We walked out... Ridiculous...

name: Customer_9850
comments: First night in Nashville, after a long car ride, ready to get a taste of that night life!! Great place to start. Food: Started with the SHISHITO PEPPERS, def glad I did. These are perfectly charred. Cooked well, so that they are still a little crisp and not soggy. Lightly salted. Greatest part, they give a little pile of sea salt on the side, so you can season to your liking!! Be careful with these. Some of the peppers have a super spicy kick. BUFFALO CAULIFLOWER was another starter. This app was a bit too sour for me. The tanginess was pretty potent that I could not focus on any other flavors. Also, the exterior of the cauliflower was not that crispy. More on the soggier side. Not a fan. Pass on this. TURKEY BLT was a good choice. The pretzel bread was nice and chewy. Lovely choice of bread for this sammy. Wonderfully smoked turkey with crispy bacon. Comes together beautifully with the smooth gruyere cheese, and the creamy avocado aioli. Great textures and tastes that really comes together in this sammy. I got it with the Tuscan tavern fries. Nice and crunchy fries. Def try. SMORES on the tabletop. Even comes with a small campfire. Classic fix'ns for smores: graham crackers, marshmellows, and chocolate bar. In addition, some strawberries and reese's peanut butter cups. Was quite the indoor smores experience. Service: Drinks were full, food got to the table fresh and hot, server was attentive, and table was cleared away promptly. All together, I think it was a good experince. Ambiance: Very casual. Rustic and slightly romantic. Nice for a girls gathering, as well as date night. Dranks: Great selection of beers, wines, and specialty cocktails. A little something for everyone. I had wine that night, but def would like to go back and try one of their cocktails. Overall: A place that I would like to visit again. Food was good. Drinks were good. This is a place that you can go, no pressure, find something to eat, and get your drink on. Enjoy!!

name: Customer_8586
comments: Great place to watch sports and try the good food selection. Brunch is great on the weekend and have something special always. Just get ready for the line so my ght as well get a spot on the bar or wait forever.

name: Customer_9161
comments: The next day we had burgers at Tavern. We really enjoyed the house cheese burger, cooked medium rare just as ordered, flavor filled and juicy. The fish tacos were good, but lacking somewhat in flavor. We has a draft Blackstone Fancy Boy and a draft Muchaco. Good service also.

name: Customer_5038
comments: Oh wow. Yummiest! Sweet potato chips with warm blue cheese sauce. Awesome. Two for one drink special til 10 pm. Perfect. Philly cheese steak egg rolls that were to die for. Great night out. Probably too cool of a place for this old gal. I wish I was hungrier.

name: Customer_9502
comments: Terrible wait (unnecessary), average service, above average prices, and excruciating wait for food. Find someplace else. There's lots to choose from.

name: Customer_1889
comments:
Good: The food was fantastic. We had a large group (10+) and came here for brunch (and drinks, natch). I had the eggs benedict with short ribs, and loved it. From what I can tell, the rest of the group all enjoyed their dishes as well, from the fried rice breakfast dish to the nachos to the AMAZING peanut butter pancakes. As a starter/side, do not under any circumstances pass up on the "white trash hash" - hasbrowns with white cheddar cheese. YUM.

Bad: The wait was ludicrous. Yes, it was a Saturday, and yes, we had a large group, but Christ Almighty. We waited at the bar (standing room only) for over two hours before being seated. Even if we had split into smaller groups, without a reservation, the wait time would've still been close to an hour and a half. Yikes.

name: Customer_8628
comments: I went to Tavern on a Saturday night and waited about 20 minutes for our table for 2, which really is pretty good! We ordered a few plates to share- egg rolls, fish tacos and Tuscan fries. The egg rolls were served with queso and salsa... for a Chinese food... that was weird. When I've had garlic Parmesan fries in the past, they're usually served with a dipping sauce of some kind,  but these were not. We were given a heaping serving of them that 2 of us couldn't finish though. The fish tacos were by far the best dish we had- HIGHLY recommend them! Our waitress was very nice, though it took her quite a few minutes to actually come over to us initially to take drink orders. Other than that she was wonderful. We each ordered a cocktail and they were strong for sure- I was just unimpressed with both. The julep was decent. The second drink was a grapefruit/lemon lime/ vodka drink that tasted like I drank straight grapefruit juice instead of a mixed drink... to be fair, the waitress did ask if I wanted it remade. The ambiance was great, and it was definitely crowded. They had a DJ playing music and it was a younger crowd.

name: Customer_7098
comments: This place is amazing! In every way! Great location, great ambiance & atmosphere. The people there, especially our bartender Sarah, were super nice and helpful. She was great! But.... the food. Oh wow the food. Best burger I've ever had ever! If they ask you if you want to upgrade your fries to he seasoned ones (for a mere 50¢) say YES YES YES. Those things are sprinkled with crack, I swear. So good. And the garlic aioli is no joke. The beer list is awesome. Lots of local options. And 2-4-1's on Wednesdays of things like Jack Daniels, other liquors, wine, and some mixed drinks (libations). great place! We'll be back every time we're in Nashville.

name: Customer_1997
comments: I used to go to tavern pretty frequently over the past few years and was SHOCKED at the experience last night. A friend and I ordered the bazooka toast - described as "bazooka guacamole/bread/smoked salmon/fried egg/arugula" for a hefty $16! When we got our food we were floored... one piece of bread covered in a sort of smoked salmon spread... a far cry from the fresh slices of smoked salmon that one would expect from that description. Really disappointing, it looked and smelled like canned salmon or cat food? Really weird ...it should be described differently on the menu!

name: Customer_4871

name: Customer_3670
comments: Burger was great. Cooked perfectly, but nothing special. Packed for brunch specials. Seem to have awesome election of cocktails and awesome bartenders. Was there for food, don't really drink. Def would go back. Atmosphere was great too.

name: Customer_9378
comments: Burger was amazing. So juicy, cooked to perfection - ordered it medium rare, and it was! Fries was deliciuos as well. thank you!

name: Customer_2354
comments: Came here during a recent trip to Nashville. Came here a couple years ago for brunch which was amazing but a super long wait so beware. Didn't realize when I picked this place this time that they also do a 2 for 1 drink special from 2-10pm on Wednesday nights. This is a great deal but makes the night a lot busier. I was with an older group of people so they personally didn't like how much noise was going on in the restaurant. In terms of food I do feel like it's a little overpriced for what you get. But I will say the mahi-mahi tacos were tasty. I would definitely come back on future trips to Nashville. And if they take reservations I will do that instead.

name: Customer_3472
comments: Oldie but goodie. Still my favorite place for brunch. With an extensive menu of delishous food & 2-for-1s, a table is well worth the wait. Grab a drink @ the bar or stroll around Midtown; one of their gracious hostesses will send you a text when they are ready to seat you! My go-tos: tavern nachos w/ angry chicken, sweet potato fries & kale salad.

name: Customer_8542
comments: We stumbled onto this restaurant after seeing the very long line at Hattie B's. The atmosphere seemed really nice and the wait for a table much more manageable-only 10 minutes. The menu choices were appealing and we put in an order for two burgers, fries, a fish sandwich and trail salad.  Then we waited, and waited and waited some more.  Fifty minutes later our food still did not arrive with no real explanation (or apology) from our server.  The manager was pleasant and after she was alerted our food did arrive. The burgers were tasty as were the Belgian fries. The trail mix salad had too many dried cranberries for my liking making it much too sweet.  I think with a different server the experience may have been more positive, but with so many great restaurants in Nashville I won't be going back to find out.

name: Customer_2462
comments: My husband and I are visiting Nashville from Chicago (go cubs). We have been to tavern once before last year and my husband fell in love with the  chickenooga drink. So in love that tavern was our first stop back in town. Well, one chickenooga into the night and there was an issue with the keg equipment making this drink unavailable. The manager soon came over with a substitute option replacing the beer. They very well could have just said "too bad" but went way above and beyond and made my husband content. Great food too but the service is well above the rest!

name: Customer_2981
comments: Chose Tavern because I wanted to catch a baseball game on their TVs while eating. The wait for a table of four was an hour on a Saturday night. Food was fine but nothing to jump up and down about. Waitress recommended the Tavern burger...it was ok.

name: Customer_8068
comments: I used to go to tavern pretty frequently over the past few years and was SHOCKED at the experience last night. A friend and I ordered the bazooka toast - described as "bazooka guacamole/bread/smoked salmon/fried egg/arugula" for a hefty $16! When we got our food we were floored... one piece of bread covered in a sort of smoked salmon spread... a far cry from the fresh slices of smoked salmon that one would expect from that description.
