We started off with the cauliflower buffalo bites and steak and cheese egg rolls. The cauliflower bites were kind of soggy/a little overdone. The cheese steak egg rolls were nothing to write home about either. They were served up with what tasted like a hunts ketchup dip and a cheese dip straight out of a jar.
I ordered the turkey BLT and asked for an extra side of the avocado aioli. The aioli did not taste like avocado. The turkey BLT should just be called a turkey sandwich because BLTs should contain a decent amount of bacon and lettuce. My sandwich came with a sliver of bacon and even less lettuce. It was stacked with turkey but it needed way more lettuce to help freshen it up. It was served with sweet potato chips that were soaked in oil. 1/4 were edible and the rest were to drenched in oil to even think about eating. I don't know why our food took so long. For sure they weren't back there frying up fresh chips for me.

name: Customer_5338
comments:
First time back to Nashville since I was in high school, and can't believe I haven't been back sooner! Here at Vanderbilt for a class, and kept passing by the Tavern on my way to campus each morning... Had an inticing, rustic, downtown Manhattan look to it. So I put it on my list of places to check out. I looked here in Yelp, and saw it had great reviews. 

I came in for dinner tonight, and immediately noticed the reclaimed wood door, wrought iron, and alternative rock playing. I knew it would be a great place. I sat at the bar, as I was here by myself, and immediately got a menu and was offered a drink. I had the 1920, which was a little stout, but better than weak, am I right? I ordered the lamb tacos, Tennessee tavern fries, and cinnamon roll bread pudding. Tacos were small, but honestly a decent portion considering how much meat was on them. They were hot out of the kitchen, and the roasted peanuts gave it great crunch. Now, the Tennessee tavern fries ... Sweet potato fries with a touch of cinnamon and sugar, with jalapeño ketchup. Shut the front door, these were to die for. Light and airy, arrived in a mini frying basket with abundant portions. The ketchup was amazing, and I definitely asked for more. The cinnamon roll bread  pudding was a muffin size portion, with vanilla ice cream, homemade whip, and caramel sauce. Great flavor, not overwhelming. 

Service was fantastic, and even met some fun people! Highly recommend this place. I'll be coming back for sure.

name: Customer_8418
comments: Cute restaurant and great location. Service was poor. Waitress took 15 minutes to greet us and get our drink orders. Would have been okay, but she had slight attitude the rest of the night and made us seem more like a burden. Food was good. Not great, but good! Also, it was uncomfortably chilly, so bring a jacket.

name: Customer_1296
comments: Came for brunch on Fathers Day, packed!  We were able to get a spot at the bar right away and ate there. Food was above average and the bartenders were quick and attentive.

name: Customer_5577
comments: This was our first stop in Nashville. The brunch drinks were 2 for 1 (probably because the average wait time on a sat morning is 2 hours). We waited at the bar and had some of the most delicious brunch cocktails! The white trash hash and red velvet waffle were well worth the 2 hour wait! When in Nashville this is a MUST!

name: Customer_9160
comments: Drinks were strong! Guacamole and fries were excellent. Beef short rib tacos were like chewing on a tire. Mahi sandwich was overcooked and super fishy. Tried this place a few years ago, never came back but thought we would give it another shot. Probably won't be back, maybe for guacamole and fries. Our server was awesome though.

name: Customer_8421
comments: tavern is above average and the american food is pretty good here. I like the ambiance and the TV in the restaurant. The drinks are good as well. It's in a neat area that is right next to bars and the division places

name: Customer_1055
comments: We went here for dinner last night with our Yelp Elite spring break friends and the food was great. I ordered a burger medium well with white cheddar, and I substituted for the Tennessee sweet potato fries with the garlic aioli which were fantastic. My friend got a Jalapeño-infused strawberry margarita, which was yummy, as well as the chimichangas, which were also very good. The chimichangas were soft, rather than deep fried, which was interesting. I will say that they don't do any happy hour specials here, which was disappointing. I got an angry orchard cider in a can, which I had never seen before because usually I get bottles, and it was $5.50 which is a little expensive. Food was great though like I said, and food prices were reasonable.

name: Customer_1747
comments: Maybe they gave a great brunch? I had their burger for dinner it was not very good dry with little flavor. Fries were greasy. The service was nice. Valet parking.

name: Customer_5933
comments: Great brunch and cocktails! The Nooner, Roasted Peppers and Squash, and Blueberry Waffles were great. Very good Bloody Mary, red sangria, and signature craft cocktails.

name: Customer_7402
comments: Best place within walking distance from my hotel. It's a pretty modern and happening place, with a cool feel to it. I really was looking for a good salad, and was pleasantly surprised with my Junk Salad (romaine, salami, shrimp, olives, pepperoncini, hearts of palm, grape tomato, cucumber, blue cheese, champagne dijon vinaigrette). This was a super tasty salad. I came back 4 days later and had the burger and sweet potato ships. Burger was pretty good, and my only complaint was that the chips were a little on the salty side. Brush some of the salt off and it was good.

name: Customer_8940
comments: The kale salad is excellent. The rest of the food was ok. Far too expensive I'd you ask me for the sports bar type atmosphere, mediocre food and almost bad cocktail. The waitress come by and asked us if we liked the food about 14 times in our hour dinner and took our plates away the second we finished it which I thought was way too aggressive.

name: Customer_8253
comments: Go for the buffalo cauliflower! What better combination could you ask for?! The drinks also are delicious. The space is large and draws a mix after work - a great place for happy hour.

name: Customer_8760
comments: Where should I start... Oh yeah, I love this place! Went for the first time this weekend and all the things I've heard about this place are true. Great food, amazing outdoor patios and a great variety of drinks. We started out with the Lobster Hushpuppies and Bazooka Guacamole. The presentation was modern and they most definitely delivered on taste, the only issue I had, was I wanted to order more appetizers! After some self restraint we order our entrees; I took the servers recommendation and had the burger and everybody else had the BLT. Looking back I wish I would have tried something new, don't get me wrong it was good but there are some amazing sounding dishes on the menu. Next time I guess. All in all if you are looking for a trendy spot to have a bite and a few drinks, I definitely recommend this place! Oh yeah, I almost forgot use the hot sauce!

name: Customer_8692
comments: We wanted to check this place out after seeing the great reviews. Arrived on Thursday (New Years Day) around noon and the place was packed with a hour and a half wait. We put our name in and went next door for a drink, The restraunt texted us when our table was ready and also had a cool app that you can check your place in line. Only had drinks and a few apps. The tuscan fries were good but had a LOT of garlic. My friend loved her Kale salad. If you like a bloody mary, try the cucumber mary made with cucumber vodka. It was unbelievable. This was hands down out favorite place in Nashville and this place had the BEST servise we got our whole trip. A+ to the staff. We were really really impressed. We went back on Friday night around 1am and it was pretty empty. The guy sitting next to us said its really a better brunch or Sunday Funday bar and not busy at night.

name: Customer_2979
comments: Overall: I've only been for brunch and was happy with it soo... nice place to relax and have a little hangover cure on a Saturday or Sunday morning. Food/Drinks: There are LOTS of brunch options. The Singapore stir fry was great, though it appeared the eggs had been sitting under a heat light for a little while. Still, it was flavorful and not something I've seen anywhere else. I was less impressed with the red velvet waffles. They were extremely dense, and pretty much just tasted like pink waffles. Not bad, just not like red velvet. Be sure to order them with a side of maple syrup, it helps with the density factor. There are a handful of 2fer drink options on the very top of the menu and while they are expensive ($10.50,) from what I've tasted, they're pretty good (and strong.) Go for the blood orange mimosa. Service/Atmosphere: Our waitress started out being extremely attentive and knowledgeable but kind of dropped off as the meal progressed. That would be understandable if the restaurant had gotten busier but it hadn't. Anyway, she was still nice so I won't complain anymore. The restaurant is very open but seems smaller than when it was under its old name (Lime.) I do like the big open bar, though. Price: About $40 for 2 people to eat & get a drink a piece for brunch (not including tip)

name: Customer_7495
comments: Nice little cozy spot. Atmosphere is casual and classy. I had the chicken skewers with rice. It was very tasty and light. Also had a margarita that was fantastic! I only like fresh margaritas and this one passed the test. Recommend checking it out.

name: Customer_5303
comments: Another Yelper hit it -- this is a noisy, crowded restaurant with big screen TVs.  I wouldn't call it a sports bar.  Nothing wrong with the place.  Cool location, good beer selection.  The food - delicious, but eliminates itself as a "sports bar". My sons and I wanted to catch some pub grub and the hockey game.  Got the game.  The grub-- eclectic.  Do go here if you want a busy, bustling, energetic, tasty, flavorful, thumping music-beat experience.  Don't go here if you want  a burger, a beer and a hockey game amidst sports conversation.

name: Customer_6670
comments: Delicious! I had a burger and my wife got the eggs with short ribs, both of which we loved. For dessert we had an orange float, which we also quite enjoyed. The servise was excellent, and the food was really quite cheap. Definitely worth a visit!

name: Customer_6530
comments:
This may seem like a standard American burger joint, but they actually have taken pains to create a thoughtful and surprising menu. 

There are options ranging from middle eastern to Mediterranean to Indian to new American and I had a sampling of them all. Everything had a distinct flavor profile, regardless of whether I liked it, and the burger was one of the best I've had in Nashville. Oh, and for dessert you can roast your own marshmallows at the table. 

Service wasn't the greatest, but not terrible as other reviews have noted and overall this is a spot I'd recommend.

name: Customer_8844
comments: Maybe they gave a great brunch? I had their burger for dinner it was not very good dry with little flavor. Fries were greasy. The service was nice. Valet parking.

name: Customer_9057
comments: Decided to try this place after our Airbnb host recommended it. Total miss! Way too overpriced for what we got. We ordered guacamole because they were out of cauliflower. The guacamole was too plain, lacking salt and spice. The size was ridiculously small and disproportional to the amount of chips you get with it. We also had chicken skewers, that were described as "sesame, garlic, ginger...". It literally tasted like chicken with some super sweet teriyaki sauce. The rice with it was totally plain too. We had kale salad with ahi tuna. Also was lacking taste, and the size of kale and tuna was disproportional. Not worth the money at all.

name: Customer_5995
comments: Tavern has a great brunch situation if you are looking to have drinks. 2 for 1 mimosas, bellinis, bloody Mary's and sangria make for a great start to the day. Brunch can get very packed during peak hours so you want to get there early on Saturdays and Sundays.

name: Customer_2175
comments:
Tavern has Nashville's best burger. I was sad when it was gone. Fantastic.

The staff is friendly, and the service is great. They even brought our group free s'mores. (That's right: They have s'mores.)

I have a new favorite Nashville restaurant.

name: Customer_5699
comments:
I was so disappointed that my 2nd Tavern experience wasn't as flawless as my first one. I'm only giving it 3 stars due to the service we received from the manager and because most of the food was still good. 

I met 3 friends for a late Saturday brunch, 2 of which had never been there before. I was excited to introduce them to Tavern's fabulousness but left feeling a little embarrassed after the service we received. 

For starters, it took about 20 minutes before our server even acknowledged us. I asked about drink specials and as soon as the last word came out of her mouth she walked away leaving me unable to order a drink. About 10 minutes later she finally came back. After ordering drinks it took another 10 minutes to get them. We were ready to order our meals (had been for about 30 minutes) but again, she walked away before we could do so. Instead, she sauntered on over to the bar and proceeded to talk and flirt with some guy at the bar for over 20 minutes. We timed it. At that point we were so disgusted that we stopped another server walking by and asked if we could order with her. She was happy to help us. My 3 friends ordered the Tavern burger and they all liked it. I opted for a ham and brie omelette and it was kind of meh. I remembered I don't like brie (my fault for ordering it) and I had to pick it all out. The omelette was lacking flavor anyway. I should have at least salt and peppered it myself, I guess. The side of white trash hash was very tasty but an extremely small serving. Only about 5 bites. Because of our shitty server we were never offered to order a second round of drinks and it was past happy hour since of course we had been sitting at the table for almost 2 hours at that point. Dirty dishes sat on our table for 30 minutes while we waited for our checks. During our 2 hours at the table our server only came around 3 times. Very disappointing. 

With the exception of the burgers my friends had, the dining experience was pretty terrible. We ended up speaking with Madeline, the manager, about our experience. She was very nice and seemed to sincerely care about what we had to say. She ended up comping our entire meal and gave us some coupons to come back and try brunch again. However, while we were speaking with Madeline the server in question was whispering and giggling with a busboy and staring at our table. Our point of "complaining" was truly not to get anything free, but to let these little brats know that people aren't just going to stand by and let them slack on their job while they run around and socialize. We ended up tipping the server who actually took our order. 

I'm hoping this horrible experience was just a fluke because I really like Tavern and want to continue coming back.

name: Customer_6141
comments:
Let's start off with positives, on a Saturday night around 8pm we didn't have a wait and the restaurant looked very nice an upscale sports bar basically. The service was good and the server was very attentive until the end when we wanted our check.

I ordered the fish tacos. The tacos were extremely small and did not have a lot of fish or anything else. We ordered the buffalo cauliflower which was very good. We also ordered the chicken skewers which tasted average but once again a smaller portion. Somebody else at the table ordered the Tavern burger which looked really good (even though they forgot the bacon), she said it was delicious.

name: Customer_2191
comments: Tavern has a great brunch situation if you are looking to have drinks. 2 for 1 mimosas, bellinis, bloody Mary's and sangria make for a great start to the day. Brunch can get very packed during peak hours so you want to get there early on Saturdays and Sundays.

name: Customer_5385
comments:
Not my kind of place but I think if it was it would be fantastic! 
Loud music, sports on big TV s, huge bar, inside or outside seating. Friendly attentive staff, food artsy. Served lightning fast. Very clean and beautifully decorated. Enjoyed my Burger very much. Micheal loved his Junk Salad... Great place for those who like what I described.

name: Customer_2496
comments: *** BUFFALO CAULIFLOWER *** Need I say more? : ) Friendly staff. Fun atmosphere. Trendy but casual at the same time... ooo and the outdoor patio is a must when the weather is nice.

name: Customer_9137
comments: I have never been so insulted and talked down to in my life. Michelle, I think that's her name it's on my receipt but she never introduced herself, was the rudest person I have ever given my money to in my life. When we sat down she was talking about personal issues with the barback loud enough for us to hear and I thought that was odd in and off itself. When she gave us our menus she said a few times "these menus are good for the next 30 seconds."  Sorry but either give us brunch or give us dinner menus and explain that the kitchen is in the midst of a shift change, don't make us feel pressured because you dropped menus that have an extremely short time limit. Instead of eating we decided to just get drinks. She let us know that the brunch menu libations were, her words, 2 for 1. We ordered a mimosa off the list and hung out. When we got get drinks they set two wooden tokens down but didn't reference the at all, so we didn't know what they were for.  Eventually ordered some food off the dinner menu to go. She was very non existent the whole time we were sitting at the bar, not attentive at all. When we asked for the bill I saw that both our drinks were on there. I asked about them and let her know about the 2 for 1 statement she said. She then proceeded to tell me it was buy one, get one and that's what the tokens are for. I told her that "buy one get one" and "2 for 1" are different and if we knew it was BOGO we would have ordered another drink (if she would have even paid attention to us).  After a little back and forth she said she would take care of it and that "they weren't trying to screw us."  She talked to us like we were the worst people on earth because she doesn't know how to explain her own restaurants policies. I work in an industry that has me visiting 10-15 bars/restaurants/hotels a day and I have never had a worse hospitality experience in my life. Tavern Management - this employee is losing you revenue left and right.  Not only is she not taking care of customers and grabbing reorders, she is turning people away for good. This treatment was so horrible and off putting that I am going to go out of my way to recommended against going to Tavern due to the disrespect we felt. Hopefully your floor managers recognize how bad she is and theyo do something about it because she is taking money out of your pocket every shift she works.

name: Customer_9128
comments: Came in for lunch while in Nashville in business. The waitress sold me on their Bloody Mary, so I ordered that and the lettuce wraps. The bloody was ridiculously watered down. It tasted watered down and looked like the glass was about 85% water/ice. When I commented on the look and taste, the waitress proceeded to tell me that if it looked watered down, there was probably extra vodka in it, which I couldn't taste because it was "infused" which cuts down on the vodka taste. What a load of BS. It was one of the most disappointing bloodies I've had. I should have sent it back, but she was adamant that I was wrong. Lettuce wraps had a nice spicy kick, which I liked, but it failed to redeem the dry, canned-tasting chicken. Very. Under-impressed.

name: Customer_4991
comments: Decided to try this place after our Airbnb host recommended it. Total miss! Way too overpriced for what we got. We ordered guacamole because they were out of cauliflower. The guacamole was too plain, lacking salt and spice. The size was ridiculously small and disproportional to the amount of chips you get with it. We also had chicken skewers, that were described as "sesame, garlic, ginger...". It literally tasted like chicken with some super sweet teriyaki sauce. The rice with it was totally plain too. We had kale salad with ahi tuna. Also was lacking taste, and the size of kale and tuna was disproportional. Not worth the money at all.

name: Customer_8436
comments: I really enjoyed this place. Very interesting menu, great drink selection, loved the decor/ambience and our kiwi bartender was great. I will definitely come back next time I am in town.

name: Customer_4790
comments: Our food was pretty. The resturant is decorated really nice and lots of seating. We got the mussels appetizer which was amazing! I got a wedge salad and my husband got the bbq ribs tacos. I liked talking to the server Zack, he was really nice and a good server. I would go back there just for the mussels!!

name: Customer_1463
comments: This place was AMAZING! I found it on yelp and saw the reviews, knew my dad and I had to check it out. We immediately got a killer spot at the bar and was greeted by the nicest bartender we've come across in Nashville this far. I had some white wine and my dad had beer on tap. We split (demolished) the nachos- I highly recommend adding chicken!! I could have ordered everything else on the menu but the nachos were super filling. Very hip place, highly recommend

name: Customer_4886
comments:
Tavern is great for brunch, lunch or dinner. The atmosphere is casual, yet classy, with dim lighting as well as some natural light above the bar and in the front room of the restaurant. There are TVs for watching sports as well. In the Midtown area of downtown, this M Street restaurant has a nice bar and cozy half-moon booths. There is also a street-side patio (with very uncomfortable, wrought iron circle tables that do not fit well with the permanent wood bench) and valet parking.

For brunch, the white trash hash is a must with any dish. The cheddar cheese biscuits with chorizo gravy and turkey BLT were great savory dishes, but I have heard amazing things about the red velvet waffles.

For lunch and dinner, don't go with the grilled cheese. The menu has so much more to offer, and it's not the greatest grilled cheese I've ever had. The guacamole was a small serving, but fresh and with great flavor. The sweet potato chips with blue cheese fondue is to die for! I'm not a huge blue cheese fan, but this is the best cheese dip/fondue I've ever had! The chips are served fresh and warm. The mussels are also amazing, with bacon adding a unique taste. 

As for drinks, the strawberry balsamic martini is my favorite drink (on their menu and in the world).  Its sweet, with a small kick from the balsamic. Their whiskey drinks are strong and the berry julep is a good choice.

Overall, this is a great restaurant for any occasion from a business lunch to a hungover Sunday brunch. Be aware, they do NOT take reservations, which can be very frustrating, but the wait is worth it.

name: Customer_7262
comments: Only had drinks here, but it was great! They have a two for one happy hour from 2pm until 10pm. The bartender was super friendly and made a great drink!

name: Customer_6766
comments: Everything is wonderful at The Tavern!!!!. The servise is outstanding. The seafood choices are plentiful. The skillet bread is so so good! I love the portion size..just right. The Chocolate chip cookie skillet dessert is super super delicious! We have gone on a Sunday night a few times a it's semi- quiet and it's a delightful Sunday meal.

name: Customer_1019
comments: Y'all gave my Asian friend and my white friend some food poisoning from the Caesar salad. Thanks Obama.

name: Customer_8131
comments:
Best place within walking distance from my hotel.  It's a pretty modern and happening place, with a cool feel to it.

I really was looking for a good salad, and was pleasantly surprised with my Junk Salad (romaine, salami, shrimp, olives, pepperoncini, hearts of palm, grape tomato, cucumber, blue cheese, champagne dijon vinaigrette).  This was a super tasty salad.

I came back 4 days later and had the burger and sweet potato ships.  Burger was pretty good, and my only complaint was that the chips were a little on the salty side.  Brush some of the salt off and it was good.

name: Customer_2458
comments: This place was AMAZING! I found it on yelp and saw the reviews, knew my dad and I had to check it out. We immediately got a killer spot at the bar and was greeted by the nicest bartender we've come across in Nashville this far. I had some white wine and my dad had beer on tap. We split (demolished) the nachos- I highly recommend adding chicken!! I could have ordered everything else on the menu but the nachos were super filling. Very hip place, highly recommend

name: Customer_5209
comments:
What I liked:
1. White Trash Hash- With a name like that, what's there not to like?  While I'm sure I could re-create this for about $2 (smashed fried hashbrowns smothered in cheese), it was well worth the extra cost to enjoy at brunch.  YUM!
2. Brunch Menu- There were too many delicious options to choose.  I went with a salad, but everything (especially the burger and french toast) looked and smelled fantastic.
3. Bloody Marys- They served my favorite, Zig-Zag mix and you get 2 for the price they charge.

What I didn't like:
1. This place gets VERY crowded on the weekend during the brunch rush.  We were quoted at hour+ wait shortly after they opened and ended up just snagging a seat at the bar.
2. Service- The bartender was understaffed and a bit slow to respond to requests.  They also forgot about part of our order and had to be reminded.

Overall Verdict: Make a reservation or show-up early and prepare to wait.  Get the white trash hash and enjoy delicious brunch!

name: Customer_4614
comments: The Tavern have the best burgers and the service was great. Atmosphere was nice and family friendly. I will definitely be back if I visit Nashville again.

name: Customer_6867
comments:
This place is awesome!  We stumbled upon it after checking into our hotel...we wanted to walk around after being in the car for 9 hours and we were starving.  We got a table outside, it was loud, but what do you expect on a Friday night in early summer?
The food was great....I got the Nuevo Israeli bread salad and my husband got the turkey blt (with sweet potato chips (YUMMMM)--both fantastic.  
They have an extensive drink/beer list and the staff is knowledgeable about the beer they serve and didn't steer my husband wrong.  
Would recommend trying this place out if you haven't already.

name: Customer_7077
comments: Burger was great. Cooked perfectly, but nothing special. Packed for brunch specials. Seem to have awesome election of cocktails and awesome bartenders. Was there for food, don't really drink. Def would go back. Atmosphere was great too.

name: Customer_8580
comments: The kale salad is excellent. The rest of the food was ok. Far too expensive I'd you ask me for the sports bar type atmosphere, mediocre food and almost bad cocktail. The waitress come by and asked us if we liked the food about 14 times in our hour dinner and took our plates away the second we finished it which I thought was way too aggressive.

name: Customer_6144
comments: The atmosphere is very clean, modern, and slightly upscale. They offer a brunch and a large selection of drinks. They are very packed for brunch though. Their brunch runs pretty late. I got there around 2pm and they said brunch was ending soon. Their brunch menu items cost around $10 each. Their normal dinner menu gets a little pricier, but you don't have to spend a lot of money here.

name: Customer_5615
comments:
3 stars for food and a 1/2 star for ambience/drink specials. Went here with a bunch of friends on a Wednesday night. The place was busy! They said our wait was about 30 min so we decided to go to the bar. 2 for 1 drink special!! Excellent! The drinks were pretty big and strong so it was a great deal. I got the tequila drink with blackberry and agave juice (can't remember the name). It was good!! We sat on the outdoor patio with our drinks while we waited for our name...it was perfect! 

The food was mehhh...I had the lamb tacos which were just ok. I felt like they needed to be more exciting...there was barely anything on them. I ordered 3 because I was pretty hungry, and it was the perfect size. My friend who got the burger loved it, so maybe I just had to order something else. Who knows. Overall I was underwhelmed. I have to eat gluten free (Celiac), and they did have a gluten free menu. It wasn't huge but enough options. However, they did have fried things on the gf menu that are NOT GF!! This is a huge pet peeve of mine...why put it on the gluten free menu if it's not?! So annoying. I would go back to this place for drinks only.

name: Customer_5007
comments:
Had a very pleasant dining experience at Tavern tonight. We arrived at 5 pm and it was pretty dead. It's a big place with a nice outdoor patio and a side patio that can be indoor/outdoor depending on the weather. The vibe seems pretty cool and laid back. Rock music and low lighting get a thumbs up in my book. 

I decided to try a sangria while I browsed over the menu. It did not disappoint. Very fresh and tasty. I decided on The Tavern burger with sweet potato fries. The burger was delicious! It's served on a "meltaway" bun which basically is just a really soft and yummy bun. The sweet potato fries were good as well. Not soggy at all which seems to happen a lot with sweet potato fries. The boyfriend really enjoyed his meal as well but I'll let him tell you about that in his own review. :) Because the dinner was so good, I decided to order a dessert, too. I opted for the cinnamon bread pudding with vanilla gelato on top. It was also delish! It was the perfect amount of sweetness and comfort to end my meal. 

Service was quick and friendly, food was good, and the atmosphere was relaxing. We will definitely be back.

name: Customer_5322
comments: Delicious brunch, fabulous servic! The buy one get one brunch drinks were a plus! It started getting crowded at 11am, so I suggest getting there when they open at 10am!

name: Customer_9735
comments: This place was very modern and chic! Very cool look and feel of the resturant. We only came in for a quick bite to eat and some drinks to start off the night. For a Saturday night around 7pm, it was pretty busy. Definitely a loud place because of all the people, but they played good music. Ambiance is casual but not too dressed down. I wouldn't wear a hoodie and sweats, but dressy casual. Service was good. We had the buffalo cauliflower and it was delicious! Will def be back when I'm in Nashville again!

name: Customer_8299
comments: Evan the doorman was as friendly as his beard is burly. Jenna the hostess got us a table wiki wiki even though the place was packed. Amy our server professed her love for us because we ordered 8 items at once and handed her the menus back. Specialty cocktails were fantastic and the fish tacos were off the charts delicious. Well done, Tavern. Well done.

name: Customer_7763
comments: I visited tavern for lunch looking to try their burger.  I had been told they have one of the best burgers in Nashville.  I thought it was a pretty good burger but I can think of several burgers better in a 5 mile radius.  I will say as a dining venue it is top notch.  Staff was excellent and the layout is very cool.  The menu has several unique items that might bring me back to try like the fried chicken skins...    A tip would be you will probably need to valet since parking is scarce in the area

name: Customer_5987
comments:
Nashville for the weekend--Brunch on Saturday! (July 14, 2012)

First off I LOVE that they have a Saturday brunch.  Avoiding the crowds of Sunday and having yummy brunch food is awesome.  I don't know why we can't have brunch everyday and brunch for dinner menus should exist---but I digress.

DRINKS:
We ordered cocktails (2 for 1!!!!!!): cucumber bloody mary, sangria, and champaign drink.  The sangria was great and I loved the bloody mary---champaign drink was tasty but paled by comparison.  Also--our incredibly awesome server gave the helpful tip that the sangria is the most booze for the buck.  Not really my most important thing to know when ordering a cocktail, but I appreciate that she willingly shared the info.

FOOD: 
Chorizo gravy and cheese biscuits =yummy but very rich!
Singapore stir fry thing =FANTASTIC--watch out for the spice but totally worth the burn
Benedict w/tabasco =don't remember the name.  I am not one for benedicts but my friends both said it was quite good.
Sweet Potato chips with blue cheese dip =super awesome, need to figure out how to make that dip.
White Trash Hash =very yummy

Service was great and we were seated right away.  If I lived in Nashville this place would be in heavy rotation.

name: Customer_3317
comments:
Great staff, service and food!

I ordered the kale salad (OMGosh - good!), short ribs tacos and the fried cauliflower- a MUST - even if you don't finish it all.

name: Customer_9663
comments: First time back to Nashville since I was in high school, and can't believe I haven't been back sooner! Here at Vanderbilt for a class, and kept passing by the Tavern on my way to campus each morning... Had an inticing, rustic, downtown Manhattan look to it. So I put it on my list of places to check out. I looked here in Yelp, and saw it had great reviews. I came in for dinner tonight, and immediately noticed the reclaimed wood door, wrought iron, and alternative rock playing. I knew it would be a great place. I sat at the bar, as I was here by myself, and immediately got a menu and was offered a drink. I had the 1920, which was a little stout, but better than weak, am I right? I ordered the lamb tacos, Tennessee tavern fries, and cinnamon roll bread pudding. Tacos were small, but honestly a decent portion considering how much meat was on them. They were hot out of the kitchen, and the roasted peanuts gave it great crunch. Now, the Tennessee tavern fries ... Sweet potato fries with a touch of cinnamon and sugar, with jalapeño ketchup. Shut the front door, these were to die for. Light and airy, arrived in a mini frying basket with abundant portions. The ketchup was amazing, and I definitely asked for more. The cinnamon roll bread pudding was a muffin size portion, with vanilla ice cream, homemade whip, and caramel sauce. Great flavor, not overwhelming. Service was fantastic, and even met some fun people! Highly recommend this place. I'll be coming back for sure.

name: Customer_8722
comments: I've been here twice now, and the food is always great and the service is decent. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the food takes a while to come out, even when it's not super busy. I've gotten the fish tacos (they are HUGE), burgers, fries (also huge portions), and goat cheese and pistachio guacamole. Like I said, the food is always very good, but if you're coming on a weekend, be prepared for a very long wait. It has a super hip atmosphere and you'll find a lot of twenty-somethings there.

name: Customer_7355
comments: Truly not worth the wait. I've tried a couple dishes and nothing has been great- wouldn't really recommend. Almost everything I have tried has either been too dry or too salty. The ambiance is nice but it's pretty slow. The only good food item is their fries.

name: Customer_4121
comments: What a fabulous new place to dine! The staff is extremely friendly, the food is creative and they have the BEST burger in town! Not only is the food great, but their use of social media is as well. I sent a tweet out about how great their burger is and received a nice card and gift certificate for my next dining experience. Nicely done, guys!

name: Customer_1306
comments: We went for lunch today. Service was too slow for anyone on a lunch break (it took nearly an hour). There wasn't a lunch menu, so we paid dinner prices for dinner portions. I saw a little section of "fast plates". I forget what it was called, but none of those items really jumped out at me. We ordered fish tacos, beef tacos with Korean BBQ and fries. It was all good. This might be a better place for dinner.

name: Customer_7492
comments:
Honesty hour, we went out in Nashville after 10pm. Apparently, there are limited options at that time, when it isn't the weekend. We decided to try out this place after walking to a couple of other places that were not like their descriptions. 
This place has a nice ambience, nice staff, and a ton of beers and ciders on tap. The prices weren't bad for the drinks or beer. Between 5-8 for the beer/cider. Around 10-12 for cocktails. Oh, and the kitchen closes at 11. 

Now on to the food, we got the burger and the chimichanga. We were splitting them so we went for something a little different with the chimichanga. We also got the cheesesteak egg rolls. Sounds fantastic, right? Unfortunately, the burger was the only highlight. Everything else got a HUGE FAIL! The chimichanga was super soggy. The rice and beans were ok. The cheesesteak egg rolls were just BAD! No taste at all.  

Now on to our drinks. We first ordered their take on a margarita. They used silver
Tequila so it had a very heavy tequila taste. It was ok.  He wound up with the punch. It was ok. Mind you, we were traveling all day and ate everything. So, it was edible. 

All and all, if you need somewhere to go late, then try it. Just  stick to very regular things. The staff is nice ,so, that is worth a visit based on that alone.

name: Customer_6141
comments:
Oh hell yeah!!  Came in for a simple burger and fries.  

Great food! Even better service!  

Will definitely be a stop on any trip to Nashville.

Make sure you try the Tuscany fries!

name: Customer_1821
comments:
Good: The food was fantastic. We had a large group (10+) and came here for brunch (and drinks, natch). I had the eggs benedict with short ribs, and loved it. From what I can tell, the rest of the group all enjoyed their dishes as well, from the fried rice breakfast dish to the nachos to the AMAZING peanut butter pancakes. As a starter/side, do not under any circumstances pass up on the "white trash hash" - hasbrowns with white cheddar cheese. YUM.

Bad: The wait was ludicrous. Yes, it was a Saturday, and yes, we had a large group, but Christ Almighty. We waited at the bar (standing room only) for over two hours before being seated. Even if we had split into smaller groups, without a reservation, the wait time would've still been close to an hour and a half. Yikes.

name: Customer_8631
comments: Good: The food was fantastic. We had a large group (10+) and came here for brunch (and drinks, natch). I had the eggs benedict with short ribs, and loved it. Even if we had split into smaller groups, without a reservation, the wait time would've still been close to an hour and a half. Yikes.

name: Customer_5592
comments:
Overall: I've only been for brunch and was happy with it soo... nice place to relax and have a little hangover cure on a Saturday or Sunday morning.

Food/Drinks: There are LOTS of brunch options. The Singapore stir fry was great, though it appeared the eggs had been sitting under a heat light for a little while. Still, it was flavorful and not something I've seen anywhere else. I was less impressed with the red velvet waffles. They were extremely dense, and pretty much just tasted like pink waffles. Not bad, just not like red velvet. Be sure to order them with a side of maple syrup, it helps with the density factor. There are a handful of 2fer drink options on the very top of the menu and while they are expensive ($10.50,) from what I've tasted, they're pretty good (and strong.) Go for the blood orange mimosa.

Service/Atmosphere: Our waitress started out being extremely attentive and knowledgeable but kind of dropped off as the meal progressed. That would be understandable if the restaurant had gotten busier but it hadn't. Anyway, she was still nice so I won't complain anymore. The restaurant is very open but seems smaller than when it was under its old name (Lime.) I do like the big open bar, though.

Price: About $40 for 2 people to eat & get a drink a piece for brunch (not including tip)

name: Customer_3233
comments: Gastropub delight! I have to stop here every time I come to Nashville for business. I haven't had a single thing from the menu that I did not love. The grilled cheese was amazing, the soup tasty, the drinks... Mmmmmmm. Try the one with agave. The truffle fries are perfect, and be sure to top it all off with s'mores you make at the table. I've enjoyed eating outside, inside, at the bar... and have taken food to go when I didn't have time to relax. The decor is rustic and interesting. Depending on the time of day, it can be a quiet spot to relax or it can get really noisy at happy hour. The one drawback is the prices. A bit on the high side, but okay for someone like me who only does this occasionally for a treat. If you were a local, it might set you back if you became a regular.

name: Customer_4763
comments: I do not unjustly dole out bad reviews, however, i feel it my moral obligation to society to inform the masses of what lies within at tavern... i want to like this place, which took the spot formerly occupied by Lime, but after 3 visits i am left with the same impression: the best thing about this place is it's location/outdoor bar seating.  terrible mixed drinks ... (drink #1: facial toner, drink #2: salad dressing, drink #3: cough syrup)... definitely stick with beer or wine here. the food was ok. i had the turkey sandwich on pretzel bread and sweet potato fries - both were meh (and cold). food was much better when they first opened. sad when standards drop...   (i also had to valet park. then valet disappeared...  my keys ended up behind the bar. that's apparently where they keep them, incase you're looking. or still waiting for your keys.)

name: Customer_8008
comments: Went on a friend's birthday for a birthday dinner and had a very bad experience. A very long wait despite having reservations, and then it took forever just to get a drink from the bar. The food was very, very disappointing--I ordered the lettuce wraps and left hungry. We split a few appetizers, including the crudite/hummus plate--I was just shocked at how overpriced it all was. This is definitely for the yuppie set that doesn't mind spending $ on mediocre food.

name: Customer_1918
comments: From service to taste this restaurant had it all. Their mahi sandwich was cooked and seasoned perfectly. Their drink selection was vast and test

name: Customer_8511
comments: Went on a friend's birthday for a birthday dinner and had a very bad experience. A very long wait despite having reservations, and then it took forever just to get a drink from the bar. name: Customer_3677
comments:
Meh. I don't see how this place got such high marks. 
We started off with the cauliflower buffalo bites and steak and cheese egg rolls. The cauliflower bites were kind of soggy/a little overdone. The cheese steak egg rolls were nothing to write home about either. They were served up with what tasted like a hunts ketchup dip and a cheese dip straight out of a jar.
I ordered the turkey BLT and asked for an extra side of the avocado aioli. The aioli did not taste like avocado. The turkey BLT should just be called a turkey sandwich because BLTs should contain a decent amount of bacon and lettuce. My sandwich came with a sliver of bacon and even less lettuce. It was stacked with turkey but it needed way more lettuce to help freshen it up. It was served with sweet potato chips that were soaked in oil. 1/4 were edible and the rest were to drenched in oil to even think about eating. I don't know why our food took so long. For sure they weren't back there frying up fresh chips for me.

name: Customer_2664
comments: Our first evening in Nashville, we decided to try the Tavern restaurant.  It is quaint and dark.  Davis was our server and he was great and very accommodating.  I had the burger which I'm sad to say, wasn't anything to write home about.  The best part of our meal was the great service we received from Davis.

name: Customer_3524
comments: The atmosphere is very nice. I always am leery of "hipster" spots but this place is legit. Super friendly and not pretentious staff. Female bartender made one of the best Bulleit neat Old Fashioned's I've had out. Other mixed drinks were also prepared well (well balanced without being boozy). I ordered Korean beef tacos. They were not bad but not one of my favorites either. They were still good. The table over got nachos that looked delicious. I also think if a place has a clean bathroom, their kitchen is usually clean too. This place is spotless. I also was impressed to see the bartenders cleaning bottles and the bar in their down time. Overall, I would definitely visit again when I am in town. I'd actually rate this place a 4.5 stars if I could.

name: Customer_3947
comments:
I waited a couple days before rating to try to be fair. This place was recommended and hyped separately to me and my husband in transit and upon arrival to Nashville. We expected a lot. 
The service was great. We sat at the bar, both bartenders and food service were polite and attentive. Drink selection and quality and price seemed good. The food is another story. It is over priced and over hyped by reviewers.
My husband had the OZ pot pie. Even with a healthy dose of the curry sauce, it was dry. And plain, could barely taste the curry. I had korean short rib tacos. Nothing korean about them. I tasted sriracha and soy sauce. Isn't  Korean about gochujang? Meat was dry.  The fries are house cut, plentiful and phenomenal. But the rest of the menu is overpriced ignorance.

name: Customer_5616
comments: Our first evening in Nashville, we decided to try the Tavern restaurant.  It is quaint and dark.  Davis was our server and he was great and very accommodating.  I had the burger which I'm sad to say, wasn't anything to write home about.  The best part of our meal was the great service we received from Davis.

name: Customer_8395
comments: Well, the concept seems cool....but, not great service.  The waitress forgot our drinks - we has finished our appetizer and they had not arrived, so we cancelled them. We tried to order 1 of the 3 late night dinner entrees they offered, but they were all out.  Umm, bummer. We left and I don't think we will be back.

name: Customer_6679
comments: Delicious food in a fun setting. Great helpful and friendly srvice. Two levels of seating near the bar. We had awesome buffalo cauliflower, egg rolls with philly cheese steak and amazing kale salad. highly recomand the Tavern.

name: Customer_2211
comments:
could get to 4 or 5 stars; maybe it was just a slightly off night.  It might be better next time but not sure if i will make it back; lots of other restaurants to try instead.  just disappointed by the execution for a place that has uses the tagline as a pub for chefs on their website.  

we got a drink at the bar; the bartender was very responsive and helpful, drinks were excellent.

ordered food; waitress didn't mention they were out of items until I tried to order them.  Asked for fried chicken skins, they were out.  tried to upsell me to their cauliflower app as a result.  We placed our order, waitress then has to come back and tell me that they are also out of the catfish i just ordered.  i realize places run out of food at times but they went 0 for 2 with my choices and they didn't tell me upfront.  annoying the waitress didn't say this upfront.  

also, this may have been due to being out of items, the waitress never came back and asked how our food was.  the short rib tacos i ordered were cold, my sister's tacos were also cold.  Even more disappointing is that the tacos i ended up buying and not really enjoying were more money than the catfish.  
Everyone else's food was appropriate temp but yeah the waitress never asked so I only get to tell you here.  everyone else's food was good; nothing spectacular but all around solid.  

also I saw other reviews mention drink specials on Sundays?  I went on a Sunday no mention of drink specials was made.  

The bar service, and overall atmosphere keep me from ranking it lower, like I said maybe I just caught them and the waitress on an off night.

name: Customer_4695
comments:
Tavern was in walking distance from our hotel, and we had read it was a good place to watch a game, so we were there! I really liked the feel of this place. It was really modern and even the waitstaff complements the look with their matching grey v-necks. We were famished after a long day and got down on so many dishes! 

-grilled artichokes. promised with a "comeback sauce" which we got to help my friend push ahead past her hangover, it didn't really do that.
-lamb tacos and pork tacos. the lamb tacos were great but nothing could compare to the pork tacos. I have never been more sad to see the end of a taco.
-salad of little gems. hello? little gems describing anything? I'm in! It was a great, little refreshment from my all-meat diet, with cranberries and fresh mozzerella.
-chicken and waffle. The fried chicken was great, but the cheddar and jalepeno waffle was almost too overpowering with the sweey syrup.
-loco moco. too much meat but the rice and egg were just what my friend needed to get back on the drinking horse so props for that!

The drink list was also amazing here, great whiskey cocktails and they make a mean martini as well! I also liked the mix of people here. It was the perfect Friday night crowd. Prices were pretty reasonable, unless, of course, you are posted up watching Michigan beat Kansas in overtime, then the bill might be a bit higher to taste victory ;)

name: Customer_6215
comments: I'm usually a chilaquiles girl, so the Huevos Rancheros sounded sort of tempting with its eggs, tortillas and salsa combination. Now, huevos rancheros in general has never really appealed to me, but Tavern had me changing my tune. I have a feeling that no other restaurant's version of this dish will impress me as much as this one, but if you are in Nashville and you are at Tavern for brunch and you don't get the Huevos Rancheros.... you're making a HUGE mistake. One of the best brunch meals of my life y'all...

name: Customer_7353
comments: Unfortunately they don't take reservations. It was a crazy busy weekend and took about an hour to be seated. Sat on porch behind bar, they had propane heaters so it was plenty warm despite 15 degree weather. Service was very attentive and friendly. Food was great. Shasito peppers were perfect. Cauliflower was good and smoking hot spicy. Glad we waited.

name: Customer_7266
comments: I was so disappointed that my 2nd Tavern experience wasn't as flawless as my first one. I'm only giving it 3 stars due to the servise we received from the manager and because most of the food was still good. I met 3 friends for a late Saturday brunch, 2 of which had never been there before. I was excited to introduce them to Tavern's fabulousness but left feeling a little embarrassed after the servic we received. For starters, it took about 20 minutes before our server even acknowledged us. I asked about drink specials and as soon as the last word came out of her mouth she walked away leaving me unable to order a drink. About 10 minutes later she finally came back. After ordering drinks it took another 10 minutes to get them. We were ready to order our meals (had been for about 30 minutes) but again, she walked away before we could do so. Instead, she sauntered on over to the bar and proceeded to talk and flirt with some guy at the bar for over 20 minutes. We timed it. At that point we were so disgusted that we stopped another server walking by and asked if we could order with her. She was happy to help us. My 3 friends ordered the Tavern burger and they all liked it. I opted for a ham and brie omelette and it was kind of meh. I remembered I don't like brie (my fault for ordering it) and I had to pick it all out. The omelette was lacking flavor anyway. I should have at least salt and peppered it myself, I guess. The side of white trash hash was very tasty but an extremely small serving. Only about 5 bites. Because of our shitty server we were never offered to order a second round of drinks and it was past happy hour since of course we had been sitting at the table for almost 2 hours at that point. Dirty dishes sat on our table for 30 minutes while we waited for our checks. During our 2 hours at the table our server only came around 3 times. Very disappointing. With the exception of the burgers my friends had, the dining experience was pretty terrible. We ended up speaking with Madeline, the manager, about our experience. She was very nice and seemed to sincerely care about what we had to say. She ended up comping our entire meal and gave us some coupons to come back and try brunch again. However, while we were speaking with Madeline the server in question was whispering and giggling with a busboy and staring at our table. Our point of "complaining" was truly not to get anything free, but to let these little brats know that people aren't just going to stand by and let them slack on their job while they run around and socialize. We ended up tipping the server who actually took our order. I'm hoping this horrible experince was just a fluke because I really like Tavern and want to continue coming back.

name: Customer_4315
comments: Great food!! Everything we ordered was good. Wait was long for Saturday brunch. My fave were the red velvet waffle and Singapore eggs.

name: Customer_9177
comments: Went to lunch at Tavern today 8/29/17 with three co-workers who had never been before on my recommendation. It was a huge mistake on my part. Tavern had been ok on previous visits but today a real disappointment. Slow and indifferent service. Hidden costs-charges for extra salsa on already over priced nachos. Ordered extra chicken on the nachos- it was not on the nachos when they arrived-we were still charged for them because Tavern brought us a plate of luke warm chicken to pour on after we'd already finished. We asked about the hidden cost of the chicken and salsa our server rolled her eyes and let us know she does not make the rules. This place is way overrated, over priced and the douche bag factor is off the charts. Fu*k Tavern.

name: Customer_3723
comments: If you think you are walking into a typical bar menu .... think again! Wonderful, original recipes. I had a kale salad, guacamole and chicken wings. All awesome with non conventional ingredients (finally chopped kale with parmesan cheese, nuts, lemon). Guacamole with pistachio nuts and goat cheese! Who would have thought!! Really good!

name: Customer_3620
comments:
Had a very pleasant dining experience at Tavern tonight. We arrived at 5 pm and it was pretty dead. It's a big place with a nice outdoor patio and a side patio that can be indoor/outdoor depending on the weather. The vibe seems pretty cool and laid back. Rock music and low lighting get a thumbs up in my book. 

I decided to try a sangria while I browsed over the menu. It did not disappoint. Very fresh and tasty. I decided on The Tavern burger with sweet potato fries. The burger was delicious! It's served on a "meltaway" bun which basically is just a really soft and yummy bun. The sweet potato fries were good as well. Not soggy at all which seems to happen a lot with sweet potato fries. The boyfriend really enjoyed his meal as well but I'll let him tell you about that in his own review. :) Because the dinner was so good, I decided to order a dessert, too. I opted for the cinnamon bread pudding with vanilla gelato on top. It was also delish! It was the perfect amount of sweetness and comfort to end my meal. 

Service was quick and friendly, food was good, and the atmosphere was relaxing. We will definitely be back.

name: Customer_8768
comments: Food was fantastic, service was so bad I wouldn't come back. They are severely understaffed, we finished eating 45 mins before we got the check. The hour and a half wait is completely unnecessary!

name: Customer_6722
comments: I finally got to come and expereince brunch here! Which is easier said than done. I've attempted to come before and the wait was around 1.5-2 hours. On Sunday we came around 1115 for a 45 minute wait which wasn't bad for a group of 5. It's two for ones for Sunday brunch and I tried the sangria and the blood orange mimosa. I preferred the sangria hands down! For food I ordered the huevos rancheros which was pretty good. My gf ordered the Singapore stiryfry and the white trash hash and I liked her stir fry a lot! I will be back for sure because I keep hearing how good the tavern burger is and I won't make the mistake of not ordering it next time! Awesome atmosphere with a brunch of tvs. Can be a little loud though.

name: Customer_3583
comments: Best brunch in Nashville. Amazing lunch. During brunch drinks are 2 for 1 and they are delicious. The wicked Bloody Mary and blood orange mimosa are my favorites. Red velvet waffle, white trash hash, cheddar biscuits and gravy, eggs benedicts, and Singapore stir fry are all so excellent it makes it hard to decide what to order each time. The burger and fries are amazing for lunch, as are the Philly cheesesteak egg rolls, and fried chicken skins with honey Sriracha sauce as apps. They also have a midtown quickie on the menu that changes every day. Tavern never gets old and never disappoints.

name: Customer_7725
comments:
Went to Tavern for the first time last night after hearing many of my friends rave about it. Got there at 6 p.m. for a friend's birthday gathering and it was not crowded then. We had a big group and the staff was accommodating about our taking two of the big booths in the bar and spilling out in the aisle. 

The wine list is very modest but I found something that worked. Service was good. Now, I gotta say, the server didn't seem like she loves her job - she didn't look all that happy about serving us, but she was timely and checked back often, so who am I to complain? 

I didn't order food myself, but grazed off my friends' appetizers. The nachos with 'angry chicken' were really, really good. I've never met a nacho I didn't like, but these rank in the top two or three I've ever had. I was suspicious about the guacamole - who puts goat cheese and pistachios in guac? Why gild the lily? But once I picked off the nuts and cheese, the guac was also superlative: had a really nice garlicky kick. 

There wasn't a whole lot on the menu that didn't look appealing, so I am looking forward to going back soon and having a real meal. On the whole, I like it a lot better than its sister, Whiskey Kitchen.

name: Customer_7590
comments:
We wanted to check this place out after seeing the great reviews. 
Arrived on Thursday (New Years Day) around noon and the place was packed with a hour and a half wait. We put our name in and went next door for a drink, 
The restaurant texted us when our table was ready and also had a cool app that you can check your place in line. 
Only had drinks and a few apps. The tuscan fries were good but had a LOT of garlic.
My friend loved her Kale salad. 
If you like a bloody mary, try the cucumber mary made with cucumber vodka. It was unbelievable. 

This was hands down out favorite place in Nashville and this place had the BEST service we got our whole trip. A+ to the staff. We were really really impressed. 
We went back on Friday night around 1am and it was pretty empty. The guy sitting next to us said its really a better brunch or Sunday Funday bar and not busy at night.

name: Customer_5860
comments: We came here because of all the great yelp reviews, I can't believe this is 4-stars.. Good beer selection, good atmosphere, and decent service. The food, however, was bla.. We really wanted to try the fried chicken skins, they came out very hard and very stuck together. The sauce had good flavor but the skins came in a clump that we could hardly break apart. Our food came out about 4 minutes into our attempt to chisel the skins apart. Kaya toast was weird and really lacked anything to bring the dish together. After scraping off the sauce it was basically Texas toast and an egg. The 2 sets of tacos we ordered were both overcooked and VERY dry. Come here for drinks, skip the food!

name: Customer_5246
comments: Burger was amazing.  So juicy, cooked to perfection - ordered it medium rare, and it was!  Fries was delicious as well.  thank you!

name: Customer_2752
comments: I really must admit, I am a fan of some tavern CUISINE. Lets start with the guacamole.... (which is laced with pistachios and goat cheese mind you) i would say...TO DIE FOR. The fish taco's are SIMPLY divine, and could quite possibly be my very favorite in all of Nashville. the Perogies are delish and add a nice touch to the menu... ( i hale from North Eastern Pennsylvania where this particular dish is a standard and i was not disappointed) The Shishito Peppers are perfect.... The Salads are fresh and refreshing... I can not wait to return and sample some more tasty delights.

name: Customer_4677
comments: Hmmmmm it's decent. Not sure about the 'rave' reviews to be honest. The prices kind of turned me off. They have a brunch item of Kaya Toast which is to out it bluntly ridiculously overpriced. I can get a jar of Kaya from the Asian market for 1/10the price of the dish. Not impressed.

name: Customer_3832
comments: We were staying right down the street from this place and it was recommended by the girl at the front desk of our hotel. We actually went to get a few drinks and bite to eat on a Friday night. The atmosphere is really nice and the bar is really big. Definitely a good bar to watch football game at or any sports game at. My girlfriend and I both had different signature cocktails which were really good. I had the fish tacos which were out of this world! So good I can't even tell you, you'll have to try them for yourself! My girlfriend had the seared tuna which was also great, a little spicy so watch out for that if you don't like spicy. We went back the next morning for brunch. I ordered the Benedict Uno which was eggs benedict with short rib and a tabasco hollandaise sauce. I also ordered a side of the white trash hash. First off all, the white trash hash was out of this world! So different and unique and so good it was amazing. The reason I'm giving this place 4 stars is because of the Benedict. I always order Eggs Benedict and no matter what kind of Hollandaise sauce it comes with I've never thought of ordering it on the side. For this Benedict I should of. It was drenched in the tabasco hollandaise sauce which wasn't bad but just was way way way too much. I couldn't even taste the egg or could see if I was eating egg or just all sauce. It honestly made me sick after we left. I wish there was half the amount they gave me or I should of got it on the side but like I said, I've never had a problem with too much hollandaise sauce. The picture below is deceiving because it doesn't look like a lot of sauce but there really was. Other then that everything was terrific! I just hope they over did my Benedict and don't do that for every Benedict dish they serve.

name: Customer_5881
comments:
