They also have a great mix of cocktails and beer that makes for great day drinking!

name: Customer_3224
comments: Tavern has a great brunch situation if you are looking to have drinks. 2 for 1 mimosas, bellinis, bloody Mary's and sangria make for a great start to the day. Brunch can get very packed during peak hours so you want to get there early on Saturdays and Sundays.

name: Customer_9255
comments:
I decided I wanted to spend my birthday in Nashville, and I was ultimately excited about finding the perfect spot for brunch. I spent tons of time reading through Yelp reviews trying to find the perfect location and finally narrowed it down to the Tavern.

We arrived a few minutes before they opened on a Sunday and were immediately directed to a table. Our waitress recommended the Tavern Tuscan Fries which were good and the portion was huge for two people. I loved the 2-for-1 drinks, and the Bellini Sparkle was my favorite. I ordered the Singapore Stir Fry which was delicious and was recommended by our waitress. 

Tavern definitely met my expectations, and I can't wait to make another visit for lunch or dinner.

name: Customer_6884
comments: Great atmosphere. Amazing burgers. The heart of Nashville in food. Would definitely come again and recommend to friends visiting Nashville.

name: Customer_8364
comments: This place has a great vibe and lots of energy! Being an out towner, we were recommended the tavern by our hotel staff at Hutton hotel. The tavern is in walking distance and has a very friendly wait staff. Their food was great and the wine made our night before walking downtown to enjoy the live music on the strip. And we are back for another round the next day! :)

name: Customer_7867
comments: This joint was recommended by a waiter who served us supper, said the red velvet waffles were to die for....ummm no suicidal thoughts here...totaly not worth the 1hr wait and is extremely loud....forget about conversation. We had the breakfast fondu....where is the fondu pot and skewers? And the $3 coffee was yucky! Service wasn't the best either. I'm getting the feeling that the waiters around here think because they probally won't ever see you again they don't have to give good customer service. You basically have to ask to be waited on.#RoadtripUSA

name: Customer_5292
comments: Drinks were strong! Guacamole and fries were excelent. Beef short rib tacos were like chewing on a tire. Mahi sandwich was overcooked and super fishy. Tried this place a few years ago, never came back but thought we would give it another shot. Probably won't be back, maybe for guacamole and fries. Our server was awesome though.

name: Customer_9105
comments: The Tavern have the best burgers and the servise was great. Atmosphere was nice and family friendly. I will defintely be back if I visit Nashville again.

name: Customer_1974
comments: First time back to Nashville since I was in high school, and can't believe I haven't been back sooner! Here at Vanderbilt for a class, and kept passing by the Tavern on my way to campus each morning... Had an inticing, rustic, downtown Manhattan look to it. So I put it on my list of places to check out. I looked here in Yelp, and saw it had great reviews. I came in for dinner tonight, and immediately noticed the reclaimed wood door, wrought iron, and alternative rock playing. I knew it would be a great place. I sat at the bar, as I was here by myself, and immediately got a menu and was offered a drink. I had the 1920, which was a little stout, but better than weak, am I right? I ordered the lamb tacos, Tennessee tavern fries, and cinnamon roll bread pudding. Tacos were small, but honestly a decent portion considering how much meat was on them. They were hot out of the kitchen, and the roasted peanuts gave it great crunch. Now, the Tennessee tavern fries ... Sweet potato fries with a touch of cinnamon and sugar, with jalapeño ketchup. Shut the front door, these were to die for. Light and airy, arrived in a mini frying basket with abundant portions. The ketchup was amazing, and I definately asked for more. The cinnamon roll bread pudding was a muffin size portion, with vanilla ice cream, homemade whip, and caramel sauce. Great flavor, not overwhelming. Service was fantastic, and even met some fun people! Highly recommend this place. I'll be coming back for sure.

name: Customer_3366
comments:
My husband and I enjoyed a late meal here last night (Monday). It wasn't too crowded, but filled up before we left. 

We sat on the patio and enjoyed the warm Nashville night.

My husband ordered the bucket of mussels and I had the beef short rib tacos.

The tacos are small, so if you're hungry, order three! It was perfect for me, though. The meat was tender and delicious. It had sliced cucumber and a spicy sauce which was to die for. 

The bucket of mussels was a large portion of mussels in a broth, served with a large chunk of french bread for dipping.  My husband enjoyed them to the end. I asked if they had a lot of garlic and he said not at all. He was delighted with the light sauce.

Although our waitress, Jennifer, who might just be the best waitress in the world, suggested many desserts (including s'mores, which involved bringing a little fire pit to the table with hershey's chocolate, strawberries and reeses) we opted for the reverse root beer float: root beer gelato with creme soda over the top. It was delicious! (Had I been out with the girlfriends, we definitely would have tried the s'mores..next time!)

As I said, Jennifer, our waitress was very attentive. She knew in detail about every item on the menu (as we ask a lot of questions!) and took great care of us.

We would definitely recommend this restaurant to any one in the area.

name: Customer_8776
comments: Great atmosphere. Amazing burgers. The heart of Nashville in food. Would definitely come again and recommend to friends visiting Nashville.

name: Customer_2280
comments: Nice place. More of a sports bar than I expected, lots of TV's. Good ambience, very good server. Food was good quality, sweet potato fries were great but could of stood to be a little hotter. Food came quick and beer on tap was fresh and of good selection.

name: Customer_4505
comments: My husband and I are visiting Nashville from Chicago (go cubs). We have been to tavern once before last year and my husband fell in love with the chickenooga drink. So in love that tavern was our first stop back in town. Well, one chickenooga into the night and there was an issue with the keg equipment making this drink unavailable. The manager soon came over with a substitute option replacing the beer. They very well could have just said "too bad" but went way above and beyond and made my husband content. Great food too but the service is well above the rest!

name: Customer_9615
comments: Delicious! I had a burger and my wife got the eggs with short ribs, both of which we loved. For dessert we had an orange float, which we also quite enjoyed. The service was excellent, and the food was really quite cheap. Definitely worth a visit!

name: Customer_8350
comments: Don't order the fish tacos- they were very disappointing. I didn't even want to eat them. Order the burger. It was very good. Restaurant is a little overpriced for what it is.

name: Customer_1510
comments: Nice, upscale bar with your no so typical bar food. The grilled cheese was pretty tasty with truffle oil fries. The lettuce wraps were fantastic! The decor was a neat industrial look and was very tastefully done. We'll be back!

name: Customer_4987
comments: The simply-named Tavern offers up some mighty simple comfort food pleasures (White Trash hash, anyone?) and elevated junk food game bites. That said, I'm not sure this is quite the weekend brunch place for me, due to the TVs providing all of the background noise. I'm not a fan of big TVs blaring games -- to me, this is the worst kind of ambiance. BUT... for those of you seeking a place to watch local sports and cheer on with a crowd, Tavern is the spot for you, especially if your tastes are a bit more high brow than your typical nachos. I mean, they have nachos, but Tavern's come with pistachio and goat cheese. Nice! I'd easily return on a non game day (or even to sit on the shaded side patio) for more of that White Trash Hash. Think tater tot casserole. I mean, really. Goodbye hangover. The egg white omelet I had was kinda blah, as the tomatoes made it seem extra watery.The "Wicked" Bloody Mary was hardly wicked, more like gentle, despite the vodka being infused with pickled things that you'd hope for on your glass. They don't automatically garnish the way you'd think. Or at least the way a New Orleanian would think. I mean... just a lime? Nu uh. Our very lovely server came out with some olives for us, which was nice. But a Bloody without beaucoup d' garnish is a naked Mary, indeed. Extra props for three bottles of hot sauces on the table, marked X, XX and XXX. Go for the orangey habanero, as it's the tastiest of the bunch (it might be the XX). Don't be fooled by the warnings. They are there for the bland American palate.

name: Customer_8560
comments: Nice, upscale bar with your no so typical bar food. The grilled cheese was pretty tasty with truffle oil fries. The lettuce wraps were fantastic! The decor was a neat industrial look and was very tastefully done. We'll be back!

name: Customer_8743
comments: First night in Nashville, after a long car ride, ready to get a taste of that night life!! Great place to start. Food: Started with the SHISHITO PEPPERS, def glad I did. These are perfectly charred. Cooked well, so that they are still a little crisp and not soggy. Lightly salted. Greatest part, they give a little pile of sea salt on the side, so you can season to your liking!! Be careful with these. Some of the peppers have a super spicy kick. BUFFALO CAULIFLOWER was another starter. This app was a bit too sour for me. The tanginess was pretty potent that I could not focus on any other flavors. Also, the exterior of the cauliflower was not that crispy. More on the soggier side. Not a fan. Pass on this. TURKEY BLT was a good choice. The pretzel bread was nice and chewy. Lovely choice of bread for this sammy. Wonderfully smoked turkey with crispy bacon. Comes together beautifully with the smooth gruyere cheese, and the creamy avocado aioli. Great textures and tastes that really comes together in this sammy. I got it with the Tuscan tavern fries. Nice and crunchy fries. Def try. SMORES on the tabletop. Even comes with a small campfire. Classic fix'ns for smores: graham crackers, marshmellows, and chocolate bar. In addition, some strawberries and reese's peanut butter cups. Was quite the indoor smores expereince. Service: Drinks were full, food got to the table fresh and hot, server was attentive, and table was cleared away promptly. All together, I think it was a good experience. Ambiance: Very casual. Rustic and slightly romantic. Nice for a girls gathering, as well as date night. Dranks: Great selection of beers, wines, and specialty cocktails. A little something for everyone. I had wine that night, but def would like to go back and try one of their cocktails. Overall: A place that I would like to visit again. Food was good. Drinks were good. This is a place that you can go, no pressure, find something to eat, and get your drink on. Enjoy!!

name: Customer_5159
comments: Great place to grab drinks with friends! The waitresses were super friendly. Go on Thursday nights for the best drink specials. One con is that the food isn't that great, but this place is fabulous for drinks.

name: Customer_5940
comments: I like Tavern a lot. The food is very good. I went here for lunch with a friend from work. I loved the vibe, the dim-ish lighting, and the music, and would definately like to come back at night time. The fish was very good, fresh, and the batter was light and perfect. I loved the sauces that came with my meal. I shouldn't have gotten the sweet potato fries. Didn't care for them. Next time I'll get regular ones. Also loved the fact that they have all of those hot sauces at the table. Any place with an abundance of hot sauces is awesome to me. I would like to go back and try other food. The only negative thing was it took far too long to eat here on our lunch break. The servise was very slow, but maybe the server was new. We had an hour break and we are late coming back. However, will go back again, definitely.

name: Customer_6608
comments: Food was fantastic, servise was so bad I wouldn't come back. They are severely understaffed, we finished eating 45 mins before we got the check. The hour and a half wait is completely unnecessary!

name: Customer_1278
comments: A friend recommended this restaurant to me while on a business trip to Nashville. The food and service were great! It's a really cool atmosphere with lots of fresh air. Unique menu items, and everything that I saw come out looked so good.

name: Customer_2546
comments:
Lots of good options in this area and the tavern is definitely one of them.  I came here for drinks one night and lunch during the day.   A bit of a wait for dinner so make sure you get a reservation if you can.

We got an appetizer - buffalo cauliflower.  It's slightly breaded and engulfed in buffalo sauce.  Good taste, but would've preferred to have it a bit crispier.  

Ordered the burger - cooked medium, lettuce, tomato, American (cheese is extra).  The fries were okay - comes in a little fryer basket.  The burger had a good sear on the outside and properly seasoned with salt.  

Good spot for food and drinks.

name: Customer_5916
comments: I used to go to tavern pretty frequently over the past few years and was SHOCKED at the experience last night. A friend and I ordered the bazooka toast - described as "bazooka guacamole/bread/smoked salmon/fried egg/arugula" for a hefty $16! When we got our food we were floored... one piece of bread covered in a sort of smoked salmon spread... a far cry from the fresh slices of smoked salmon that one would expect from that description. Really disappointing, it looked and smelled like canned salmon or cat food? Really weird ...it should be described differently on the menu!

name: Customer_2489
comments: Came here during a recent trip to Nashville. Came here a couple years ago for brunch which was amazing but a super long wait so beware. Didn't realize when I picked this place this time that they also do a 2 for 1 drink special from 2-10pm on Wednesday nights. This is a great deal but makes the night a lot busier. I was with an older group of people so they personally didn't like how much noise was going on in the restaurant. In terms of food I do feel like it's a little overpriced for what you get. But I will say the mahi-mahi tacos were tasty. I would defintely come back on future trips to Nashville. And if they take reservations I will do that instead.

name: Customer_9416
comments:
This place is awesome!  We stumbled upon it after checking into our hotel...we wanted to walk around after being in the car for 9 hours and we were starving.  We got a table outside, it was loud, but what do you expect on a Friday night in early summer?
The food was great....I got the Nuevo Israeli bread salad and my husband got the turkey blt (with sweet potato chips (YUMMMM)--both fantastic.  
They have an extensive drink/beer list and the staff is knowledgeable about the beer they serve and didn't steer my husband wrong.  
Would recommend trying this place out if you haven't already.

name: Customer_1158
comments: I've only been to Tavern once and it was for Sunday brunch. My friend and I wanted somewhere close to our church (Midtown 12South) and she suggested Tavern because she said the brunch food was good. I wasn't too sure about the meal I ended up ordering...you know how you have those days where you teeter back and forth between what to order and then end up just blurting out a choice and don't really know if you're ok with what you said? Well...this one of those times, so it might have skewed my verdict. The food was good, but it wasn't my favorite. The 2for1 brunch drinks helped a bit. I might would go back and try some lunch food and see how that is. But for now, it's just A-ok in my book.

name: Customer_4780
comments: Short rib tacos ruled! The sweet potato fries were an awesome starter. Our server Lindsay was amazing. Kept our glasses full the whole time and checked up on us constantly! Good vibe and they had the game on which in the playoffs is always a good thing! I'd go back again! Maybe take mom and dad to this joint!

name: Customer_1824
comments:
Gastropub delight! I have to stop here every time I come to Nashville for business. I haven't had a single thing from the menu that I did not love. The grilled cheese was amazing, the soup tasty, the drinks... Mmmmmmm. Try the one with agave. The truffle fries are perfect, and be sure to top it all off with s'mores you make at the table. I've enjoyed eating outside, inside, at the bar... and have taken food to go when I didn't have time to relax. The decor is rustic and interesting. Depending on the time of day, it can be a quiet spot to relax or it can get really noisy at happy hour. 

The one drawback is the prices. A bit on the high side, but okay for someone like me who only does this occasionally for a treat. If you were a local, it might set you back if you became a regular.

name: Customer_3094
comments: The kale salad is excellent. The rest of the food was ok. Far too expensive I'd you ask me for the sports bar type atmosphere, mediocre food and almost bad cocktail. The waitress come by and asked us if we liked the food about 14 times in our hour dinner and took our plates away the second we finished it which I thought was way too aggressive.

name: Customer_8160
comments: Best place within walking distance from my hotel. It's a pretty modern and happening place, with a cool feel to it. I really was looking for a good salad, and was pleasantly surprised with my Junk Salad (romaine, salami, shrimp, olives, pepperoncini, hearts of palm, grape tomato, cucumber, blue cheese, champagne dijon vinaigrette). This was a super tasty salad. I came back 4 days later and had the burger and sweet potato ships. Burger was pretty good, and my only complaint was that the chips were a little on the salty side. Brush some of the salt off and it was good.

name: Customer_9647
comments: this place was so awesome. we went on sunday so the drinks were 2 for the price of one. they have a great little sitting area outside where you can sit and wait for your table to be ready. I had the Blood & Smoke, im not a huge fan of bloody marys usually but this was amazing. the food was also great, and came out fairly quick after ordering. they also had a DJ playing a variety of music the whole time and I really enjoyed that.  I definitely will visit this place again.

name: Customer_3755
comments:
What I liked:
1. White Trash Hash- With a name like that, what's there not to like?  While I'm sure I could re-create this for about $2 (smashed fried hashbrowns smothered in cheese), it was well worth the extra cost to enjoy at brunch.  YUM!
2. Brunch Menu- There were too many delicious options to choose.  I went with a salad, but everything (especially the burger and french toast) looked and smelled fantastic.
3. Bloody Marys- They served my favorite, Zig-Zag mix and you get 2 for the price they charge.

What I didn't like:
1. This place gets VERY crowded on the weekend during the brunch rush.  We were quoted at hour+ wait shortly after they opened and ended up just snagging a seat at the bar.
2. Service- The bartender was understaffed and a bit slow to respond to requests.  They also forgot about part of our order and had to be reminded.

Overall Verdict: Make a reservation or show-up early and prepare to wait.  Get the white trash hash and enjoy delicious brunch!

name: Customer_1238
comments: One of my favorite spots in town. Burger is amazing, good vibe, nice staff. Go-to gastro pub for sure.

name: Customer_2822
comments: I could eat the blue cheese fondue on almost anything. I bet liver would taste good in that fondue. Fortunately I had some really good buffalo cauliflower to go along with and I hasten to say it was a top 5 all time appetizer ever.People rave about the fries and they were good but not the best I have had. The Tavern burger on the other-hand may be the best burger I have ever had. Made from ground rib-eye and filet makes me believe God made the burger lol The lobster sliders were really good but 22 bucks not that good. The mushroom soup had to be made by Angels it was amazing. Its a little pricey but you definitely get what you pay for, for the most part. As a whole it may be the best lunch ever. I give very few 5 stars on average and this was well earned. The place is nice and cozy and the staff were great. It was a religious experiance involving food.

name: Customer_7299
comments: I love Tavern. They have exceptional cocktails, killer food, and an ambiance that can't be beat! I foresee many a dollar of mine being spent here.... It gets VERY busy, and on Sunday when I stopped in with a friend it was no exception. Luckily, there were two seats at the bar, so we snagged them and sat down. After drooling over another customer's plate of mussels, I decided I had to get them. White wine with bacon, leeks, and a piece of "dippy" bread? Um score. My friend had the chicken chimichanga, and it was cheesy but still full of flavor and amazing! But let's talk cocktails, something that really gets my engine running and Tavern hit the mark. The red sangria was pre-mixed and topped off with some bubbly. It was a good sangria, but not over the top good. However, my balsamic martini with stoli, strawberry puree, and a splash of balsamic syrup?? Creative and delicious! I will be ordering the drink again and again! The bellini sparkle was not in a tiny champagne flute, it was in a tumbler and was refreshing. My friend couldn't stop ordering the cucumber, apple, and elderflower cocktail. Be warned, it is very strong! I was worried our servise would be poor because they only had 2 bartenders for the entire bar, but it wasn't. They were attentive and sure to check up on us and get our orders in. They also have some incredible outdoor seating areas, and enjoying a cocktail on a nice day here is heaven. Thanks for the good times Tavern, I can't wait to see you again!

name: Customer_8483
comments:
I finally got to come and experience brunch here! Which is easier said than done. I've attempted to come before and the wait was around 1.5-2 hours. 
On Sunday we came around 1115 for a 45 minute wait which wasn't bad for a group of 5. 
It's two for ones for Sunday brunch and I tried the sangria and the blood orange mimosa. I preferred the sangria hands down!
For food I ordered the huevos rancheros which was pretty good. My gf ordered the Singapore stiryfry and the white trash hash and I liked her stir fry a lot!
I will be back for sure because I keep hearing how good the tavern burger is and I won't make the mistake of not ordering it next time! 
Awesome atmosphere with a brunch of tvs. Can be a little loud though.

name: Customer_2346
comments: Meet by a great hostess at the door, Jenna. Her smile was amazing! Drinks at the bar were rather good.  They actually have a loco moco! BOOM!

name: Customer_4590
comments: Delicious! I had a burger and my wife got the eggs with short ribs, both of which we loved. For dessert we had an orange float, which we also quite enjoyed. The service was excellent, and the food was really quite cheap. Definitely worth a visit!

name: Customer_7051
comments: Evan the doorman was as friendly as his beard is burly. Jenna the hostess got us a table wiki wiki even though the place was packed. Amy our server professed her love for us because we ordered 8 items at once and handed her the menus back. Specialty cocktails were fantastic and the fish tacos were off the charts delicious. Well done, Tavern. Well done.

name: Customer_8315
comments:
This place is awesome!  We stumbled upon it after checking into our hotel...we wanted to walk around after being in the car for 9 hours and we were starving.  We got a table outside, it was loud, but what do you expect on a Friday night in early summer?
The food was great....I got the Nuevo Israeli bread salad and my husband got the turkey blt (with sweet potato chips (YUMMMM)--both fantastic.  
They have an extensive drink/beer list and the staff is knowledgeable about the beer they serve and didn't steer my husband wrong.  
Would recommend trying this place out if you haven't already.

name: Customer_5478
comments:
You find yourself in an unfamiliar city, it's raining, and you need to duck in somewhere. You choose Tavern Midtown. The ambiance is modern rustic. Great music, and knowledgeable, friendly bartenders await. 

Per recommendation, I decided on the Tavern Burger and fries. For more detail, ribeye & filet beef blend with a perfectly toasted bun, two slices of red onion, thick cut tomato,  four evenly cut pickle chips, two slices of bacon, and three roasted green chilis.  Perfectly cooked throughout, it is the perfect dinner to satisfy the palate during this business trip.  The Belgian fries are not too soggy, not overly salted. As good served with roasted garlic aioli as they are with the Louisiana XX hot sauce.

Food: 5/5
Ambiance: 4/5
Staff: 5/5
Come back factor: 6/5

Thank you for a great experience!

name: Customer_5734
comments:
I've been to Tavern three times, and each time this "happy hour" (quotes due to the fact that actual happy hour is only on Wednesdays) location was chosen by or because of guy friends. Why do men love this place?? Maybe it's the industrial concrete or the weird chains on the wall? 

Anyway, the food really is good - I recommend the nachos, guac or lobster hushpuppies, just don't be shocked when you get your pricey check at the end of the night. The drinks are only reasonably priced if you go on 2-4-1 Wednesday - unless you follow the lead of the d-bag at our table last night and walk out on your check. 

If you're going with a large group make sure you get there early since they don't take reservations or let you call ahead. They also charge a $15 cake fee if you bring a dessert on a special occasion, even though they have no desserts on the menu. 

It's not a bad place - it's in a good location, has good food and a cool vibe, I just prefer something a little cheaper and more low key.
If you share my preference for a midtown happy hour, allow me to suggest Brewhouse or Corner Pub instead.

name: Customer_2147
comments:
Stopped by while on a business trip after reading other reviews. I had the salmon and it was really good. Only knock I have is that the portion size was really small (I thought, anyway). Also had the kale salad which was really good. I was trying to be good, but definitely had order envy when I saw the burger and fries. 

Give it a try! I would definitely go back!

name: Customer_6873
comments: Food was great here! I've been here before just for drinks and wanted to come back because I had an amazing pineapple charred mule cocktail. We came back and ate this time. The only thing preventing me from giving Tavern five stars was that the service was slower than it should be and it wasn't an insanely busy night. Our waitress was not the most attentive.

name: Customer_6643
comments:
Not my cuppa gin. Probably because of all that basil.

Tavern is big, a bit brash, bro-friendly with all the TVs and reasonably priced for its prime location on Broadway. Drop your name and cell phone number at the host stand and get sexted when your table is ready. So tech.

Reviews sing praises of their prime beef burgers, so wifey and I opted for a pair, each with bacon and cheese. Subbing a side salad for fries comes with a surcharge... the amount will totally surprise you. (Clickbait header fail: It's $3.50.)

With the fixin's and the greens, a $9.50 patty sizzled up to $16. And the lasting impression is nil, save the need for seasoning and a Maillard crust. It's an average burger that should be $8 at any pub, which gives me pause as to why it comes so highly praised. An off-night in the kitchen? Labor Day weekend lethargy? Unclear. The end result just didn't resonate.

Could cocktails save the day? Her berry julep was all pulp and my 1920 (a gin, grapefruit, ginger and basil concoction borrowed from Brinkley's) tasted only of the green leaf. No tartness, no ginger bite, no other herbal subtleties from the spirit. Just basil. All the basil. At least they were cheap-ish!

name: Customer_3285
comments: Food and service was great! Try the BLT and the egg rolls! The drinks are so good as well.

name: Customer_3894
comments: Y'all gave my Asian friend and my white friend some food poisoning from the Caesar salad. Thanks Obama.

name: Customer_7513
comments: Sunday Funday !!!! Best place to go on Sunday!!!! Excellent breakfast/brunch! If you got to watch your football/ ice hockey playoffs- any sports! This is the place!

name: Customer_2470
comments: I've never been to an M Street resturant before, for those of you who are not familiar with M Street they are the zany people who bring us restaraunt concepts such as Kayne Prime (on my bucket list,) Virago and Moto (also on my bucket list.) So on Wednesday night we visited Tavern, which is self-described as "a pub for chefs." Valet parking at this location is a must and they were prompt and efficient. There was plenty of porch seating available as well as being used - Nashvillians do love their porches. The inside of the restaraunt had a rustic feel and it seemed as though the bar top was inhabited by business class regulars. That having been said I could easily picture the bar at 12 midnight being inhabited by waitrons and people with checkered pants, it would be a great place to have some concept drinks and small plates after a busy restaurant shift. I ordered the Korean short rib tacos - I definately got the red pepper forward taste as well as the cool of the cucumber and cilantro. I would order it again. Delivery time was about 13 minutes, a good ticket time. It's very evident that these people are "on their game," I will be returning to try other items on their menu. And one day I will visit Kayne Prime, I might splurge for that on my father's birthday. Visit Tavern, have fun!

name: Customer_5333
comments: Yum! Mussels are excellent---get extra bread for dipping. Order small plates and share to try lots if items. Kale salad is very good but a small is enough for two people to share since the flavors are unique --- good balance among Parmesan, citrus and cranberries. Guacamole is indeed yummy and lobster hush puppies are a great twist on soul food. Jalapeño ketchup has a nice kick. Shortrib tacos are good, dependable food. They won't knock your socks off, but you won't be sorry. Drinks: 1920 is a little more bitter than I anticipated, but still good. Existentialist is very refreshing as a summer drink.

name: Customer_3364
comments: I've been here several times for lunch and I always get the same thing; Scottish Salmon and the Nuevo Bread Salad. My wife ordered the burger and it is the burger for which we measure all others. Service is good, ambiance and location are good. It is so much better than its sister restaurant, Whiskey Kitchen. I hear it is a trendy and crowded venue at night.

name: Customer_4358
comments:
What I liked:
1. White Trash Hash- With a name like that, what's there not to like?  While I'm sure I could re-create this for about $2 (smashed fried hashbrowns smothered in cheese), it was well worth the extra cost to enjoy at brunch.  YUM!
2. Brunch Menu- There were too many delicious options to choose.  I went with a salad, but everything (especially the burger and french toast) looked and smelled fantastic.
3. Bloody Marys- They served my favorite, Zig-Zag mix and you get 2 for the price they charge.

What I didn't like:
1. This place gets VERY crowded on the weekend during the brunch rush.  We were quoted at hour+ wait shortly after they opened and ended up just snagging a seat at the bar.
2. Service- The bartender was understaffed and a bit slow to respond to requests.  They also forgot about part of our order and had to be reminded.

Overall Verdict: Make a reservation or show-up early and prepare to wait.  Get the white trash hash and enjoy delicious brunch!

name: Customer_7911
comments: Great vegetarian options (I got the Buffalo cauliflower - amazing), healthy options (chopped kale salad with almonds and dried blueberries with light dressing), as well as favorites like tacos, nachos, fried chicken and burgers.  Lots of tvs but also more secluded tables. Would definitely come back!

name: Customer_2663
comments: Another Yelper hit it -- this is a noisy, crowded restaurant with big screen TVs.  I wouldn't call it a sports bar.  Nothing wrong with the place.  Cool location, good beer selection.  The food - delicious, but eliminates itself as a "sports bar". My sons and I wanted to catch some pub grub and the hockey game.  Got the game.  The grub-- eclectic.  Do go here if you want a busy, bustling, energetic, tasty, flavorful, thumping music-beat experience.  Don't go here if you want  a burger, a beer and a hockey game amidst sports conversation.

name: Customer_9345
comments: Went to lunch at Tavern today 8/29/17 with three co-workers who had never been before on my recommendation. It was a huge mistake on my part. Tavern had been ok on previous visits but today a real disappointment. Slow and indifferent service. Hidden costs-charges for extra salsa on already over priced nachos. Ordered extra chicken on the nachos- it was not on the nachos when they arrived-we were still charged for them because Tavern brought us a plate of luke warm chicken to pour on after we'd already finished. We asked about the hidden cost of the chicken and salsa our server rolled her eyes and let us know she does not make the rules. This place is way overrated, over priced and the douche bag factor is off the charts. Fu*k Tavern.

name: Customer_6924
comments: One of my favorite spots in town. Burger is amazing, good vibe, nice staff. Go-to gastro pub for sure.

name: Customer_5937
comments: I've been here twice now, and the food is always great and the service is decent. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the food takes a while to come out, even when it's not super busy. I've gotten the fish tacos (they are HUGE), burgers, fries (also huge portions), and goat cheese and pistachio guacamole. Like I said, the food is always very good, but if you're coming on a weekend, be prepared for a very long wait. It has a super hip atmosphere and you'll find a lot of twenty-somethings there.

name: Customer_3470
comments:
Awesome brunch place. I think they must have put crack in their white trash hash. I'm still dreaming about it every now and then. I couldn't remember what I had. The white trash hash blew my mind and it's the only thing I remember. 
They also have 2-1 special drink during brunch. The only 2 things that prevent me from going there all the times, are my student loan and a long wait. We end up sitting at a bar.

name: Customer_3680
comments: Great vegetarian options (I got the Buffalo cauliflower - amazing), healthy options (chopped kale salad with almonds and dried blueberries with light dressing), as well as favorites like tacos, nachos, fried chicken and burgers.  Lots of tvs but also more secluded tables. Would definitely come back!

name: Customer_9078
comments: My 8 friends and I came here during our visit to Nashville because of good reviews we heard from friends who visited - they did not disappoint.  Tavern was a great brunch spot and they were able to accommodate our large group fairly easily.  The service was awesome, relaxed and friendly staff all around.  The food was phenomenal - We split almost every app on the menu, all very good.  I had the special taco scramble and it was one of the best egg dishes I've had in a while.  The "white trash hash" that came with it was delicious and a twist on the classic hashbrowns.  All in all I would come back here and would recommend to anyone visiting.

name: Customer_1041
comments:
Wow, what an impression! This was my first visit to Nashville and absolutely loved it.  Tavern had a great contemporary vibe and look to it.  The food was incredible.  Our table had the Tavern Burger, Chimichanga, and the Basket of Crispy Little Fish.  Each was to die for.  If you are a carnivore then the burger is the way to go, Prime and Filet made the burger super juicy and tasty! 

The bar area had adequate seating and served every liquor drink you could think of as well of 2oz pour of some really great tequila and whiskey.  Local beer on draft and bolted favorites are also served.  


This place is a must go!

name: Customer_5710
comments:
This may seem like a standard American burger joint, but they actually have taken pains to create a thoughtful and surprising menu. 

There are options ranging from middle eastern to Mediterranean to Indian to new American and I had a sampling of them all. Everything had a distinct flavor profile, regardless of whether I liked it, and the burger was one of the best I've had in Nashville. Oh, and for dessert you can roast your own marshmallows at the table. 

Service wasn't the greatest, but not terrible as other reviews have noted and overall this is a spot I'd recommend.

name: Customer_5570
comments: Best brunch! Came here on a busy Saturday with a group of girls. Everyone loved their food and drinks! Waitress was friendly, efficient and knowledgeable about all menu and drink items. Would definitely come here again.

name: Customer_9137
comments: Food was so good! Great music, good casual or event atmosphere. Came here for a group birthday dinner. Their white sangria was amazing

name: Customer_3673
comments: The 45 minute wait was well worth it, especially since you have drinks while you wait! The staff here at Tavern were super attentive and really helpful in giving suggestions on what to order. We got the maple fondue and it was incredible, you got to try a little bit of everything. The red velvet waffles were out of this world, the blueberry cornmeal waffles were a slam dunk, the Frosted Flakes crusted French toast was life changing. The sausages were great, the chicken was very spicy but overall great and the fruit was super fresh and sweet. The eggs benedict were really good but very large. All in all I would come back again in a heartbeat!! WE LOVE TAVERN BRUNCH

name: Customer_1810
comments: Where should I start... Oh yeah, I love this place! Went for the first time this weekend and all the things I've heard about this place are true. Great food, amazing outdoor patios and a great variety of drinks. We started out with the Lobster Hushpuppies and Bazooka Guacamole. The presentation was modern and they most definitely delivered on taste, the only issue I had, was I wanted to order more appetizers! After some self restraint we order our entrees; I took the servers recommendation and had the burger and everybody else had the BLT. Looking back I wish I would have tried something new, don't get me wrong it was good but there are some amazing sounding dishes on the menu. Next time I guess. All in all if you are looking for a trendy spot to have a bite and a few drinks, I definitely recommend this place! Oh yeah, I almost forgot use the hot sauce!

name: Customer_2620
comments: Went today with a group for brunch. We had no complaints. Great-cucumber Bloody Mary, coffee, lobster gumbo, grilled artichoke, white trash hash and service. The decor was tasteful and semi modern. I definitely felt like we left Nashville for a couple hours which was great! Will definitely be back!

name: Customer_7356
comments: Great food, great atmosphere.  I had the mac and cheese, which was a special and it wasn't on the menu, but it was AMAZING.  I also highly recommend the egg rolls.  Not your normal egg rolls.

name: Customer_4661
comments: Looks, from the street, like it would be good, but it was just okay. Our waitress pretty much forgot about us the entire time we were there. Not sure what that was all about. We tried practicing mindfulness to make the time pass while we were waiting for her to come back out and take our order. My nachos were disappointing--basically felt like a slice of cheese was melted over chips with globs of black beans. The kale salad was a warm mound of wilted kale mixed with parm cheese. My son liked his burger, so that was good.

name: Customer_8268
comments: Tavern has Nashville's best burger. I was sad when it was gone. Fantastic. The staff is friendly, and the service is great. They even brought our group free s'mores. (That's right: They have s'mores.) I have a new favorite Nashville restaurant.

name: Customer_8700
comments: This joint was recommended by a waiter who served us supper, said the red velvet waffles were to die for....ummm no suicidal thoughts here...totaly not worth the 1hr wait and is extremely loud....forget about conversation. We had the breakfast fondu....where is the fondu pot and skewers? And the $3 coffee was yucky! Service wasn't the best either. I'm getting the feeling that the waiters around here think because they probally won't ever see you again they don't have to give good customer srvice. You basically have to ask to be waited on.#RoadtripUSA

name: Customer_2976
comments: Nice bar with good music and lively atmosphere. The beef Tacos were so Yummy, and so were the fries. Went if there happy

name: Customer_2737
comments:
my favorite brunch spot on nashville! 

the drinks are amazing and they have a wide range of items on the menu. my favorite brunch items are probably the benedicts and white trash hash.

my favorite items served all day are the sweet potato fries and tuscan kale salad!

the only complaint I would have is that they usually have a long wait, especially for brunch so come early and be prepared to wait! it's certainly worth it. 

other than that, the atmosphere and food are some
of the best in nashville!

name: Customer_9995
comments: A friend recommended this restaurant to me while on a business trip to Nashville. The food and service were great! It's a really cool atmosphere with lots of fresh air. Unique menu items, and everything that I saw come out looked so good.

name: Customer_5803
comments:
Had a very pleasant dining experience at Tavern tonight. We arrived at 5 pm and it was pretty dead. It's a big place with a nice outdoor patio and a side patio that can be indoor/outdoor depending on the weather. The vibe seems pretty cool and laid back. Rock music and low lighting get a thumbs up in my book. 

I decided to try a sangria while I browsed over the menu. It did not disappoint. Very fresh and tasty. I decided on The Tavern burger with sweet potato fries. The burger was delicious! It's served on a "meltaway" bun which basically is just a really soft and yummy bun. The sweet potato fries were good as well. Not soggy at all which seems to happen a lot with sweet potato fries. The boyfriend really enjoyed his meal as well but I'll let him tell you about that in his own review. :) Because the dinner was so good, I decided to order a dessert, too. I opted for the cinnamon bread pudding with vanilla gelato on top. It was also delish! It was the perfect amount of sweetness and comfort to end my meal. 

Service was quick and friendly, food was good, and the atmosphere was relaxing. We will definitely be back.

name: Customer_7298
comments:
I really enjoyed my mussels and the atmosphere in Tavern, but this place wasn't the homerun I expected. We had a 20 minute wait on a game day, so I thought that was very reasonable. Tavern has a ton of TVs, so it's great for watching a game. The bartenders were pretty quick to provide drinks as we waited, and the craft brew and cocktail menu is good. There isn't a very expansive selection, but what's available is diverse. The food is pretty stellar as well. My mussels were delicious and our nacho appetizer was great without any meat. Fresh jalapeños, black beans, and the perfect amount of cheese made them a delight. Our server is what missed the mark. She was courteous for sure, but her timing was really off. It took a while for us to order once seated and she altered between smothering us or ignoring the table. I also wasn't impressed with my friends' lamb tacos. The tacos come in an order of two or three, and this place seems to be stingy with the meat filling. I'd definitely recommend a side an order of three. 

All and all, I'd come back. This place is tasty, but it's not the pinnacle of dining.

name: Customer_6974
comments: Great place. Good food. Good prices, $30 for 2 people.  Good service. Too loud on the inside but perfect for sitting outside. Try the pretzel sandwich with fries.

name: Customer_7363
comments: ALERT: A must for brunch spot!!! I have been here several times now. The brunch time is SO busy but SO worth it! I reccomend the Red Velvet Waffles and the Blood Orange Mimosa. Another time I went for dinner I had a phenomenal Mahi sandwich with the white Sangria. Holy amazing. The service is great, just hectic during brunch.

name: Customer_9563
comments: Good drinks, good food and a great atmosphere! What more could you want? The drink menu is very extensive, good selection of scotch and cocktails. The food was very impressive as well. I tried the sweet potato fries with jalapeno mayo after seeing it suggested so much and I must say they delivered! This is a great place to hang out with friends and pass some time. Give it a try!

name: Customer_9247
comments:
Stopped in at lunch for THE Tavern Burger.  While it is the only burger on the menu, they provide many options for it.  While I didn't personally order it, a coworker got a cooked egg on it,  You can get it also with Grilled Onions or Bacon.

The burger is pretty sizable and also includes Belgian fries. I'm not sure exactly what they do to Begian-ize them, butt he were quite good.

We arrived at just a bit after 11 AM so it wasn't very busy yet. Parking could certainly be an issue though.

15 dollars for a burger might also be a bit pricier that a regular Joe or Jane is willing to pay, and it would be hard to argue.  It was however, quite delicious and filling.

I'm not sure what the dinner time crowd looks like, but at least for THE Burger I would be back.

name: Customer_6975
comments: Got to the resturant and gave the name under our reservation. They don't take reservations and don't know why open table lists them but they get that a lot. Hmm ok. Can you try to do something for us since it isn't our fault you haven't contacted open table? No, 1 hr wait. No problem, we will go next door for drinks. Get text from restaurant that let's you check status through wait for out....opentable. Hmmmm. Come back in an hr, get seated outside even though there are plenty of spaces inside. Fine. Drink wifey ordered was the best part of the experince. Can we order the cauliflower - no, we are out of our most popular item. Ok. Guac appetizer - made from half an avocado and a thousand chips. $12 Salad with ahi - 1 dimensional salad with 3 pieces of ahi. Ahi was good wish there was more of it. Salad had no diversity anything interesting $23 Chicken kabobs - supposed to be with ginger terriyaki and sesame and garlic. Only thing I could taste was terriyaki, very heavy handed. Nothing we ordered was beyond marginal...

name: Customer_5015
comments: I do not unjustly dole out bad reviews, however, i feel it my moral obligation to society to inform the masses of what lies within at tavern... i want to like this place, which took the spot formerly occupied by Lime, but after 3 visits i am left with the same impression: the best thing about this place is it's location/outdoor bar seating.  terrible mixed drinks ... (drink #1: facial toner, drink #2: salad dressing, drink #3: cough syrup)... definitely stick with beer or wine here. the food was ok. i had the turkey sandwich on pretzel bread and sweet potato fries - both were meh (and cold). food was much better when they first opened. sad when standards drop...   (i also had to valet park. then valet disappeared...  my keys ended up behind the bar. that's apparently where they keep them, incase you're looking. or still waiting for your keys.)

name: Customer_2531
comments: I really enjoyed this place. Very interesting menu, great drink selection, loved the decor/ambience and our kiwi bartender was great. I will definitely come back next time I am in town.

name: Customer_2821
comments: I'm usually a chilaquiles girl, so the Huevos Rancheros sounded sort of tempting with its eggs, tortillas and salsa combination. Now, huevos rancheros in general has never really appealed to me, but Tavern had me changing my tune. I have a feeling that no other restaurant's version of this dish will impress me as much as this one, but if you are in Nashville and you are at Tavern for brunch and you don't get the Huevos Rancheros.... you're making a HUGE mistake. One of the best brunch meals of my life y'all...

name: Customer_1747
comments:
3 stars for food and a 1/2 star for ambience/drink specials. Went here with a bunch of friends on a Wednesday night. The place was busy! They said our wait was about 30 min so we decided to go to the bar. 2 for 1 drink special!! Excellent! The drinks were pretty big and strong so it was a great deal. I got the tequila drink with blackberry and agave juice (can't remember the name). It was good!! We sat on the outdoor patio with our drinks while we waited for our name...it was perfect! 

The food was mehhh...I had the lamb tacos which were just ok. I felt like they needed to be more exciting...there was barely anything on them. I ordered 3 because I was pretty hungry, and it was the perfect size. My friend who got the burger loved it, so maybe I just had to order something else. Who knows. Overall I was underwhelmed. I have to eat gluten free (Celiac), and they did have a gluten free menu. It wasn't huge but enough options. However, they did have fried things on the gf menu that are NOT GF!! This is a huge pet peeve of mine...why put it on the gluten free menu if it's not?! So annoying. I would go back to this place for drinks only.

name: Customer_1309
comments:
5/5 drinks. 
5/5 food. The burger was so delicious, I'm glad I went with our server's direction. The Tuscan fries were an interesting side and the parmesan and red pepper was a great way to make it unique. 
3/5 the wait. You can get drinks at the bar while you wait, which helps soften the wait time, but be prepared to wait multiple hours on a popular night especially if you come at peak times with a group of people. 
5/5 service.

name: Customer_8234
comments: We walked in without a reservation on Father's Day  Sunday at 11 in the morning. We had a flight to catch at 3, so didn't have time to wait and luckily were able to sit at the bar right away. Looking at the menu didn't see anything that looked intriguing or exciting. I was upset that we may have been stuck with some boring brunch on our last day in Nashville. Oh my, was I wrong or what? I ordered the big daddy omelette and my husband got the Huevos Rancheros. I got a big omelet and I couldn't finish it. My omelette  was flavorful and the white trash hash was out of this world. I got a fried egg on top of my omelette. What else can you ask for? They also had buy one get one mimosa. Not sure if that was a Father's Day promotion or they do that every Sunday. We also ordered the red velvet waffle for dessert which sounded and looked creative but wasn't that impressive. Overall a great experience and definitely recommend it!!!

name: Customer_4766
comments: The pork chops were delicious. Yummy burger. Good beer and cocktail selection, nice decor. It was busy when we were there, so a little loud.

name: Customer_4739
comments: Went today with a group for brunch. We had no complaints. Great-cucumber Bloody Mary, coffee, lobster gumbo, grilled artichoke, white trash hash and service. The decor was tasteful and semi modern. I definitely felt like we left Nashville for a couple hours which was great! Will definitely be back!

name: Customer_8520
comments: great amosphere and wonderful food! highly reccomend but expect a long wait. well worth it though.

name: Customer_7462
comments:
Tavern is a great brunch place with a good vibe.  I love the sangeria because they top it off with Cava, sortof a sparkling sangeria...refreshing.  I like sitting at the bar because there can be a bit of a wait depending on when you get there.  And in my experience you always get better service at the bar.   
Parking can be hard around midtown so I would valet,  its free, just tip the poor guy!

name: Customer_5919
comments: On a girls trip to nashville the gentleman on the plane ride into town suggested this restaurant. We went during Brunch time on Saturday. Reasonable wait, but they text you when the table is ready. Everything was amazing. Highly suggest the stir-fry and tavern burger and obviously you have to try the white trash hash. Highly recommend for visitors and locals alike.

name: Customer_6867
comments:
Best place within walking distance from my hotel.  It's a pretty modern and happening place, with a cool feel to it.

I really was looking for a good salad, and was pleasantly surprised with my Junk Salad (romaine, salami, shrimp, olives, pepperoncini, hearts of palm, grape tomato, cucumber, blue cheese, champagne dijon vinaigrette).  This was a super tasty salad.

I came back 4 days later and had the burger and sweet potato ships.  Burger was pretty good, and my only complaint was that the chips were a little on the salty side.  Brush some of the salt off and it was good.

name: Customer_7445
comments: Got the turkey blt. Excellent! Service was a little slow but we weren't in a rush.

name: Customer_4855
comments: Great place. Good food. Good prices, $30 for 2 people.  Good service. Too loud on the inside but perfect for sitting outside. Try the pretzel sandwich with fries.

name: Customer_2373
comments: I love the atmosphere of this place. The bar is kind of open to the outside and it's a really unique, modern setup. The service was a bit slow for a half-full restaurant but the bartenders were very nice. I ordered the buffalo cauliflower and mussels. The mussels were delicious but the cauliflower was so spicy and overpowering that the spice hung in your mouth for so long that it kind of took away from the mussels. Overall would  definitely recommend a visit if you're staying in the midtown area, but would recommend trying a different appetizer than cauliflower.

name: Customer_9195
comments: Went for brunch on Saturday and was extremely pleased to discover 2-for-1 drinks! Our group tried pretty much one of each drink and were extremely happy with each, particularly the Wicked Bloody Mary. The atmosphere was great-- trendy but very relaxed. I had the Singapore Stir fry, which was so flavorful and a wonderful change from the usual breakfast fare. As I dont eat meat or cheese, breakfast can be a little boring and standard, but this was a delicious option that strayed from the ordinary. Others had two different omelet varieties and the eggs benedict uno, all of which made the table very happy and satisfied. Would definitely recommend for brunch.. My only wish would be that they had more vegetarian options. The bloody marys by far made up for that though!

name: Customer_2261
comments: So my girlfriend and I wanted to have a low key night. We went in around 8pmon a Friday night and the wait to get a table was about an hour. We decided to go to the bar and have a drink while we waited. A spot at the bar came open, so we took that instead. Good thing, because almost 2 hours in, they still wouldn't have called our name? At first I loved the crowd. It was a tad older. It was a nice "after work" 30 something crowd. NONE of the local "socialites" were there. However as midnight approached, that changed. It turned into the Virago/Whiskey Kitchen crowd. Which I know many people don't go to WK for that very reason. Onto food and drink. I had the Nacho's and my friend had the fried fish. Neither one of us were the least bit impressed with the food. She said her's was very bland and mine was not impressive at all. However she did give props to the spicy ketchup that comes with the fries! As for our drinks. Fancy names and high prices sum it up. I was brave and tried the "preserves" drink. I went with Gin and the pinapple and honey preserves .. i think that is what it was. It was very strong. The bartender told me that it would start to taste different with time. Um, no. It tasted like gin with a little jelly. I don't care how "new york" and trendy it is suppose to be (that is how it was described to me) it was gross. It was nice. A bigger Whiskey Kitchen is the best way to describe it. I'm sure I'll go back, but I will stick with drinks I know and try to leave before the pretentious crowd arrives. One other note. The manager kept coming over to us numerous times to make sure we were happy. I though that was nice!

name: Customer_3133
comments: The atmosphere is very clean, modern, and slightly upscale. They offer a brunch and a large selection of drinks. They are very packed for brunch though. Their brunch runs pretty late. I got there around 2pm and they said brunch was ending soon. Their brunch menu items cost around $10 each. Their normal dinner menu gets a little pricier, but you don't have to spend a lot of money here.

name: Customer_2746
comments:
I have seen various reviews on Tavern.  Some very negative.  Others slightly positive.  Most complimented the food but nothing spectacular. 

So, this past Friday night a few friends and I got together for dinner and I wanted to try some place new.  I put out a list of 3 new places (new to me anyway) I'd like to try - based upon the Menu.  I listed Red Pony in Franklin, Burger Up and Tavern.  I sent my friends links to the restaurants and ultimately we agreed that Tavern would be the place.  

We arrived at 7:30 and ended up having to wait an hour for a table and they don't take reservations.  That was fine.  We figured about anywhere we went on a Friday night at this point we would encounter a wait of similar length.  So, we waited and ordered a couple cocktails while we waited.  

This is probably the biggest downside of the restaurant.  They don't have a place for you to really wait.  The bar was jam packed and there was no seating up front.  There was seating outside on the patio - but no one was out there because it was raining and cold.  So, we stood inside near the door for an hour.  

When we were finally seated the server asked us if we needed any more drinks and if we wanted any appetizers.

We decided to go with the 'Bazooka" Guacamole Appetizer.  I pretty much hate Guacamole and never order it anywhere.  I've tried it several times many different places.  Never liked it.  But, this was supposed to be 'different' with some goat cheese and other stuff in it as well.  The presentation of the appetizer was very cool.  They bring it out in a 2-3" deep round cake pan lined with parchment or wax paper - I don't really remember.  Inside there is a glass jar with one of those hinged glass lids on top and its filled with this guacamole concoction.  They have a few chips out on the pan, however, there is also a small, brown paper bag with the logo of 'Tavern' on it - and it is filled with chips.  We took the small server spoon and each took a dollop of the guacamole and put it on a chip.  Wow!  Absolutely incredible.  I don't know if it qualifies as guacamole or not (I'm sure some purists would say it doesn't) - but whatever it is or whatever you want to call it - it was incredible.  I couldn't get enough.  We were scraping the bottom of the jar trying to get every last ounce of this wonderful, tasty spread.

Moving onto dinner two of us go the Tavern Burger.  This burger is made with Prime Rib and Filet.  2 excellent cuts of meat - ground up and made into a burger.  I had mine with White Cheddar and bacon and was incredible!  Everything was good.  The meat, the bacon, the cheese - even the bun was tasty.  My friend had his plain and loved it as well.  Both burgers were served with fries.  He had the regular fries - I had mine tossed in Parmesan and garlic.  Either way they were good.  Apparently they serve them several different ways.

Another friend got the 'Mama Sans Fried Chicken'.  He was blown away by how much food he got.  He also was surprised at how well the chicken went with the cold noodles he was served as the side.  He said the cold noodles were a good juxtaposition against the hot chicken. 

My other friend got the "Salad of Little Gems".  It looked a bit small to me but he claimed to really enjoy it.  As far as salads go it did look great.

The food was all served rather quickly but the pacing of the meal was on point.  The appetizer was served and finished well ahead of the meal making its way from the kitchen.  Too often I feel rushed and sometimes the appetizers and entree arrive within second of each other.  Sometimes even together!  I think the pacing of the meal was excellent.  Also, our server was great and our glasses were never empty.  She made sure we always had plenty to drink.

4 Cocktails, 4 entree's, 1 appetizer = $94 bucks after tax and everything.  So, around 20 bucks a person for a night out.  

So, to review:

Long wait - no place to really sit.  They DO take your phone number and will call you when your table is ready so you can make your way back to the restaurant.

Service was excellent.  Drinks were never empty.  Pacing of meal was great from the appetizer to the main course.

Price was fine.  We could have eaten for less if we didn't get cocktails, appetizers AND the main course.  If we'd just had water and our meal - we would have spent a lot less.  The cocktails were pricy - but pretty stout.  They didn't skimp on the alcohol for sure.

I think it was wonderful and we are already planning our next trip!  I think you should too.

name: Customer_2868
comments:
I decided I wanted to spend my birthday in Nashville, and I was ultimately excited about finding the perfect spot for brunch. I spent tons of time reading through Yelp reviews trying to find the perfect location and finally narrowed it down to the Tavern.

We arrived a few minutes before they opened on a Sunday and were immediately directed to a table. Our waitress recommended the Tavern Tuscan Fries which were good and the portion was huge for two people. I loved the 2-for-1 drinks, and the Bellini Sparkle was my favorite. I ordered the Singapore Stir Fry which was delicious and was recommended by our waitress. 

Tavern definitely met my expectations, and I can't wait to make another visit for lunch or dinner.

name: Customer_1128
comments: Came here during a recent trip to Nashville. Came here a couple years ago for brunch which was amazing but a super long wait so beware. Didn't realize when I picked this place this time that they also do a 2 for 1 drink special from 2-10pm on Wednesday nights. This is a great deal but makes the night a lot busier. I was with an older group of people so they personally didn't like how much noise was going on in the restaraunt. In terms of food I do feel like it's a little overpriced for what you get. But I will say the mahi-mahi tacos were tasty. I would definitely come back on future trips to Nashville. And if they take reservations I will do that instead.

name: Customer_1227
comments: The pork chops were delishous. Yummy burger. Good beer and cocktail selection, nice decor. It was busy when we were there, so a little loud.

name: Customer_1992
comments: Good fun place, appetizers are fun, and different! Place is always full of nice people, good energy. Great for large or small groups. Fun times!

name: Customer_1316
comments:
Went to Tavern for the first time last night after hearing many of my friends rave about it. Got there at 6 p.m. for a friend's birthday gathering and it was not crowded then. We had a big group and the staff was accommodating about our taking two of the big booths in the bar and spilling out in the aisle. 

The wine list is very modest but I found something that worked. Service was good. Now, I gotta say, the server didn't seem like she loves her job - she didn't look all that happy about serving us, but she was timely and checked back often, so who am I to complain? 

I didn't order food myself, but grazed off my friends' appetizers. The nachos with 'angry chicken' were really, really good. I've never met a nacho I didn't like, but these rank in the top two or three I've ever had. I was suspicious about the guacamole - who puts goat cheese and pistachios in guac? Why gild the lily? But once I picked off the nuts and cheese, the guac was also superlative: had a really nice garlicky kick. 

There wasn't a whole lot on the menu that didn't look appealing, so I am looking forward to going back soon and having a real meal. On the whole, I like it a lot better than its sister, Whiskey Kitchen.

name: Customer_4026
comments: I really must admit, I am a fan of some tavern CUISINE. Lets start with the guacamole.... (which is laced with pistachios and goat cheese mind you) i would say...TO DIE FOR. The fish taco's are SIMPLY divine, and could quite possibly be my very favorite in all of Nashville. the Perogies are delish and add a nice touch to the menu... ( i hale from North Eastern Pennsylvania where this particular dish is a standard and i was not disappointed) The Shishito Peppers are perfect.... The Salads are fresh and refreshing... I can not wait to return and sample some more tasty delights.

name: Customer_1087
comments: My vegan friend had the kale salad and loved it. I had one of the taco options -- pretty good too. Wine list was short but reasonably priced. Service was friendly. Better than many of the other options near campus.

name: Customer_4684
comments: A good place. Kind of on the loud side, but a nice place. Fried chicken skins were superior. Rest of food was good and waitress was fairly attentive and kind of tuned in. Not a place to go if you're in a hurry.

name: Customer_3622
comments: Place was awesome! Went here for my birthday & I had a large party of 12, they included gratuity with the bill. But the waitress was very nice! Good music & environment. I will definitely be coming to this place again!!!

name: Customer_8032
comments: Dark wood, open warm space and welcoming service. It seems the owners of Tavern have their hand on the pulse of the Vandy area. The patio cushioned banquet seating perfect for people watching. The patio is open and inviting, the interior is spacious and bustling. I had wine, chicken tacos and Yukon truffle chips. I must say the chips were my favorite, perfect for trying all the sauces on the table. They were warm and crispy. The tacos were a bit tough and chewy. I will defiantly be back to conquer that burger! Chow!

name: Customer_3812
comments: Tavern is a local food hangout with nightly live country music. Our country music singer was from Australia but she has Nashville voice. It shows the love of county music is universal.

name: Customer_9015
comments: Tavern is a local food hangout with nightly live country music. Our country music singer was from Australia but she has Nashville voice. It shows the love of county music is universal.

name: Customer_9284
comments: Looks, from the street, like it would be good, but it was just okay. Our waitress pretty much forgot about us the entire time we were there. Not sure what that was all about. We tried practicing mindfulness to make the time pass while we were waiting for her to come back out and take our order. My nachos were disappointing--basically felt like a slice of cheese was melted over chips with globs of black beans. The kale salad was a warm mound of wilted kale mixed with parm cheese. My son liked his burger, so that was good.

name: Customer_6953
comments: Great atmosphere. Amazing burgers. The heart of Nashville in food. Would definitely come again and recommend to friends visiting Nashville.

name: Customer_2692
comments: This was our first stop in Nashville. The brunch drinks were 2 for 1 (probably because the average wait time on a sat morning is 2 hours). We waited at the bar and had some of the most delicious brunch cocktails! The white trash hash and red velvet waffle were well worth the 2 hour wait! When in Nashville this is a MUST!

name: Customer_7085
comments: I've been here twice now, and the food is always great and the service is decent. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the food takes a while to come out, even when it's not super busy. I've gotten the fish tacos (they are HUGE), burgers, fries (also huge portions), and goat cheese and pistachio guacamole. Like I said, the food is always very good, but if you're coming on a weekend, be prepared for a very long wait. It has a super hip atmosphere and you'll find a lot of twenty-somethings there.

name: Customer_1566
comments: Short rib tacos ruled! The sweet potato fries were an awesome starter. Our server Lindsay was amazing. Kept our glasses full the whole time and checked up on us constantly! Good vibe and they had the game on which in the playoffs is always a good thing! I'd go back again! Maybe take mom and dad to this joint!

name: Customer_7131
comments: Ordered to go through Uber Eats. Great burger and fries. A little pricey but the to go containers made it worth it. 4 stars only bc it was a little cold by time it got to my house. Will order again soon.

name: Customer_6531
comments:
This place is awesome!  We stumbled upon it after checking into our hotel...we wanted to walk around after being in the car for 9 hours and we were starving.  We got a table outside, it was loud, but what do you expect on a Friday night in early summer?
The food was great....I got the Nuevo Israeli bread salad and my husband got the turkey blt (with sweet potato chips (YUMMMM)--both fantastic.  
They have an extensive drink/beer list and the staff is knowledgeable about the beer they serve and didn't steer my husband wrong.  
Would recommend trying this place out if you haven't already.

name: Customer_3166
comments: I've never been to an M Street restaraunt before, for those of you who are not familiar with M Street they are the zany people who bring us restaraunt concepts such as Kayne Prime (on my bucket list,) Virago and Moto (also on my bucket list.) So on Wednesday night we visited Tavern, which is self-described as "a pub for chefs." Valet parking at this location is a must and they were prompt and efficient. There was plenty of porch seating available as well as being used - Nashvillians do love their porches. The inside of the restaraunt had a rustic feel and it seemed as though the bar top was inhabited by business class regulars. That having been said I could easily picture the bar at 12 midnight being inhabited by waitrons and people with checkered pants, it would be a great place to have some concept drinks and small plates after a busy restaraunt shift. I ordered the Korean short rib tacos - I definitely got the red pepper forward taste as well as the cool of the cucumber and cilantro. I would order it again. Delivery time was about 13 minutes, a good ticket time. It's very evident that these people are "on their game," I will be returning to try other items on their menu. And one day I will visit Kayne Prime, I might splurge for that on my father's birthday. Visit Tavern, have fun!

name: Customer_4776
comments:
Went here for a Saturday morning brunch and it wasn't that bad! 

Cons: the wait is crazy long (over an hour), the lighting is a bit dark, the music and atmosphere is crazy loud so prepare to scream your conversations, the drinks (specifically the mimosa) wasn't that strong and the food was good but average.

Pros: It's a nice trendy spot with fun music that you'll want to sing along to (especially after drinks). The staff was very attentive and friendly! And the prices aren't that bad (for downtown).

All in all it was a nice experience, but don't think I'll be in a hurry to go back.

name: Customer_1942
comments:
Tavern is probably one of the better brunch places in Nashville IF (and only if) you go with friends. This is not the place to go for a brunch date or to go with any person that you actually want to have a conversation with.

Both times that my wife and I have gone (once by ourselves, and the other time with some friends) the music has been extremely loud - like to the point where we have been yelling just to hear each other. Not kidding. Look, I like my music loud... and their playlist was actually on point (late 90's/early 2000's hits)... but going out to eat is a social experience. Part of sharing a meal is enjoying the company of the people you're with. Don't blast music in my face and force me to lean in just to hear what the person next to me is saying. C'mon. 

On to the food! It's GREAT. I highly recommend the Benedict Uno - a short rib benedict topped with tabasco-infused hollandaise. Wow. So much amazing flavor in every bite. I savored it right down to the end. I also recommend the maple fondue if you're with a group. It's a fun dish to share and has assorted fruits and some french toast and sausage... all to be dipped in a delicious warm maple syrup mixture. Can't go wrong. Also, don't sleep on the 2-for-1 libations. The blood orange mimosa and the red sangria are my favorites (although the last time I went, I just doubled up on the sangria... easily my favorite).

This place deserves respect for the quality of food they put out and their decent pricing (average about $12-$15 per entree). The only things that keep this from being a 4-star review are the noise level, the lack of parking (bring cash because you will need to use the valet), and the fact that you will undoubtedly have a wait. When we went with our friends, we got their 10 minutes after they opened and were told there was a 20-30 minute wait. We ended up actually waiting almost an hour. Not really a complaint, since you have to factor in a wait at popular places... but still. Just a warning - you will have a wait.

Give this place a shot if you like good food for brunch, just go in knowing that there are some pitfalls with this place.

name: Customer_3193
comments:
Lots of good options in this area and the tavern is definitely one of them.  I came here for drinks one night and lunch during the day.   A bit of a wait for dinner so make sure you get a reservation if you can.

We got an appetizer - buffalo cauliflower.  It's slightly breaded and engulfed in buffalo sauce.  Good taste, but would've preferred to have it a bit crispier.  

Ordered the burger - cooked medium, lettuce, tomato, American (cheese is extra).  The fries were okay - comes in a little fryer basket.  The burger had a good sear on the outside and properly seasoned with salt.  

Good spot for food and drinks.

name: Customer_7089
comments: Amazing bloody Mary's! We went there yesterday and their "brunch" was between 10-3 and consisted of 2 for 1 bloody Mary's. The place was packed and had to sit outside. Would recomand they actually turn the heat lamps on when it's 35 degrees out! Get here early to get a seat! We didn't try the food but the menu looked great.

name: Customer_5394
comments: Amazing bloody Mary's! We went there yesterday and their "brunch" was between 10-3 and consisted of 2 for 1 bloody Mary's. The place was packed and had to sit outside. Would recommend they actually turn the heat lamps on when it's 35 degrees out! Get here early to get a seat! We didn't try the food but the menu looked great.

name: Customer_2602
comments: Truly not worth the wait. I've tried a couple dishes and nothing has been great- wouldn't really recommend. Almost everything I have tried has either been too dry or too salty. The ambiance is nice but it's pretty slow. The only good food item is their fries.

name: Customer_8890
comments: Was in Nashville this past weekend with some friends. Decided to try this place as it was close to where we were staying. The place is very quaint on the inside. Dark lighting, the type of spot that could suffice a first date, a work event or a family get together. My friend and I showed up around 3pm and strangely there was a ten minute wait (Which is weird, because it's that awkward time in between lunch and dinner, but whatever.) Our server is super friendly and attentive. I order the pan seared tuna with a side of the sweet potato fries with jalapeno ketchup. My friend orders the tavern burger. Our food comes. I take a bite of my tuna and it appears raw, almost entirely uncooked. I try again and can't bare it. The waiter has no problem swapping my order for the salmon which is very kind of him. My friend appears to enjoy the burger. The fries are fine-- not seven dollar side worthy fine, but decent enough. The jalapeno ketchup tastes like regular ketchup. The salmon doesn't particularly taste like fish (almost like an overly marinated chicken, which wouldn't be a bad thing if it wasn't brought under the guise of fish) but I run through it because I'm starved. We pay and the meal for me was at its best below average. Especially for the cost. Naturally the evening/early morning hits and I've got all types of food poisoning and stomach bug type issues (diarrhea, nauseous, headache, puking.) This was Monday morning/ Sunday evening. It's now Thursday and I'm still ill. Not quite sure how these people are cleaning their meats, but I won't be back anytime soon. Nice, attentive staff and sweet vibe. Food was awful.

name: Customer_7975
comments: I am now obsessed with Tavern. I'm from out of town and was just in for the weekend, but it was the best meal I have had in awhile (the smoked salmon Benedict w the hash). The hash was unreal! Everyone loved their meals, as well as the great drink specials (buy one get one). The sangria was great on a Saturday morning patio and our server Melissa was so so sweet! Amazing service plus an amazing personality and delicious food. I wish I lived in Nashville so I could eat here weekly. Enjoy it! Cheers!

name: Customer_9733
comments:
I don't get it. 4 and 5-start reviews abound, and the weekend brunch line is absurd, but I'd have to describe my experience at Tavern as "just okay."

I went here on a Sunday morning ambigudate a month ago. We managed to get bar seating after waiting about 10 minutes, which seemed pretty good compared to the lengthy wait for a real table. The place was bustling, but we didn't have to wait too long to get in our drink orders. That said, while I love deals--and 2-for-1 mimosas and the like qualify--I wasn't bowled over. It tasted like a cheap cava and was heavy on the orange juice.

I ordered a burger while my dining companion decided to go with the traditional brunch. My burger was decent but not mouthwateringly amazing, which makes it a far cry from many of the reviews claiming this to be the "best burger in Nashville." Similarly, despite the attempts to make the brunch fare a bit fancier, I wasn't bowled over by any of the flavors.

While the prices aren't crazy expensive, they aren't cheap either. Overall I'd describe Tavern as "fine." I'd have no qualms about returning, but the foodie within me doesn't get the hype. 

Nashville, just because something is dressed up to look fancy and act fancy doesn't mean it's *actually* fancy.

name: Customer_2734
