comments: Looks, from the street, like it would be good, but it was just okay. Our waitress pretty much forgot about us the entire time we were there. Not sure what that was all about. We tried practicing mindfulness to make the time pass while we were waiting for her to come back out and take our order. My nachos were disappointing--basically felt like a slice of cheese was melted over chips with globs of black beans. The kale salad was a warm mound of wilted kale mixed with parm cheese. My son liked his burger, so that was good.

name: Customer_5438
comments: The kale salad is excellent. The rest of the food was ok. Far too expensive I'd you ask me for the sports bar type atmosphere, mediocre food and almost bad cocktail. The waitress come by and asked us if we liked the food about 14 times in our hour dinner and took our plates away the second we finished it which I thought was way too aggressive.

name: Customer_9477
comments: Great vegetarian options (I got the Buffalo cauliflower - amazing), healthy options (chopped kale salad with almonds and dried blueberries with light dressing), as well as favorites like tacos, nachos, fried chicken and burgers. Lots of tvs but also more secluded tables. Would definately come back!

name: Customer_5117
comments: I could eat the blue cheese fondue on almost anything. I bet liver would taste good in that fondue. Fortunately I had some really good buffalo cauliflower to go along with and I hasten to say it was a top 5 all time appetizer ever.People rave about the fries and they were good but not the best I have had. The Tavern burger on the other-hand may be the best burger I have ever had. Made from ground rib-eye and filet makes me believe God made the burger lol The lobster sliders were really good but 22 bucks not that good. The mushroom soup had to be made by Angels it was amazing. Its a little pricey but you definitely get what you pay for, for the most part. As a whole it may be the best lunch ever. I give very few 5 stars on average and this was well earned. The place is nice and cozy and the staff were great. It was a religious experince involving food.

name: Customer_1121
comments:
I love Tavern. They have exceptional cocktails, killer food, and an ambiance that can't be beat! I foresee many a dollar of mine being spent here....

It gets VERY busy, and on Sunday when I stopped in with a friend it was no exception. Luckily, there were two seats at the bar, so we snagged them and sat down. After drooling over another customer's plate of mussels, I decided I had to get them. White wine with bacon, leeks, and a piece of "dippy" bread? Um score. My friend had the chicken chimichanga, and it was cheesy but still full of flavor and amazing! 

But let's talk cocktails, something that really gets my engine running and Tavern hit the mark.

The red sangria was pre-mixed and topped off with some bubbly. It was a good sangria, but not over the top good. However, my balsamic martini with stoli, strawberry puree, and a splash of balsamic syrup?? Creative and delicious! I will be ordering the drink again and again! The bellini sparkle was not in a tiny champagne flute, it was in a tumbler and was refreshing. My friend couldn't stop ordering the cucumber, apple, and elderflower cocktail. Be warned, it is very strong! 

I was worried our service would be poor because they only had 2 bartenders for the entire bar, but it wasn't. They were attentive and sure to check up on us and get our orders in. They also have some incredible outdoor seating areas, and enjoying a cocktail on a nice day here is heaven. 

Thanks for the good times Tavern, I can't wait to see you again!

name: Customer_7262
comments: First and foremost, this place is worth the wait. If you are planning to eat here, and didn't come before opening, expect at least a 20-30 minute wait if you're lucky. We got here right when the doors opened and only had to wait 20 minutes to get seated. The food is everything it's hyped up to be, and the service was really great. So, as said earlier, this place is worth the wait.

name: Customer_9894
comments: Service and food was excellent!! Personal favorite is the beef short rib tacos washed down with a gluten-free beer.

name: Customer_6224
comments: Great place to watch sports and try the good food selection. Brunch is great on the weekend and have something special always. Just get ready for the line so my ght as well get a spot on the bar or wait forever.

name: Customer_4007
comments: Was not too much a fan of some of the food. The Lamb was not lamb have no clue why it was. However the staff is very nice and the drinks were great.

name: Customer_7647
comments: Great place. Good food. Good prices, $30 for 2 people.  Good service. Too loud on the inside but perfect for sitting outside. Try the pretzel sandwich with fries.

name: Customer_3953
comments: Fantastic brunch, bloody Mary's and blood orange mimosas were superb. The Red Velvet waffles, cheddar cheese, chorizo and gravy biscuits were great too and you must try the huevos rancheros, they will not disappoint. The service was also great.

name: Customer_5709
comments: Tavern is a local food hangout with nightly live country music. Our country music singer was from Australia but she has Nashville voice. It shows the love of county music is universal.

name: Customer_5297
comments:
I've been to Tavern a variety of times since it opened and have had a lot of fun trying their dishes.  Really delish food and great atmosphere.

For brunch, my favorite would be the Singapore Stir Fry - yum!!  I also love their brunch drinks - my two favs are the Bellini Sparkle and the Blood Orange Mimosa

Lunch/Dinner: The Bucket of Mussels, Mahi Sandwich, and the Tuscan Kale & Parmesan Salad

Dessert: hands down the S'mores - had some out of town guests in recently and took them just for s'mores and drinks late night, and it was such a blast - I felt like a kid roasting marshmellows all over again but in a much classier manner :)

Late night weekends is also really fun at Tavern with the music, but definitely hard to hold a conversation with anyone if you are eating during that time.

name: Customer_1307
comments: We stumbled onto this resturant after seeing the very long line at Hattie B's. The atmosphere seemed really nice and the wait for a table much more manageable-only 10 minutes. The menu choices were appealing and we put in an order for two burgers, fries, a fish sandwich and trail salad. Then we waited, and waited and waited some more. Fifty minutes later our food still did not arrive with no real explanation (or apology) from our server. The manager was pleasant and after she was alerted our food did arrive. The burgers were tasty as were the Belgian fries. The trail mix salad had too many dried cranberries for my liking making it much too sweet. I think with a different server the experience may have been more positive, but with so many great restaurants in Nashville I won't be going back to find out.

name: Customer_3626
comments: If you think you are walking into a typical bar menu .... think again! Wonderful, original recipes. I had a kale salad, guacamole and chicken wings. All awesome with non conventional ingredients (finally chopped kale with parmesan cheese, nuts, lemon). Guacamole with pistachio nuts and goat cheese! Who would have thought!! Really good!

name: Customer_7848
comments:
3 stars for food and a 1/2 star for ambience/drink specials. Went here with a bunch of friends on a Wednesday night. The place was busy! They said our wait was about 30 min so we decided to go to the bar. 2 for 1 drink special!! Excellent! The drinks were pretty big and strong so it was a great deal. I got the tequila drink with blackberry and agave juice (can't remember the name). It was good!! We sat on the outdoor patio with our drinks while we waited for our name...it was perfect! 

The food was mehhh...I had the lamb tacos which were just ok. I felt like they needed to be more exciting...there was barely anything on them. I ordered 3 because I was pretty hungry, and it was the perfect size. My friend who got the burger loved it, so maybe I just had to order something else. Who knows. Overall I was underwhelmed. I have to eat gluten free (Celiac), and they did have a gluten free menu. It wasn't huge but enough options. However, they did have fried things on the gf menu that are NOT GF!! This is a huge pet peeve of mine...why put it on the gluten free menu if it's not?! So annoying. I would go back to this place for drinks only.

name: Customer_4739
comments: I am now obsessed with Tavern. I'm from out of town and was just in for the weekend, but it was the best meal I have had in awhile (the smoked salmon Benedict w the hash). The hash was unreal! Everyone loved their meals, as well as the great drink specials (buy one get one). The sangria was great on a Saturday morning patio and our server Melissa was so so sweet! Amazing service plus an amazing personality and delicious food. I wish I lived in Nashville so I could eat here weekly. Enjoy it! Cheers!

name: Customer_3402
comments:
5/5 drinks. 
5/5 food. The burger was so delicious, I'm glad I went with our server's direction. The Tuscan fries were an interesting side and the parmesan and red pepper was a great way to make it unique. 
3/5 the wait. You can get drinks at the bar while you wait, which helps soften the wait time, but be prepared to wait multiple hours on a popular night especially if you come at peak times with a group of people. 
5/5 service.

name: Customer_4277
comments: The pork chops were delicous. Yummy burger. Good beer and cocktail selection, nice decor. It was busy when we were there, so a little loud.

name: Customer_7362
comments: Food and service was great! Try the BLT and the egg rolls! The drinks are so good as well.

name: Customer_5112
comments: Great spot to come to if your in Nashville. The have one the best drink deals you can find on thursdays and Saturday's and Sunday's. Food is okay.

name: Customer_1323
comments: Tavern is a great place to grab a late night bite. The menu has a lot of variety. I really enjoy the kale salad and all their fries. The s'mores dessert is also really fun and unique! Definitely worth checking out if you're in midtown Nashville.

name: Customer_1674
comments: Terrible wait (unnecessary), average service, above average prices, and excruciating wait for food. Find someplace else. There's lots to choose from.

name: Customer_5379
comments: Waited 1.5 hours in the bar next door to eat at this overhyped egg factory. Not worth it what so ever. Go to Hattie bs or princes and skip it.

name: Customer_6492
comments: Great atmosphere. Amazing burgers. The heart of Nashville in food. Would definitely come again and recommend to friends visiting Nashville.

name: Customer_1176
comments: Short rib tacos ruled! The sweet potato fries were an awesome starter. Our server Lindsay was amazing. Kept our glasses full the whole time and checked up on us constantly! Good vibe and they had the game on which in the playoffs is always a good thing! I'd go back again! Maybe take mom and dad to this joint!

name: Customer_4241
comments: Got the turkey blt. Excellent! Service was a little slow but we weren't in a rush.

name: Customer_1052
comments: Solid brunch spot! Got there at peak time and the wait was less than what they thought. In the interim we sat on the padded benches outside. The place was packed but they seemed to turn it over and get people in and out quick. The bazooka guacamole was very good but the star of the show was the chorizo gravy on the biscuits. The spicy chicken sausage is aptly named as it packs a punch. I love hot food so it was perfect for me. My fiancé said it was at the limit of her spice scale so normal people may find it too much. She has the pretzel pancakes which are pancakes with pretzels on top covered in syrup. It wasn't what we expected but was good. Something about biting into a pretzel and it not having any crunch doesn't feel right but that may just be us. The girl with us had the pain Perdu and couldn't finish it but said it was good. We will for sure make our way back here as we each tried to decide between 3 different dishes so I look forward to having tried them all.

name: Customer_5389
comments: I literally had the best grilled salmon of my life here! This place is amazing. The food is extremely good. My husband had chimichanga and he is also very happy  with his food. The service was great too. I can't recommend this place more!

name: Customer_1262
comments:
Let's start off with positives, on a Saturday night around 8pm we didn't have a wait and the restaurant looked very nice an upscale sports bar basically. The service was good and the server was very attentive until the end when we wanted our check.

I ordered the fish tacos. The tacos were extremely small and did not have a lot of fish or anything else. We ordered the buffalo cauliflower which was very good. We also ordered the chicken skewers which tasted average but once again a smaller portion. Somebody else at the table ordered the Tavern burger which looked really good (even though they forgot the bacon), she said it was delicious.

name: Customer_7726
comments: Cute restaurant and great location. Service was poor. Waitress took 15 minutes to greet us and get our drink orders. Would have been okay, but she had slight attitude the rest of the night and made us seem more like a burden. Food was good. Not great, but good! Also, it was uncomfortably chilly, so bring a jacket.

name: Customer_5291
comments: The kale salad is life changing. This restaurant is a bit pricey but it's such a good go-to spot that I can't really complain. I haven't had the brunch but I've heard it's delish. The sweet potato fries are good too but share them!

name: Customer_8657
comments:
Oh hell yeah!!  Came in for a simple burger and fries.  

Great food! Even better service!  

Will definitely be a stop on any trip to Nashville.

Make sure you try the Tuscany fries!

name: Customer_2100
comments: Went to Tavern for brunch on Saturday morning and fell in love! We got there a few minutes before 10, when they open, and were seated right away. This is definitely the way to do it, because 30 minutes later, there was already a long wait. I ordered the Singapore Stir-Fry ($9.50) and was totally happy with it. Rice stir-fried with bacon and green onion, with a perfectly cooked over-easy egg. My only complaint was that it was a little bit on the salty side, likely due to the stir-fry sauce combined with the bacon. But if you're okay with salty food, I would definitely recommend it! I cannot wait to go back to Tavern and try other brunch menu items because everything on the menu sounded so delicious and creative!

name: Customer_9470
comments: Just stopped in for drinks. Staff was great, never felt rushed. Food passing by smelt and looked awesome. May be coming back tomorrow.

name: Customer_6952
comments:
Good: The food was fantastic. We had a large group (10+) and came here for brunch (and drinks, natch). I had the eggs benedict with short ribs, and loved it. From what I can tell, the rest of the group all enjoyed their dishes as well, from the fried rice breakfast dish to the nachos to the AMAZING peanut butter pancakes. As a starter/side, do not under any circumstances pass up on the "white trash hash" - hasbrowns with white cheddar cheese. YUM.

Bad: The wait was ludicrous. Yes, it was a Saturday, and yes, we had a large group, but Christ Almighty. We waited at the bar (standing room only) for over two hours before being seated. Even if we had split into smaller groups, without a reservation, the wait time would've still been close to an hour and a half. Yikes.

name: Customer_8209
comments: Absolutely awesome menu, the beer selection was fantastic and most importantly, Emily did a fantastic job taking care of us. I had the pork chop and loved it! Others at the table had the chimichanga, the Son of a Brown Bag and the Loco, all very well reviewed. Highly reccomend this place that's in a great area of town.

name: Customer_8788
comments:
I waited a couple days before rating to try to be fair. This place was recommended and hyped separately to me and my husband in transit and upon arrival to Nashville. We expected a lot. 
The service was great. We sat at the bar, both bartenders and food service were polite and attentive. Drink selection and quality and price seemed good. The food is another story. It is over priced and over hyped by reviewers.
My husband had the OZ pot pie. Even with a healthy dose of the curry sauce, it was dry. And plain, could barely taste the curry. I had korean short rib tacos. Nothing korean about them. I tasted sriracha and soy sauce. Isn't  Korean about gochujang? Meat was dry.  The fries are house cut, plentiful and phenomenal. But the rest of the menu is overpriced ignorance.

name: Customer_1764
comments: This place is amazing! In every way! Great location, great ambiance & atmosphere. The people there, especially our bartender Sarah, were super nice and helpful. She was great! But.... the food. Oh wow the food. Best burger I've ever had ever! If they ask you if you want to upgrade your fries to he seasoned ones (for a mere 50¢) say YES YES YES. Those things are sprinkled with crack, I swear. So good. And the garlic aioli is no joke. The beer list is awesome. Lots of local options. And 2-4-1's on Wednesdays of things like Jack Daniels, other liquors, wine, and some mixed drinks (libations). great place! We'll be back every time we're in Nashville.

name: Customer_3771
comments:
We went here for dinner last night with our Yelp Elite spring break friends and the food was great. I ordered a burger medium well with white cheddar, and I substituted for the Tennessee sweet potato fries with the garlic aioli which were fantastic.

My friend got a Jalapeño-infused strawberry margarita, which was yummy, as well as the chimichangas, which were also very good. The chimichangas were soft, rather than deep fried, which was interesting.

I will say that they don't do any happy hour specials here, which was disappointing. I got an angry orchard cider in a can, which I had never seen before because usually I get bottles, and it was $5.50 which is a little expensive.

Food was great though like I said, and food prices were reasonable.

name: Customer_7923
comments: Was not too much a fan of some of the food. The Lamb was not lamb have no clue why it was.  However the staff is very nice and the drinks were great.

name: Customer_7670
comments: Food and service was great! Try the BLT and the egg rolls! The drinks are so good as well.

name: Customer_1242
comments: Yum! Mussels are excellent---get extra bread for dipping. Order small plates and share to try lots if items. Kale salad is very good but a small is enough for two people to share since the flavors are unique --- good balance among Parmesan, citrus and cranberries. Guacamole is indeed yummy and lobster hush puppies are a great twist on soul food. Jalapeño ketchup has a nice kick. Shortrib tacos are good, dependable food. They won't knock your socks off, but you won't be sorry. Drinks: 1920 is a little more bitter than I anticipated, but still good. Existentialist is very refreshing as a summer drink.

name: Customer_7859
comments: Not much to say that hasn't been said.  I had the burger, which I suspect they use truffle oil on, and it was very tasty, along with an order of the philly cheesesteak eggrolls (you only get 2 for 10 bucks).  My only critique of the food was that the eggrolls had this thick, doughy wrapping that reminded me of some of the really cheap egg rolls I used to eat at my high school cafeteria.  Pretty happenin' place, though.

name: Customer_1099
comments:
I've been to Tavern a variety of times since it opened and have had a lot of fun trying their dishes.  Really delish food and great atmosphere.

For brunch, my favorite would be the Singapore Stir Fry - yum!!  I also love their brunch drinks - my two favs are the Bellini Sparkle and the Blood Orange Mimosa

Lunch/Dinner: The Bucket of Mussels, Mahi Sandwich, and the Tuscan Kale & Parmesan Salad

Dessert: hands down the S'mores - had some out of town guests in recently and took them just for s'mores and drinks late night, and it was such a blast - I felt like a kid roasting marshmellows all over again but in a much classier manner :)

Late night weekends is also really fun at Tavern with the music, but definitely hard to hold a conversation with anyone if you are eating during that time.

name: Customer_3584
comments:
We went here for dinner last night with our Yelp Elite spring break friends and the food was great. I ordered a burger medium well with white cheddar, and I substituted for the Tennessee sweet potato fries with the garlic aioli which were fantastic.

My friend got a Jalapeño-infused strawberry margarita, which was yummy, as well as the chimichangas, which were also very good. The chimichangas were soft, rather than deep fried, which was interesting.

I will say that they don't do any happy hour specials here, which was disappointing. I got an angry orchard cider in a can, which I had never seen before because usually I get bottles, and it was $5.50 which is a little expensive.

Food was great though like I said, and food prices were reasonable.

name: Customer_1315
comments: We stopped here for lunch/dinner and wasn't disappointed.   We was seated and served drinks promptly. Had a difficult time deciding what to order cause everything looked delicious.  I ordered the brown bag meal.  Which is a thick cut grilled bologna and over-easy egg sandwich with homemade potato hips, with truffle oil.

name: Customer_3943
comments: Jalepeno margaritas. Grilled artichokes. Mac and cheese. Amazing.

name: Customer_9691
comments: Tavern has a nice variety of healthy options. They have a large section titled "yolks" which consists of the many different and funky ways you can serve an egg (we had one with salmon in an omelette and it was delicious). We also had the "trail mix" which consisted of bulgur, quinoa, and other healthy perks... a great way to start the morning. 2/1 brunch libations - I would recommend the Cucumber Mary.

name: Customer_2234
comments: Tavern (used to be Lime, which has moved) is great! It is an M Street restaraunt, along with Whiskey Kitchen, Virago and (their "crown jewel") Kanye Prime steakhouse. First of all, I love the location. It's right on Broadway - near Patterson, 12th South, Red Door, etc. Second, it's trendy enough without feeling overly pretentious. I dig the layout - there are two outdoor seating area options (which we didn't do because of the cicadas), and the inside is very well done. There are TV's all over the place, the bar is stocked, and there is a decent amount of tables. Third, the service (for us) was very good. Granted, we went on the Sunday before Memorial Day - so it was relatively empty, but still. Our server was attentive, but not overly so where you feel like you couldn't enjoy your meal in peace. And forth, the cuisine. I would describe their menu as all over the place goodness. :) It's so varied, but it all sounds great. APPS: We've heard many good things about the guacamole, so we tried it: The Bazooka Guacamole - with avocado, goat cheese and pistachio. I liked the creaminess of the guac, but wanted more spice / flavor. Luckily for me there were three different hot sauces available labeled as X, XX, and XXX. Yum. (PS - there is also homemade BBQ sauce.) A lot of other app options sounded great, too. We'll probably try something else next time like the Lobster Hushpuppies or the Eggrolls. ENTREES: I was so overwhelmed with the variety on their menu, that last minute I went for the Tavern Burger with White Cheddar - and I switched the Belgian Fries for the Tennessee Fries (sweet potato with jalapeno ketchup.) . The fries were great, and the burger was one of the best burgers in N'ville. My husband was deciding between three completely difference options as well: The Basket of Fish, the Nachos with Pork or one of the Taco options. Like me, he ordered last minute and got the Pork Nachos. I doubt he would have if he had thought about it for even a second since we already ordered the guac which came with a bag of chips...but c'est la vie. They were delish. LIBATIONS: Some of their drinks were pricey, some were reasonable. Just be cautious when you order because your bill could add up quickly if you get the specialty cocktails... I got a $7 glass of wine, and my husband got a beer for $4.75. Comparing Tavern to similar places, it seemed okay to me. :) LATE NIGHT: From 11PM to 1AM they have a late night menu. WEDNESDAYS: 2-4-1's. I'll be returning to Tavern for sure.

name: Customer_1091
comments: Delicious! I had a burger and my wife got the eggs with short ribs, both of which we loved. For dessert we had an orange float, which we also quite enjoyed. The service was excellent, and the food was really quite cheap. Definitely worth a visit!

name: Customer_9645
comments: The girls and I always go to Tavern for Sunday night dinners. Our favorite waitress Sarah Michelle delivers the best service. She knows our drinks and never steers us wrong on what to try to eat next. The buffalo cauliflower is so yummy but nothing compares to the S'mores for dessert.

name: Customer_3325
comments:
Lots of good options in this area and the tavern is definitely one of them.  I came here for drinks one night and lunch during the day.   A bit of a wait for dinner so make sure you get a reservation if you can.

We got an appetizer - buffalo cauliflower.  It's slightly breaded and engulfed in buffalo sauce.  Good taste, but would've preferred to have it a bit crispier.  

Ordered the burger - cooked medium, lettuce, tomato, American (cheese is extra).  The fries were okay - comes in a little fryer basket.  The burger had a good sear on the outside and properly seasoned with salt.  

Good spot for food and drinks.

name: Customer_1759
comments: Truly not worth the wait. I've tried a couple dishes and nothing has been great- wouldn't really recommend. Almost everything I have tried has either been too dry or too salty. The ambiance is nice but it's pretty slow. The only good food item is their fries.

name: Customer_4335
comments: Gluten free menu!!!! Staff is kind and knowledgable. Food is DELICIOUS. Selection of wine is large, but not overwhelming. From the start to finish the Tavern was enjoyable. Tricia behind the bar was wonderful and a huge shout out to the server that's gluten free (I didn't catch her name!) and helped me with my food- you're the best! So so happy I came here. You made my night.

name: Customer_2074
comments: Just walked into the Tavern Nashville and was served by the brightest smile in the world. Thank you Heather , amazing server.

name: Customer_3848
comments:
Tavern is probably one of the better brunch places in Nashville IF (and only if) you go with friends. This is not the place to go for a brunch date or to go with any person that you actually want to have a conversation with.

Both times that my wife and I have gone (once by ourselves, and the other time with some friends) the music has been extremely loud - like to the point where we have been yelling just to hear each other. Not kidding. Look, I like my music loud... and their playlist was actually on point (late 90's/early 2000's hits)... but going out to eat is a social experience. Part of sharing a meal is enjoying the company of the people you're with. Don't blast music in my face and force me to lean in just to hear what the person next to me is saying. C'mon. 

On to the food! It's GREAT. I highly recommend the Benedict Uno - a short rib benedict topped with tabasco-infused hollandaise. Wow. So much amazing flavor in every bite. I savored it right down to the end. I also recommend the maple fondue if you're with a group. It's a fun dish to share and has assorted fruits and some french toast and sausage... all to be dipped in a delicious warm maple syrup mixture. Can't go wrong. Also, don't sleep on the 2-for-1 libations. The blood orange mimosa and the red sangria are my favorites (although the last time I went, I just doubled up on the sangria... easily my favorite).

This place deserves respect for the quality of food they put out and their decent pricing (average about $12-$15 per entree). The only things that keep this from being a 4-star review are the noise level, the lack of parking (bring cash because you will need to use the valet), and the fact that you will undoubtedly have a wait. When we went with our friends, we got their 10 minutes after they opened and were told there was a 20-30 minute wait. We ended up actually waiting almost an hour. Not really a complaint, since you have to factor in a wait at popular places... but still. Just a warning - you will have a wait.

Give this place a shot if you like good food for brunch, just go in knowing that there are some pitfalls with this place.

name: Customer_6552
comments: great amosphere and wonderful food! highly recommend but expect a long wait. well worth it though.

name: Customer_1035
comments: This place is amazing! In every way! Great location, great ambiance & atmosphere. The people there, especially our bartender Sarah, were super nice and helpful. She was great! But.... the food. Oh wow the food. Best burger I've ever had ever! If they ask you if you want to upgrade your fries to he seasoned ones (for a mere 50¢) say YES YES YES. Those things are sprinkled with crack, I swear. So good. And the garlic aioli is no joke. The beer list is awesome. Lots of local options. And 2-4-1's on Wednesdays of things like Jack Daniels, other liquors, wine, and some mixed drinks (libations). great place! We'll be back every time we're in Nashville.

name: Customer_3186
comments: Came in for lunch while in Nashville in business. The waitress sold me on their Bloody Mary, so I ordered that and the lettuce wraps. The bloody was ridiculously watered down. It tasted watered down and looked like the glass was about 85% water/ice. When I commented on the look and taste, the waitress proceeded to tell me that if it looked watered down, there was probably extra vodka in it, which I couldn't taste because it was "infused" which cuts down on the vodka taste. What a load of BS. It was one of the most disappointing bloodies I've had. I should have sent it back, but she was adamant that I was wrong. Lettuce wraps had a nice spicy kick, which I liked, but it failed to redeem the dry, canned-tasting chicken. Very. Under-impressed.

name: Customer_3870
comments: Our first evening in Nashville, we decided to try the Tavern restaurant.  It is quaint and dark.  Davis was our server and he was great and very accommodating.  I had the burger which I'm sad to say, wasn't anything to write home about.  The best part of our meal was the great service we received from Davis.

name: Customer_7250
comments: I love the atmosphere of this place. The bar is kind of open to the outside and it's a really unique, modern setup. The service was a bit slow for a half-full restaurant but the bartenders were very nice. I ordered the buffalo cauliflower and mussels. The mussels were delicious but the cauliflower was so spicy and overpowering that the spice hung in your mouth for so long that it kind of took away from the mussels. Overall would  definitely recommend a visit if you're staying in the midtown area, but would recommend trying a different appetizer than cauliflower.

name: Customer_4521
comments: this place was so awesome. we went on sunday so the drinks were 2 for the price of one. they have a great little sitting area outside where you can sit and wait for your table to be ready. I had the Blood & Smoke, im not a huge fan of bloody marys usually but this was amazing. the food was also great, and came out fairly quick after ordering. they also had a DJ playing a variety of music the whole time and I really enjoyed that.  I definitely will visit this place again.

name: Customer_8394
comments: Decided to try this place after our Airbnb host recommended it. Total miss! Way too overpriced for what we got. We ordered guacamole because they were out of cauliflower. The guacamole was too plain, lacking salt and spice. The size was ridiculously small and disproportional to the amount of chips you get with it. We also had chicken skewers, that were described as "sesame, garlic, ginger...". It literally tasted like chicken with some super sweet teriyaki sauce. The rice with it was totally plain too. We had kale salad with ahi tuna. Also was lacking taste, and the size of kale and tuna was disproportional. Not worth the money at all.

name: Customer_8354
comments: Awesome atmosphere and great food. You have to go here if your in Nashville!  Make sure you try the Buffalo Cauliflower, Beef short rib tacos and the Horseshoe. We tried the fried chicken skins.....not a fan.

name: Customer_6051
comments: Burger was great. Cooked perfectly, but nothing special. Packed for brunch specials. Seem to have awesome election of cocktails and awesome bartenders. Was there for food, don't really drink. Def would go back. Atmosphere was great too.

name: Customer_9729
comments: We came here based off a recommendation from our hotel.  The food was fine but nothing impressive.  It was basic bar food.  The music was way too loud.  Impossible to have a conversation and we were there at 5:30 on a Saturday.  If you're in from out of town, try another place for dinner.

name: Customer_7555
comments: Great food!  The menu is full of interesting, and unique items.  I tried the smoked salmon eggs benedict, and it was phenomenal.  The interior is very well decorated, and the servers were helpful and prompt.  Though it was a little on the expensive side, it was well worth the cost for such a great experience.

name: Customer_8401
comments:
All around nice upper scale bar.  Exactly what you would expect from a place like this.

Tip:  Get the Kale salad, even as a side.  It's amazing.

name: Customer_8595
comments:
Food is great, drinks are great, deals are great (Brunch with 2-4-1 drinks? Heck yeah!). The menu is extensive and interesting, with unique twists on classic dishes. The service is also great, but I am withholding a fifth star due to the management's seating policies.

We came for brunch on a Sunday expecting an hour plus wait, so when the hostess informed us it would be 1hr45m we weren't surprised. However, we became frustrated when we noticed there were 4 open tables on the patio that still hadn't been seated after an hour of waiting. It was a beautiful day so we asked the hostess about it and she said that the tables were reserved. When we asked again, she explained that the patio tables were not assigned to a specific server but were instead added on to a server's load inside, so they weren't seating them because they didn't want to overwhelm the servers. Totally understandable to not want to overwork your servers, but why not seat people with the caveat that service will be slower? Or better yet, why not specifically assign a server to the outdoor section so that wait times will be lower? Having worked in the service industry, our group was confused by this. We ended up just sitting at one of the empty patio tables until the hostess notified us that a table was ready. 

We ordered the Cheddar Biscuit, the Wood Fire Double Yokes, and a Turkey Feta Omelette from the specials board and all were delicious. The biscuit comes in a trio and though it doesn't look like a lot of food they are VERY filling. Our server surprised us with a side of White Trash Hash on the house because our food was taking longer than expected (we didn't even notice the timing, so it was a very nice gesture). The White Trash Hash is a must, this stuff is addicting! Potatoes, rice, and gooey cheese- who could ask for more.

Overall, great place for brunch in Nashville. Expect a long line but food worth the wait. Hopefully management can improve their seating policies to cut down on wait times in the future.

name: Customer_7108
comments: We were scouting for a place to rent out for a company retreat dinner. Unfortunately, they don't allow dogs on the patio, and I has my 2 small dogs. I'd understand this if you couldn't access the patio, but theirs is easily accessible from the front door and the street. I don't know what moron made the no dogs on the open air patio rule, but they should reconsider. That said, I did not eat here, went up the street to eat. The two stars were earned by the hostess, who was lovely and apologetic. I wish her the best and hope she finds employment at a better run establishment. We will be spending our decently sized budget elsewhere. Gracias por nada Tavern.

name: Customer_9592
comments: Tavern is THE Nashville brunch spot. {starters} I have tried a good portion of the starter selections - but the buffalo cauliflower, brussels and tavern fries stand out above the rest. The mussels are also a great option for dinner or happy hour. {entrees} I'm a huge fan of benedicts, and Tavern kills it with each of their 3 options - aptly named uno, dos, and (for some reason) three. Uno is my favorite, with braised short rib and Tobasco hollandaise. It is absolutely delishous. Other great options are the Nooner - which is a bacon scramble with fried oysters and spicy sour cream - and the Singapore Stir-fry, with wok-style rice, a sunny-side-up egg, and bacon. You really can't go wrong with any of the Tavern's fantastic brunch selections, but these stand out for sure. {libations} Possibly the reason that Tavern is so popular among Nashville brunch-goers, is the 2-for-1 deal they offer during brunch all weekend. The selection is fairly standard, with mimosas, a bellini, two bloody mary renditions, and a very sweet sangria. My favorite is the blood orange mimosa, but each drink has its merits. Overall, Tavern is a wonderful place for any brunch occasion and I will continue to dine here often as long as I am in Nashville. The wait is brutal so make sure you arrive early to start off with a beverage in the sun on their outdoor waiting area. Enjoy!

name: Customer_2190
comments:
Oh, Brunch at Tavern. I'm so sad that it took me so long to visit you. 

I'll keep this brief: The dishes here are superbly crafted. Flavors are lovely and multifaceted, and the plating is gorgeous. My favorite dishes, though, are easy to pinpoint. 

First up is the Sweet Potato Chips, which arrive at your table with a curry salt and blue cheese fondue. This is a perfect start to any meal, and honestly, I could probably be happy just munching on these while sipping a few cocktails (which I'll get to in a moment). As for a main course, though: The Benedict Dos. Poached eggs, smoked salmon, and a creamy hollandaise? Delicious doesn't even begin to cover it. 

I will admit that I find myself rather addicted to their Blood Orange Mimosa, so I haven't actually tried anything else on the menu. However, one of my closest friends loved the Bloody Mary, and their beer selection is impressive and was mat with easy approval from our group a few weeks ago. 

Is it loud? Yes. 
Is it expensive? Sure, although most of the cocktails are two for one. 
But is it worth the insanely long wait? Absolutely.

name: Customer_3528
comments: This was our first stop in Nashville. The brunch drinks were 2 for 1 (probably because the average wait time on a sat morning is 2 hours). We waited at the bar and had some of the most delicious brunch cocktails! The white trash hash and red velvet waffle were well worth the 2 hour wait! When in Nashville this is a MUST!

name: Customer_8822
comments: ALERT: A must for brunch spot!!! I have been here several times now. The brunch time is SO busy but SO worth it! I recommend the Red Velvet Waffles and the Blood Orange Mimosa. Another time I went for dinner I had a phenomenal Mahi sandwich with the white Sangria. Holy amazing. The service is great, just hectic during brunch.

name: Customer_5047
comments: I liked this place a lot, a more refined food/beverage option among a sea of walkable college dive bars. Modern well-designed multi-level interior filled with natural light by day, soft mood lighting at night. Nice looking and well-dressed mixed-age crowd both times I was here. Excellent 2-for-1 Thursday Happy Hour 2-10 PM with a solid selection of pours. This neighborhood likes its drink . . Food reasonably priced and a good mix of options, not perfect, but for essentially up-scale " bar food", it's good. I bet brunch on weekends here would be fun. My "Ham-Jam-Bread & Butter" was deliciuos. Awesome lettuce wraps, at $14.50. Lobster Sliders at twice the price were a letdown, but as in life: Shit happens. Hard working friendly bartenders. I recommend it if you're near Vanderbilt. Walking distance to many hotels (Courtyard, Hampton Inn, A-Loft, Hilton Garden, The Hutton). A little loud inside, but you're still able to hold a conversation, and the up-tempo music adds to the vibe.

name: Customer_5744
comments:
All around nice upper scale bar.  Exactly what you would expect from a place like this.

Tip:  Get the Kale salad, even as a side.  It's amazing.

name: Customer_2103
comments: Best brunch! Came here on a busy Saturday with a group of girls. Everyone loved their food and drinks! Waitress was friendly, efficient and knowledgeable about all menu and drink items. Would definitely come here again.

name: Customer_6265
comments: Came for brunch on Fathers Day, packed!  We were able to get a spot at the bar right away and ate there. Food was above average and the bartenders were quick and attentive.

name: Customer_9849
comments:
My favorite place to eat and/or drink in Nashville.  

It's in midtown, which is local and away from the honky tonks.  The ambiance, food, drinks, and service is great.  And if anything, there is always good people watching.  I come to Tavern after church for brunch, out with my girlfriends for drinks, or out to a nice fun dinner with my boyfriend. 

My birthday was on a Wednesday last year, which is 2-for-1's night. I came with my girlfriends and had my favorite dessert, their S'mores!  So much fun!

When asked where do I want to go for brunch? Lunch? Dinner? or just a night out...I always pick Tavern.

name: Customer_3218
comments: This was our first stop in Nashville. The brunch drinks were 2 for 1 (probably because the average wait time on a sat morning is 2 hours). We waited at the bar and had some of the most delicious brunch cocktails! The white trash hash and red velvet waffle were well worth the 2 hour wait! When in Nashville this is a MUST!

name: Customer_1507
comments: Absolutely awesome menu, the beer selection was fantastic and most importantly, Emily did a fantastic job taking care of us. I had the pork chop and loved it! Others at the table had the chimichanga, the Son of a Brown Bag and the Loco, all very well reviewed. Highly recomend this place that's in a great area of town.

name: Customer_5276
comments:
What I liked:
1. White Trash Hash- With a name like that, what's there not to like?  While I'm sure I could re-create this for about $2 (smashed fried hashbrowns smothered in cheese), it was well worth the extra cost to enjoy at brunch.  YUM!
2. Brunch Menu- There were too many delicious options to choose.  I went with a salad, but everything (especially the burger and french toast) looked and smelled fantastic.
3. Bloody Marys- They served my favorite, Zig-Zag mix and you get 2 for the price they charge.

What I didn't like:
1. This place gets VERY crowded on the weekend during the brunch rush.  We were quoted at hour+ wait shortly after they opened and ended up just snagging a seat at the bar.
2. Service- The bartender was understaffed and a bit slow to respond to requests.  They also forgot about part of our order and had to be reminded.

Overall Verdict: Make a reservation or show-up early and prepare to wait.  Get the white trash hash and enjoy delicious brunch!

name: Customer_2395
comments:
The simply-named Tavern offers up some mighty simple comfort food pleasures (White Trash hash, anyone?) and elevated junk food game bites. 

That said, I'm not sure this is quite the weekend brunch place for me, due to the TVs providing all of the background noise. I'm not a fan of big TVs blaring games -- to me, this is the worst kind of ambiance. BUT... for those of you seeking a place to watch local sports and cheer on with a crowd, Tavern is the spot for you, especially if your tastes are a bit more high brow than your typical nachos. I mean, they have nachos, but Tavern's come with pistachio and goat cheese. Nice! 

I'd easily return on a non game day (or even to sit on the shaded side patio) for more of that White Trash Hash. Think tater tot casserole. I mean, really. Goodbye hangover. The egg white omelet I had was kinda blah, as the tomatoes made it seem extra watery.The "Wicked" Bloody Mary was hardly wicked, more like gentle, despite the vodka being infused with pickled things that you'd hope for on your glass. They don't automatically garnish the way you'd think. Or at least the way a New Orleanian would think. I mean... just a lime? Nu uh. Our very lovely server came out with some olives for us, which was nice. But a Bloody without beaucoup d' garnish is a naked Mary, indeed.

Extra props for three bottles of hot sauces on the table, marked X, XX and XXX. Go for the orangey habanero, as it's the tastiest of the bunch (it might be the XX). Don't be fooled by the warnings. They are there for the bland American palate.

name: Customer_2646
comments:
Awesome brunch place. I think they must have put crack in their white trash hash. I'm still dreaming about it every now and then. I couldn't remember what I had. The white trash hash blew my mind and it's the only thing I remember. 
They also have 2-1 special drink during brunch. The only 2 things that prevent me from going there all the times, are my student loan and a long wait. We end up sitting at a bar.

name: Customer_5757
comments: This place has a great vibe and lots of energy! Being an out towner, we were recommended the tavern by our hotel staff at Hutton hotel. The tavern is in walking distance and has a very friendly wait staff. Their food was great and the wine made our night before walking downtown to enjoy the live music on the strip. And we are back for another round the next day! :)

name: Customer_6173
comments: this place was so awesome. we went on sunday so the drinks were 2 for the price of one. they have a great little sitting area outside where you can sit and wait for your table to be ready. I had the Blood & Smoke, im not a huge fan of bloody marys usually but this was amazing. the food was also great, and came out fairly quick after ordering. they also had a DJ playing a variety of music the whole time and I really enjoyed that. I defintely will visit this place again.

name: Customer_3778
comments:
We wanted to check this place out after seeing the great reviews. 
Arrived on Thursday (New Years Day) around noon and the place was packed with a hour and a half wait. We put our name in and went next door for a drink, 
The restaurant texted us when our table was ready and also had a cool app that you can check your place in line. 
Only had drinks and a few apps. The tuscan fries were good but had a LOT of garlic.
My friend loved her Kale salad. 
If you like a bloody mary, try the cucumber mary made with cucumber vodka. It was unbelievable. 

This was hands down out favorite place in Nashville and this place had the BEST service we got our whole trip. A+ to the staff. We were really really impressed. 
We went back on Friday night around 1am and it was pretty empty. The guy sitting next to us said its really a better brunch or Sunday Funday bar and not busy at night.

name: Customer_3938
comments: We came here because of all the great yelp reviews, I can't believe this is 4-stars.. Good beer selection, good atmosphere, and decent service.  The food, however, was bla.. We really wanted to try the fried chicken skins, they came out very hard and very stuck together.  The sauce had good flavor but the skins came in a clump that we could hardly break apart. Our food came out about 4 minutes I into our attempt to chisel the skins apart. Kaya toast was weird and really lacked anything to bring the dish together.  After scraping off the sauce it was basically Texas toast and an egg.  The 2 sets of tacos we ordered were both overcooked and VERY dry. Come here for drinks, skip the food!

name: Customer_4168
comments:
I waited a couple days before rating to try to be fair. This place was recommended and hyped separately to me and my husband in transit and upon arrival to Nashville. We expected a lot. 
The service was great. We sat at the bar, both bartenders and food service were polite and attentive. Drink selection and quality and price seemed good. The food is another story. It is over priced and over hyped by reviewers.
My husband had the OZ pot pie. Even with a healthy dose of the curry sauce, it was dry. And plain, could barely taste the curry. I had korean short rib tacos. Nothing korean about them. I tasted sriracha and soy sauce. Isn't  Korean about gochujang? Meat was dry.  The fries are house cut, plentiful and phenomenal. But the rest of the menu is overpriced ignorance.

name: Customer_5438
comments: Jalepeno margaritas. Grilled artichokes. Mac and cheese. Amazing.

name: Customer_2168
comments: Good drinks, good food and a great atmosphere! What more could you want? The drink menu is very extensive, good selection of scotch and cocktails. The food was very impressive as well. I tried the sweet potato fries with jalapeno mayo after seeing it suggested so much and I must say they delivered! This is a great place to hang out with friends and pass some time. Give it a try!

name: Customer_3727
comments:
I thought this place was called 'Whiskey Tavern"- That is what the sign said. Its so cool they dropped the Whiskey.  hmm, okay, Tavern it is. Then I kept calling it Whiskey Kitchen because well it is just like Whiskey Kitchen. 

The dark woods, dim light bulbs and limited tables all from IKEAS dark collection, snooty staff, high drink prices and 6 tables on reserved at 5:30 on a Saturday seems a bit weird for a "tavern" 

I went here with a few friends. We just wanted to grab a drink. Even though there were not seats at the bar I proceeded to tell the security-ish hostess we'd just stand and drink our drinks. Seemed like a strange concept to her. We wedged our way in there and was asked if we were waiting for a table. We weren't. The bartender was shocked we were just getting 'drinks'. You won't find a food review here. 

We ordered our drinks and she held her hand out waiting to pay out. No problem. After paying immediately after ordering, we had to drink the drinks.  Lots of huffin and puffin and stink eyes that we were just going to stand there and drink! 

If you like to be 'seen', enjoy bars with chains on the wall, in this room where Tom Edison light bulbs meets LA-tude this is your jam.

name: Customer_5190
comments: I've been here several times for lunch and I always get the same thing; Scottish Salmon and the Nuevo Bread Salad.  My wife ordered the burger and it is the burger for which we measure all others. Service is good, ambiance and location are good.  It is so much better than its sister restaurant, Whiskey Kitchen.  I hear it is a trendy and crowded venue at night.

name: Customer_9922
comments: Ordered to go through Uber Eats. Great burger and fries. A little pricey but the to go containers made it worth it. 4 stars only bc it was a little cold by time it got to my house. Will order again soon.

name: Customer_1768
comments: We normally love the tavern and eat here often. Cooks really are responsible for the customer experience as much as front of the house. When something is improperly cooked, the kitchen's job is to fix it. When I asked for my raw dish to be cooked a bit more, I received it incredibly overcooked. A translucent egg is raw. That is not sunny side up. A cool red center is not medium. That is medium rate. There are so many wonderful choices on Nashville, that kind of kitchen attitude is certainly bad for business. At the very least, the waitress could have sent a manager over at my obvious displeasure. Perhaps customer service is not important with the "midtown" crowd.

name: Customer_6225
comments: Chose the Tavern based on an article I read on the internet that many chefs in the area head to here for brunch and now I know why. My my my.... Perfect brunch on a gorgeous day.... Mimosas on the patio, pretzel pancakes that were scrumptious. Tehren was spot on with the servise we received. Highly recommend this place to anyone in Nashville or traveling through. Will certainly be back!

name: Customer_1395
comments: Oldie but goodie. Still my favorite place for brunch. With an extensive menu of delicious food & 2-for-1s, a table is well worth the wait. Grab a drink @ the bar or stroll around Midtown; one of their gracious hostesses will send you a text when they are ready to seat you! My go-tos: tavern nachos w/ angry chicken, sweet potato fries & kale salad.

name: Customer_1344
comments: All around nice upper scale bar. Exactly what you would expect from a place like this. Tip: Get the Kale salad, even as a side. It's amazing.

name: Customer_6536
comments: Good stuff for brunch if you are drinking. Recommend getting there early as it was packed when we got there around 11 and there was a ton of people waiting when we left.

name: Customer_9243
comments:
Went here for a Saturday morning brunch and it wasn't that bad! 

Cons: the wait is crazy long (over an hour), the lighting is a bit dark, the music and atmosphere is crazy loud so prepare to scream your conversations, the drinks (specifically the mimosa) wasn't that strong and the food was good but average.

Pros: It's a nice trendy spot with fun music that you'll want to sing along to (especially after drinks). The staff was very attentive and friendly! And the prices aren't that bad (for downtown).

All in all it was a nice experience, but don't think I'll be in a hurry to go back.

name: Customer_8912
comments: We waited an hour and a half to eat at this restaurant for a party of 3. We sat at the bar where they offered 2 for 1 drinks. 2 drinks for the price of 1!! What could be better? Towards the end of our hour and a half wait we began to get to hungry so we ordered some fries. They were very yummy!! Since eating the fries, by the time we got our table and ordered a meal, I wasn't very hungry. So I didn't  eat much of the omelette I ordered. So I don't have much feedback for that.

name: Customer_9800
comments: So cute! A must stop on your Nashville adventure!!! Cutest drinks and brunch spot. I got the red sangria and an egg white and fruit brunch. My friends for mimosas. We are all so happy!

name: Customer_4948
comments: Had a wonderful dinner at the tavern I had the chicken skewers, they we're delicious, wish they had more veggies in them however. But still they were great! My girlfriend got the Mahi sandwich and said it was perfectly blackened a Cajun tater that paired well with a creamy cucumber garnish, it was all really delicious! I got the house made cocktail "Amerboire".  So good I got 2!! Natalie was our server and she was so helpful and great! Made us feel right at home in Nashville! Can't wait  to come back

name: Customer_3603
comments: On a girls trip to nashville the gentleman on the plane ride into town suggested this restaurant. We went during Brunch time on Saturday. Reasonable wait, but they text you when the table is ready. Everything was amazing. Highly suggest the stir-fry and tavern burger and obviously you have to try the white trash hash. Highly recommend for visitors and locals alike.

name: Customer_5739
comments:
Overall: I've only been for brunch and was happy with it soo... nice place to relax and have a little hangover cure on a Saturday or Sunday morning.

Food/Drinks: There are LOTS of brunch options. The Singapore stir fry was great, though it appeared the eggs had been sitting under a heat light for a little while. Still, it was flavorful and not something I've seen anywhere else. I was less impressed with the red velvet waffles. They were extremely dense, and pretty much just tasted like pink waffles. Not bad, just not like red velvet. Be sure to order them with a side of maple syrup, it helps with the density factor. There are a handful of 2fer drink options on the very top of the menu and while they are expensive ($10.50,) from what I've tasted, they're pretty good (and strong.) Go for the blood orange mimosa.

Service/Atmosphere: Our waitress started out being extremely attentive and knowledgeable but kind of dropped off as the meal progressed. That would be understandable if the restaurant had gotten busier but it hadn't. Anyway, she was still nice so I won't complain anymore. The restaurant is very open but seems smaller than when it was under its old name (Lime.) I do like the big open bar, though.

Price: About $40 for 2 people to eat & get a drink a piece for brunch (not including tip)

name: Customer_8346
comments:
Had a very pleasant dining experience at Tavern tonight. We arrived at 5 pm and it was pretty dead. It's a big place with a nice outdoor patio and a side patio that can be indoor/outdoor depending on the weather. The vibe seems pretty cool and laid back. Rock music and low lighting get a thumbs up in my book. 

I decided to try a sangria while I browsed over the menu. It did not disappoint. Very fresh and tasty. I decided on The Tavern burger with sweet potato fries. The burger was delicious! It's served on a "meltaway" bun which basically is just a really soft and yummy bun. The sweet potato fries were good as well. Not soggy at all which seems to happen a lot with sweet potato fries. The boyfriend really enjoyed his meal as well but I'll let him tell you about that in his own review. :) Because the dinner was so good, I decided to order a dessert, too. I opted for the cinnamon bread pudding with vanilla gelato on top. It was also delish! It was the perfect amount of sweetness and comfort to end my meal. 

Service was quick and friendly, food was good, and the atmosphere was relaxing. We will definitely be back.

name: Customer_1849
comments: Well, the concept seems cool....but, not great service.  The waitress forgot our drinks - we has finished our appetizer and they had not arrived, so we cancelled them. We tried to order 1 of the 3 late night dinner entrees they offered, but they were all out.  Umm, bummer. We left and I don't think we will be back.

name: Customer_7077
comments: Amazing food, great service! Melissa was so accommodating! We got seated right away too.

name: Customer_1131
comments: I got the bazooka toast, it was amazing! A little bit pricey but totally worth it. So good it inspired me to give my first yelp review :)

name: Customer_5297
comments: Unfortunately they don't take reservations. It was a crazy busy weekend and took about an hour to be seated. Sat on porch behind bar, they had propane heaters so it was plenty warm despite 15 degree weather. Service was very attentive and friendly. Food was great. Shasito peppers were perfect. Cauliflower was good and smoking hot spicy. Glad we waited.

name: Customer_7429
comments: Tavern has a nice variety of healthy options. They have a large section titled "yolks" which consists of the many different and funky ways you can serve an egg (we had one with salmon in an omelette and it was delicious). We also had the "trail mix" which consisted of bulgur, quinoa, and other healthy perks... a great way to start the morning. 2/1 brunch libations - I would recommend the Cucumber Mary.

name: Customer_8593
comments: Fantastic brunch, bloody Mary's and blood orange mimosas were superb. The Red Velvet waffles, cheddar cheese, chorizo and gravy biscuits were great too and you must try the huevos rancheros, they will not disappoint. The service was also great.

name: Customer_3245
comments: Got the turkey blt. Excellent! Service was a little slow but we weren't in a rush.

name: Customer_4688
comments:
So... it took me a while to write this review but my visits have been so spread out in time. Bottom line is any way I love it!!!

My favorite server is Jaclyn and even though I got nothing but good service here I would say she's a superstar. So very helpful and friendly

Food wise I don't think you can go wrong. I have been all over the menu and had all good experience. Some of my favorites are the Parmesan fries, the buffalo cauliflower and the kale salad. The lettuce wraps are perfect if your not super hungry or just looking for something healthier, the black bean falafel is so yummy and their chimichanga is even better than Chuy's! 

The only bad thing is you can't book a table and it's usually a long wait in line, which I just hate.... bartenders are super hood working both the seated and people waiting behind so you can always get a drink at watch TV while waiting for your table. 
Watch out for the Saturday and Sunday brunches if you don't like a crowd, I love it though. The energy and the 2 for 1 mimosas, selected wines and spirits are a perfect start for your weekend morning. 

This is the perfect neighborhood restaurant that is neat, clean, romantic if you like or cool and full of sports if that

name: Customer_9978
comments: Food tastes good but not worth the price. Drinks are overpriced as well. $11.50 for a small Moscow mule with stolii vodka. I got the grilled cheese and the grilled chicken skewers. Both tasted fine but nothing to write home about. The chicken came with rice but everything was very plain, nothing that would warrant the price I paid. My tab totaled $61 after tip for grilled cheese, chicken skewers, a beer, and a Moscow mule. For this reason I would not go back.

name: Customer_5636
comments: Food was fantastic, service was so bad I wouldn't come back. They are severely understaffed, we finished eating 45 mins before we got the check. The hour and a half wait is completely unnecessary!

name: Customer_7224
comments: Ordered to go through Uber Eats. Great burger and fries. A little pricey but the to go containers made it worth it. 4 stars only bc it was a little cold by time it got to my house. Will order again soon.

name: Customer_3527
comments:
Tavern is great for brunch, lunch or dinner. The atmosphere is casual, yet classy, with dim lighting as well as some natural light above the bar and in the front room of the restaurant. There are TVs for watching sports as well. In the Midtown area of downtown, this M Street restaurant has a nice bar and cozy half-moon booths. There is also a street-side patio (with very uncomfortable, wrought iron circle tables that do not fit well with the permanent wood bench) and valet parking.

For brunch, the white trash hash is a must with any dish. The cheddar cheese biscuits with chorizo gravy and turkey BLT were great savory dishes, but I have heard amazing things about the red velvet waffles.

For lunch and dinner, don't go with the grilled cheese. The menu has so much more to offer, and it's not the greatest grilled cheese I've ever had. The guacamole was a small serving, but fresh and with great flavor. The sweet potato chips with blue cheese fondue is to die for! I'm not a huge blue cheese fan, but this is the best cheese dip/fondue I've ever had! The chips are served fresh and warm. The mussels are also amazing, with bacon adding a unique taste. 

As for drinks, the strawberry balsamic martini is my favorite drink (on their menu and in the world).  Its sweet, with a small kick from the balsamic. Their whiskey drinks are strong and the berry julep is a good choice.

Overall, this is a great restaurant for any occasion from a business lunch to a hungover Sunday brunch. Be aware, they do NOT take reservations, which can be very frustrating, but the wait is worth it.

name: Customer_2030
comments: Great place. Good food. Good prices, $30 for 2 people.  Good service. Too loud on the inside but perfect for sitting outside. Try the pretzel sandwich with fries.

name: Customer_2477
comments: I came here for my birthday brunch and was pleasantly surprised! Our server was wonderful and she talked a lot with us and made the expereince even better! Every single dish ordered from our table was delishous! Definitely one of he best brunch places in Nashville!

name: Customer_8540
comments:
My favorite place to eat and/or drink in Nashville.  

It's in midtown, which is local and away from the honky tonks.  The ambiance, food, drinks, and service is great.  And if anything, there is always good people watching.  I come to Tavern after church for brunch, out with my girlfriends for drinks, or out to a nice fun dinner with my boyfriend. 

My birthday was on a Wednesday last year, which is 2-for-1's night. I came with my girlfriends and had my favorite dessert, their S'mores!  So much fun!

When asked where do I want to go for brunch? Lunch? Dinner? or just a night out...I always pick Tavern.

comments: We came here based off a recommendation from our hotel.  The food was fine but nothing impressive.  It was basic bar food.  The music was way too loud.  Impossible to have a conversation and we were there at 5:30 on a Saturday.  If you're in from out of town, try another place for dinner.

name: Customer_1097

So, as said earlier, this place is worth the wait.

comments:
I've been to Tavern a variety of times since it opened and have had a lot of fun trying their dishes.  Really delish food and great atmosphere.

For brunch, my favorite would be the Singapore Stir Fry - yum!!  I also love their brunch drinks - my two favs are the Bellini Sparkle and the Blood Orange Mimosa

Lunch/Dinner: The Bucket of Mussels, Mahi Sandwich, and the Tuscan Kale & Parmesan Salad

Dessert: hands down the S'mores - had some out of town guests in recently and took them just for s'mores and drinks late night, and it was such a blast - I felt like a kid roasting marshmellows all over again but in a much classier manner :)

Late night weekends is also really fun at Tavern with the music, but definitely hard to hold a conversation with anyone if you are eating during that time.

name: Customer_1056
comments: The food here is outstanding. I generally get the Tavern Burger, which is legitimately one of the best in town. The desserts are great as well; for instance, they let you make s'mores at your table. Furthermore, the beer selection is fairly robust, usually with several local breweries on tap. The downside here is the servic. First, it's usually quite slow, even when the dining room is not too busy. It's taken over an hour to get my lunch before, and not during peak hours. However, the pace does not bother me as much as some of the staff's snooty demeanor. The hostesses in particular are generally a bit condescending, which is off-putting. The wait staff themselves are usually a bit better; you can tell they work for tips, whereas the hostesses quite clearly do not. All in all a good spot for lunch or supper, though.

name: Customer_4564
comments: You find yourself in an unfamiliar city, it's raining, and you need to duck in somewhere. You choose Tavern Midtown. The ambiance is modern rustic. name: Customer_6561
comments:
After a failed attempt at a much busier and more popular restaurant nearby, we found the Tavern to be the perfect spot to start off our Nashville trip. 

There was no wait on a Friday night around 11pm. We were starving and impatient for something satisfyingly unhealthy and delicious. 

The two of us definitely over-ordered. After we received our beer and cider orders, we placed our gargantuan order for two: the Tuscan style Tavern fries, which was HUGE, the chips and guacamole and the fish and chips. Obviously, the healthy factor was not an issue.

Everything was tasty, just in huge portions. The Tavern fries were easy to munch on, although there was way too much. We probably could have ordered this alone. But I guess if an order of fries cost $6.50, I wouldn't expect just a small tin.

The guacamole was interesting. The goat cheese gave it a different flavor - but I liked it. There were so many chips but at the same time, there was a lot of guac. 

The fish and chips wasn't bad, not mind blowing either. It was so greasy I could only take several bites before calling it quits. I love when my fried fish is super tender and juicy, but this was a bit much. When each bite you take the grease seems to flow out into your mouth, it may be too much.

Overall, a delicious late night meal for ones who were unable to wait 45 minutes for a table at 9:30pm elsewhere... I'd definitely come back here for a couple beers and an order of their Tavern fries.

name: Customer_9257
comments: Go for the buffalo cauliflower! What better combination could you ask for?! The drinks also are delicious. The space is large and draws a mix after work - a great place for happy hour.

name: Customer_5753
comments:
Tavern (used to be Lime, which has moved) is great!  It is an M Street restaurant, along with Whiskey Kitchen, Virago and (their "crown jewel") Kanye Prime steakhouse.    

First of all, I love the location.  It's right on Broadway - near Patterson, 12th South, Red Door, etc.  

Second, it's trendy enough without feeling overly pretentious.  I dig the layout - there are two outdoor seating area options (which we didn't do because of the cicadas), and the inside is very well done.  There are TV's all over the place, the bar is stocked, and there is a decent amount of tables.         

Third, the service (for us) was very good.  Granted, we went on the Sunday before Memorial Day - so it was relatively empty, but still.  Our server was attentive, but not overly so where you feel like you couldn't enjoy your meal in peace.    

And forth, the cuisine.  I would describe their menu as all over the place goodness.  :)  It's so varied, but it all sounds great.  
APPS:  
We've heard many good things about the guacamole, so we tried it:  The Bazooka Guacamole - with avocado, goat cheese and pistachio.  I liked the creaminess of the guac, but wanted more spice / flavor.  Luckily for me there were three different hot sauces available labeled as X, XX, and XXX.  Yum.  (PS - there is also homemade BBQ sauce.)  A lot of other app options sounded great, too.  We'll probably try something else next time like the Lobster Hushpuppies or the Eggrolls. 
ENTREES:
I was so overwhelmed with the variety on their menu, that last minute I went for the Tavern Burger with White Cheddar - and I switched the Belgian Fries for the Tennessee Fries (sweet potato with jalapeno ketchup.)  .  The fries were great, and the burger was one of the best burgers in N'ville.  My husband was deciding between three completely difference options as well:  The Basket of Fish, the Nachos with Pork or one of the Taco options.   Like me, he ordered last minute and got the Pork Nachos.  I doubt he would have if he had thought about it for even a second since we already ordered the guac which came with a bag of chips...but c'est la vie.  They were delish.  
LIBATIONS:
Some of their drinks were pricey, some were reasonable.  Just be cautious when you order because your bill could add up quickly if you get the specialty cocktails... I got a $7 glass of wine, and my husband got a beer for $4.75.  Comparing Tavern to similar places, it seemed okay to me.  :)  
LATE NIGHT: 
From 11PM to 1AM they have a late night menu.
WEDNESDAYS:
2-4-1's.

I'll be returning to Tavern for sure.

name: Customer_4275
comments: Truly not worth the wait. I've tried a couple dishes and nothing has been great- wouldn't really recommend. Almost everything I have tried has either been too dry or too salty. The ambiance is nice but it's pretty slow. The only good food item is their fries.

name: Customer_9789
comments:
Food is great, drinks are great, deals are great (Brunch with 2-4-1 drinks? Heck yeah!). The menu is extensive and interesting, with unique twists on classic dishes. The service is also great, but I am withholding a fifth star due to the management's seating policies.

We came for brunch on a Sunday expecting an hour plus wait, so when the hostess informed us it would be 1hr45m we weren't surprised. However, we became frustrated when we noticed there were 4 open tables on the patio that still hadn't been seated after an hour of waiting. It was a beautiful day so we asked the hostess about it and she said that the tables were reserved. When we asked again, she explained that the patio tables were not assigned to a specific server but were instead added on to a server's load inside, so they weren't seating them because they didn't want to overwhelm the servers. Totally understandable to not want to overwork your servers, but why not seat people with the caveat that service will be slower? Or better yet, why not specifically assign a server to the outdoor section so that wait times will be lower? Having worked in the service industry, our group was confused by this. We ended up just sitting at one of the empty patio tables until the hostess notified us that a table was ready. 

We ordered the Cheddar Biscuit, the Wood Fire Double Yokes, and a Turkey Feta Omelette from the specials board and all were delicious. The biscuit comes in a trio and though it doesn't look like a lot of food they are VERY filling. Our server surprised us with a side of White Trash Hash on the house because our food was taking longer than expected (we didn't even notice the timing, so it was a very nice gesture). The White Trash Hash is a must, this stuff is addicting! Potatoes, rice, and gooey cheese- who could ask for more.

Overall, great place for brunch in Nashville. Expect a long line but food worth the wait. Hopefully management can improve their seating policies to cut down on wait times in the future.

name: Customer_5412
comments: Seriously, the best place I've been to in Nashville (so far). The food was excellent, and there is plenty of variety to make everyone happy. Definitely eating here again soon.

name: Customer_2955
comments:

The grilled cheese was amazing, the soup tasty, the drinks... Mmmmmmm. Try the one with agave. The truffle fries are perfect, and be sure to top it all off with s'mores you make at the table. I've enjoyed eating outside, inside, at the bar... and have taken food to go when I didn't have time to relax. The decor is rustic and interesting. Depending on the time of day, it can be a quiet spot to relax or it can get really noisy at happy hour. 

The one drawback is the prices. A bit on the high side, but okay for someone like me who only does this occasionally for a treat. If you were a local, it might set you back if you became a regular.

name: Customer_3169
comments: Don't order the fish tacos- they were very disappointing. I didn't even want to eat them. Order the burger. It was very good. Restaurant is a little overpriced for what it is.

name: Customer_7530
comments: Burger was amazing.  So juicy, cooked to perfection - ordered it medium rare, and it was!  Fries was delicious as well.  thank you!

name: Customer_3820
comments: The girls and I always go to Tavern for Sunday night dinners. Our favorite waitress Sarah Michelle delivers the best service. She knows our drinks and never steers us wrong on what to try to eat next. The buffalo cauliflower is so yummy but nothing compares to the S'mores for dessert.

name: Customer_8313
comments: Seriously, the best place I've been to in Nashville (so far). The food was excellent, and there is plenty of variety to make everyone happy. Definitely eating here again soon.

name: Customer_2745
comments: I went to Tavern on a Saturday night and waited about 20 minutes for our table for 2, which really is pretty good! We ordered a few plates to share- egg rolls, fish tacos and Tuscan fries. The egg rolls were served with queso and salsa... for a Chinese food... that was weird. Our waitress was very nice, though it took her quite a few minutes to actually come over to us initially to take drink orders. Other than that she was wonderful. name: Customer_8738
comments:

name: Customer_7976
comments: Good fun place, appetizers are fun, and different! Place is always full of nice people, good energy. Great for large or small groups. Fun times!

There are TV's all over the place, the bar is stocked, and there is a decent amount of tables. Third, the service (for us) was very good. name: Customer_6452
comments: Waited 1.5 hours in the bar next door to eat at this overhyped egg factory. Not worth it what so ever. Go to Hattie bs or princes and skip it.

name: Customer_5554
comments: Went to Tavern for brunch on Saturday morning and fell in love! We got there a few minutes before 10, when they open, and were seated right away. I cannot wait to go back to Tavern and try other brunch menu items because everything on the menu sounded so delicious and creative!

name: Customer_2084
comments:
I decided I wanted to spend my birthday in Nashville, and I was ultimately excited about finding the perfect spot for brunch. I spent tons of time reading through Yelp reviews trying to find the perfect location and finally narrowed it down to the Tavern.

We arrived a few minutes before they opened on a Sunday and were immediately directed to a table. Our waitress recommended the Tavern Tuscan Fries which were good and the portion was huge for two people. I loved the 2-for-1 drinks, and the Bellini Sparkle was my favorite. I ordered the Singapore Stir Fry which was delicious and was recommended by our waitress. 

Tavern definitely met my expectations, and I can't wait to make another visit for lunch or dinner.
