name: Customer_7187
comments: I liked this place a lot, a more refined food/beverage option among a sea of walkable college dive bars. Modern well-designed multi-level interior filled with natural light by day, soft mood lighting at night. Nice looking and well-dressed mixed-age crowd both times I was here. Excellent 2-for-1 Thursday Happy Hour 2-10 PM with a solid selection of pours. This neighborhood likes its drink . . Food reasonably priced and a good mix of options, not perfect, but for essentially up-scale " bar food", it's good.  I bet brunch on weekends here would be fun. My "Ham-Jam-Bread & Butter" was delicious.  Awesome lettuce wraps, at $14.50. Lobster Sliders at twice the price were a letdown, but as in life: Shit happens. Hard working friendly bartenders. I recommend it if you're near Vanderbilt.  Walking distance to many hotels (Courtyard, Hampton Inn, A-Loft, Hilton Garden, The Hutton). A little loud inside, but you're still able to hold a conversation, and the up-tempo music adds to the vibe.

name: Customer_4649
comments:
We wanted to check this place out after seeing the great reviews. 
Arrived on Thursday (New Years Day) around noon and the place was packed with a hour and a half wait. We put our name in and went next door for a drink, 
The restaurant texted us when our table was ready and also had a cool app that you can check your place in line. 
Only had drinks and a few apps. The tuscan fries were good but had a LOT of garlic.
My friend loved her Kale salad. 
If you like a bloody mary, try the cucumber mary made with cucumber vodka. It was unbelievable. 

This was hands down out favorite place in Nashville and this place had the BEST service we got our whole trip. A+ to the staff. We were really really impressed. 
We went back on Friday night around 1am and it was pretty empty. The guy sitting next to us said its really a better brunch or Sunday Funday bar and not busy at night.

name: Customer_9986
comments: Great burgers!  Still full in the morning with a meat hangover.  Fries were excellent too.  Service was good.  Busy night but felt taken care of.  Highly recommend.

name: Customer_5428
comments: Delicious! I had a burger and my wife got the eggs with short ribs, both of which we loved. For dessert we had an orange float, which we also quite enjoyed. The service was excellent, and the food was really quite cheap. Definitely worth a visit!

name: Customer_1287
comments:
First time back to Nashville since I was in high school, and can't believe I haven't been back sooner! Here at Vanderbilt for a class, and kept passing by the Tavern on my way to campus each morning... Had an inticing, rustic, downtown Manhattan look to it. So I put it on my list of places to check out. I looked here in Yelp, and saw it had great reviews. 

I came in for dinner tonight, and immediately noticed the reclaimed wood door, wrought iron, and alternative rock playing. I knew it would be a great place. I sat at the bar, as I was here by myself, and immediately got a menu and was offered a drink. I had the 1920, which was a little stout, but better than weak, am I right? I ordered the lamb tacos, Tennessee tavern fries, and cinnamon roll bread pudding. Tacos were small, but honestly a decent portion considering how much meat was on them. They were hot out of the kitchen, and the roasted peanuts gave it great crunch. Now, the Tennessee tavern fries ... Sweet potato fries with a touch of cinnamon and sugar, with jalapeño ketchup. Shut the front door, these were to die for. Light and airy, arrived in a mini frying basket with abundant portions. The ketchup was amazing, and I definitely asked for more. The cinnamon roll bread  pudding was a muffin size portion, with vanilla ice cream, homemade whip, and caramel sauce. Great flavor, not overwhelming. 

Service was fantastic, and even met some fun people! Highly recommend this place. I'll be coming back for sure.

name: Customer_8719
comments: Tavern has Nashville's best burger. I was sad when it was gone. Fantastic. The staff is friendly, and the service is great. They even brought our group free s'mores. (That's right: They have s'mores.) I have a new favorite Nashville restaurant.

name: Customer_2862
comments: Food was fantastic, service was so bad I wouldn't come back. They are severely understaffed, we finished eating 45 mins before we got the check. The hour and a half wait is completely unnecessary!

name: Customer_5009
comments: I had high hopes after hearing good things and reading good reviews from numerous sites. A friend and I went for brunch and while we waited 45 minutes for a table, that was expected. She came back 10 minutes later with our meal which, to my dismay, was disappointing. I've had better food at a local diner in town and for half the price. I have no idea how long our food sat under heat lamps but my white trash hash was cold and the eggs on the  nooner I ordered were overcooked. My friend ordered the roasted peppers and squashes and said hers was good but she couldn't eat the hash. The service was pretty crummy. We had to ask for our check and then we had to ask the hostess for someone to check us out because our waitress must have forgotten about us. Overall it was a dismal experience and while I was excited to take my husband the next time we are in Nashville, I think we'll be eating elsewhere.

name: Customer_9988
comments: I visited tavern for lunch looking to try their burger.  I had been told they have one of the best burgers in Nashville.  I thought it was a pretty good burger but I can think of several burgers better in a 5 mile radius.  I will say as a dining venue it is top notch.  Staff was excellent and the layout is very cool.  The menu has several unique items that might bring me back to try like the fried chicken skins...    A tip would be you will probably need to valet since parking is scarce in the area

name: Customer_5792
comments: Great food, great atmosphere.  I had the mac and cheese, which was a special and it wasn't on the menu, but it was AMAZING.  I also highly recommend the egg rolls.  Not your normal egg rolls.

name: Customer_3978
comments: Food was great here! I've been here before just for drinks and wanted to come back because I had an amazing pineapple charred mule cocktail. We came back and ate this time. The only thing preventing me from giving Tavern five stars was that the service was slower than it should be and it wasn't an insanely busy night. Our waitress was not the most attentive.

name: Customer_2479

Hope others have a better experience because it is a good looking restaurant.

I must say the chips were my favorite, perfect for trying all the sauces on the table.  They were warm and crispy.  The tacos were a bit tough and chewy.  I will defiantly be back to conquer that burger!  Chow!

name: Customer_5596
comments: Sunday Funday !!!! Best place to go on Sunday!!!! Excellent breakfast/brunch! If you got to watch your football/ ice hockey playoffs- any sports! This is the place!

name: Customer_9598
comments: The 45 minute wait was well worth it, especially since you have drinks while you wait! The staff here at Tavern were super attentive and really helpful in giving suggestions on what to order. We got the maple fondue and it was incredible, you got to try a little bit of everything. The red velvet waffles were out of this world, the blueberry cornmeal waffles were a slam dunk, the Frosted Flakes crusted French toast was life changing. The sausages were great, the chicken was very spicy but overall great and the fruit was super fresh and sweet. The eggs benedict were really good but very large. All in all I would come back again in a heartbeat!! WE LOVE TAVERN BRUNCH

name: Customer_5956
comments: I really enjoyed this place. Very interesting menu, great drink selection, loved the decor/ambience and our kiwi bartender was great. I will definitely come back next time I am in town.

name: Customer_9282
comments: Looks, from the street, like it would be good, but it was just okay. Our waitress pretty much forgot about us the entire time we were there. Not sure what that was all about. We tried practicing mindfulness to make the time pass while we were waiting for her to come back out and take our order. My nachos were disappointing--basically felt like a slice of cheese was melted over chips with globs of black beans. The kale salad was a warm mound of wilted kale mixed with parm cheese. My son liked his burger, so that was good.

name: Customer_3548
comments: Solid brunch spot! Got there at peak time and the wait was less than what they thought. In the interim we sat on the padded benches outside. The place was packed but they seemed to turn it over and get people in and out quick. The bazooka guacamole was very good but the star of the show was the chorizo gravy on the biscuits. The spicy chicken sausage is aptly named as it packs a punch. I love hot food so it was perfect for me. My fiancé said it was at the limit of her spice scale so normal people may find it too much. She has the pretzel pancakes which are pancakes with pretzels on top covered in syrup. It wasn't what we expected but was good. Something about biting into a pretzel and it not having any crunch doesn't feel right but that may just be us. The girl with us had the pain Perdu and couldn't finish it but said it was good. We will for sure make our way back here as we each tried to decide between 3 different dishes so I look forward to having tried them all.

name: Customer_2782
comments: We stopped here for lunch/dinner and wasn't disappointed.   We was seated and served drinks promptly. Had a difficult time deciding what to order cause everything looked delicious.  I ordered the brown bag meal.  Which is a thick cut grilled bologna and over-easy egg sandwich with homemade potato hips, with truffle oil.

name: Customer_2445
comments: You'll definitely have a wait for brunch but grab a drink and buckle in cause it's worth it. Everyone at the table loved what they ordered. We started with the buffalo cauliflower and got the pretzel pancakes, nooner, blueberry waffle and the red velvet waffle and damn if we didn't clean our plates. Also if you don't get the white trash hash you'll regret it for years to come. Service was great and our drinks were perfect.

name: Customer_9847
comments: This place was very modern and chic! Very cool look and feel of the restaurant. We only came in for a quick bite to eat and some drinks to start off the night. For a Saturday night around 7pm, it was pretty busy. Definitely a loud place because of all the people, but they played good music. Ambiance is casual but not too dressed down. I wouldn't wear a hoodie and sweats, but dressy casual. Service was good. We had the buffalo cauliflower and it was delicious! Will def be back when I'm in Nashville again!

name: Customer_1600
comments: This joint was recommended by a waiter who served us supper, said the red velvet waffles were to die for....ummm no suicidal thoughts here...totaly not worth the 1hr wait and is extremely loud....forget about conversation. We had the breakfast fondu....where is the fondu pot and skewers? And the $3 coffee was yucky! Service wasn't the best either. I'm getting the feeling that the waiters around here think because they probally won't ever see you again they don't have to give good customer service. You basically have to ask to be waited on.#RoadtripUSA

name: Customer_3358
comments: Had a wonderful dinner at the tavern I had the chicken skewers, they we're delicious, wish they had more veggies in them however. But still they were great! My girlfriend got the Mahi sandwich and said it was perfectly blackened a Cajun tater that paired well with a creamy cucumber garnish, it was all really delicious! I got the house made cocktail "Amerboire".  So good I got 2!! Natalie was our server and she was so helpful and great! Made us feel right at home in Nashville! Can't wait  to come back

name: Customer_8154
comments:
My friend and I were visiting Nashville and found this place through a quick google search. We were staying downtown, so it was a quick and cheap cab ride away (5 minutes/$7 ride). We went on a Saturday night, so there was about an hour wait. We decided to grab a drink at the bar (no wait there) and stood around chatting/playing a charades game on our phone...which helped pass the time! The drinks were avg. $10/piece. Not cheap, but normal for this kind of restaurant. 

Once we were seated, we knew we wanted to try their french fries (we had previously scoped out the menu) and quickly ordered the sweet potato ones. She ordered the mahi sandwich and I went with the chicken tikka masala, Both were very good.

Would recommend and return!

name: Customer_7893
Customer_4868
comments: Brunch only review. Tavern has delicious brunch that belies its rather generic name. There are some really creative dishes, both sweet and savory. The Shanghai Stirfry is savory breakfast genius: bacon fried rice with an egg on top. So good. My group shared the red velvet pancakes and the cheddar cheese biscuits (with chorizo gravy). Both were pretty good, though I think the red velvet pancakes were a bit sweet. Everyone was happy with their food, and you can't really complain about a 2 for 1 Bloody Mary/Mimosa on a Sunday morning.

name: Customer_1699

name: Customer_5590
comments: Horrible servise! Restaurant was recommended so we decided to check it out. First time in Nashville so we wanted to see what the downtown experience was, and we were greatly disappointed; mostly due to our unfortunate experience at tavern. We waited for 20 minutes without any acknowledgement from our waiter. When we finally saw him in our area he greeted a table who had just arrived, skipped our table and went on to another. We ended up leaving the establishment. I repeat...horrible service!!!! I guess I can take that back, it wasn't horrible, there WAS NO SERVICE!

name: Customer_1842
comments: Burger was amazing. So juicy, cooked to perfection - ordered it medium rare, and it was! Fries was deliciuos as well. thank you!

name: Customer_7447
comments:
We went here for dinner last night with our Yelp Elite spring break friends and the food was great. I ordered a burger medium well with white cheddar, and I substituted for the Tennessee sweet potato fries with the garlic aioli which were fantastic.

My friend got a Jalapeño-infused strawberry margarita, which was yummy, as well as the chimichangas, which were also very good. The chimichangas were soft, rather than deep fried, which was interesting.

I will say that they don't do any happy hour specials here, which was disappointing. I got an angry orchard cider in a can, which I had never seen before because usually I get bottles, and it was $5.50 which is a little expensive.

Food was great though like I said, and food prices were reasonable.

name: Customer_3328
comments: I have never been so insulted and talked down to in my life. Michelle, I think that's her name it's on my receipt but she never introduced herself, was the rudest person I have ever given my money to in my life. When we sat down she was talking about personal issues with the barback loud enough for us to hear and I thought that was odd in and off itself. When she gave us our menus she said a few times "these menus are good for the next 30 seconds."  Sorry but either give us brunch or give us dinner menus and explain that the kitchen is in the midst of a shift change, don't make us feel pressured because you dropped menus that have an extremely short time limit. Instead of eating we decided to just get drinks. She let us know that the brunch menu libations were, her words, 2 for 1. We ordered a mimosa off the list and hung out. When we got get drinks they set two wooden tokens down but didn't reference the at all, so we didn't know what they were for.  Eventually ordered some food off the dinner menu to go. She was very non existent the whole time we were sitting at the bar, not attentive at all. When we asked for the bill I saw that both our drinks were on there. I asked about them and let her know about the 2 for 1 statement she said. She then proceeded to tell me it was buy one, get one and that's what the tokens are for. I told her that "buy one get one" and "2 for 1" are different and if we knew it was BOGO we would have ordered another drink (if she would have even paid attention to us).  After a little back and forth she said she would take care of it and that "they weren't trying to screw us."  She talked to us like we were the worst people on earth because she doesn't know how to explain her own restaurants policies. name: Customer_4414

name: Customer_5985

name: Customer_7108
comments: Food was great here! I've been here before just for drinks and wanted to come back because I had an amazing pineapple charred mule cocktail. We came back and ate this time. The only thing preventing me from giving Tavern five stars was that the service was slower than it should be and it wasn't an insanely busy night. Our waitress was not the most attentive.

name: Customer_1392
comments: Dark wood, open warm space and welcoming service.  It seems the owners of Tavern have their hand on the pulse of the Vandy area.  The patio cushioned banquet seating perfect for people watching.  The patio is open and inviting, the interior is spacious and bustling.  I had wine, chicken tacos and Yukon truffle chips.  I must say the chips were my favorite, perfect for trying all the sauces on the table.  They were warm and crispy.  The tacos were a bit tough and chewy.  I will defiantly be back to conquer that burger!  Chow!

name: Customer_2882
comments: Good drinks, good food and a great atmosphere! What more could you want? The drink menu is very extensive, good selection of scotch and cocktails. The food was very impressive as well. I tried the sweet potato fries with jalapeno mayo after seeing it suggested so much and I must say they delivered! This is a great place to hang out with friends and pass some time. Give it a try!

name: Customer_2540
comments: Unfortunately they don't take reservations. It was a crazy busy weekend and took about an hour to be seated. Sat on porch behind bar, they had propane heaters so it was plenty warm despite 15 degree weather. Service was very attentive and friendly. Food was great. Shasito peppers were perfect. Cauliflower was good and smoking hot spicy. Glad we waited.

name: Customer_1959
comments:
I have seen various reviews on Tavern.  Some very negative.  Others slightly positive.  Most complimented the food but nothing spectacular. 

So, this past Friday night a few friends and I got together for dinner and I wanted to try some place new.  I put out a list of 3 new places (new to me anyway) I'd like to try - based upon the Menu.  I listed Red Pony in Franklin, Burger Up and Tavern.  I sent my friends links to the restaurants and ultimately we agreed that Tavern would be the place.  

We arrived at 7:30 and ended up having to wait an hour for a table and they don't take reservations.  That was fine.  We figured about anywhere we went on a Friday night at this point we would encounter a wait of similar length.  So, we waited and ordered a couple cocktails while we waited.  

This is probably the biggest downside of the restaurant.  They don't have a place for you to really wait.  The bar was jam packed and there was no seating up front.  There was seating outside on the patio - but no one was out there because it was raining and cold.  So, we stood inside near the door for an hour.  

When we were finally seated the server asked us if we needed any more drinks and if we wanted any appetizers.

We decided to go with the 'Bazooka" Guacamole Appetizer.  I pretty much hate Guacamole and never order it anywhere.  I've tried it several times many different places.  Never liked it.  But, this was supposed to be 'different' with some goat cheese and other stuff in it as well.  The presentation of the appetizer was very cool.  They bring it out in a 2-3" deep round cake pan lined with parchment or wax paper - I don't really remember.  Inside there is a glass jar with one of those hinged glass lids on top and its filled with this guacamole concoction.  They have a few chips out on the pan, however, there is also a small, brown paper bag with the logo of 'Tavern' on it - and it is filled with chips.  We took the small server spoon and each took a dollop of the guacamole and put it on a chip.  Wow!  Absolutely incredible.  I don't know if it qualifies as guacamole or not (I'm sure some purists would say it doesn't) - but whatever it is or whatever you want to call it - it was incredible.  I couldn't get enough.  We were scraping the bottom of the jar trying to get every last ounce of this wonderful, tasty spread.

Moving onto dinner two of us go the Tavern Burger.  This burger is made with Prime Rib and Filet.  2 excellent cuts of meat - ground up and made into a burger.  I had mine with White Cheddar and bacon and was incredible!  Everything was good.  The meat, the bacon, the cheese - even the bun was tasty.  My friend had his plain and loved it as well.  Both burgers were served with fries.  He had the regular fries - I had mine tossed in Parmesan and garlic.  Either way they were good.  Apparently they serve them several different ways.

Another friend got the 'Mama Sans Fried Chicken'.  He was blown away by how much food he got.  He also was surprised at how well the chicken went with the cold noodles he was served as the side.  He said the cold noodles were a good juxtaposition against the hot chicken. 

My other friend got the "Salad of Little Gems".  It looked a bit small to me but he claimed to really enjoy it.  As far as salads go it did look great.

The food was all served rather quickly but the pacing of the meal was on point.  The appetizer was served and finished well ahead of the meal making its way from the kitchen.  Too often I feel rushed and sometimes the appetizers and entree arrive within second of each other.  Sometimes even together!  I think the pacing of the meal was excellent.  Also, our server was great and our glasses were never empty.  She made sure we always had plenty to drink.

4 Cocktails, 4 entree's, 1 appetizer = $94 bucks after tax and everything.  So, around 20 bucks a person for a night out.  

So, to review:

Long wait - no place to really sit.  They DO take your phone number and will call you when your table is ready so you can make your way back to the restaurant.

Service was excellent.  Drinks were never empty.  Pacing of meal was great from the appetizer to the main course.

Price was fine.  We could have eaten for less if we didn't get cocktails, appetizers AND the main course.  If we'd just had water and our meal - we would have spent a lot less.  The cocktails were pricy - but pretty stout.  They didn't skimp on the alcohol for sure.

I think it was wonderful and we are already planning our next trip!  I think you should too.

name: Customer_5715
comments:
Food tastes good but not worth the price. Drinks are overpriced as well. $11.50 for a small Moscow mule with stolii vodka. 

I got the grilled cheese and the grilled chicken skewers. Both tasted fine but nothing to write home about. The chicken came with rice but everything was very plain, nothing that would warrant the price I paid. My tab totaled $61 after tip for grilled cheese, chicken skewers, a beer, and a Moscow mule. 

For this reason I would not go back.

name: Customer_1469
comments: On a girls trip to nashville the gentleman on the plane ride into town suggested this restaurant. We went during Brunch time on Saturday. Reasonable wait, but they text you when the table is ready. Everything was amazing. Highly suggest the stir-fry and tavern burger and obviously you have to try the white trash hash. Highly recomend for visitors and locals alike.

name: Customer_7299
comments:
I waited a couple days before rating to try to be fair. This place was recommended and hyped separately to me and my husband in transit and upon arrival to Nashville. We expected a lot. 
The service was great. We sat at the bar, both bartenders and food service were polite and attentive. Drink selection and quality and price seemed good. The food is another story. It is over priced and over hyped by reviewers.
My husband had the OZ pot pie. Even with a healthy dose of the curry sauce, it was dry. And plain, could barely taste the curry. I had korean short rib tacos. Nothing korean about them. I tasted sriracha and soy sauce. Isn't  Korean about gochujang? Meat was dry.  The fries are house cut, plentiful and phenomenal. But the rest of the menu is overpriced ignorance.

name: Customer_3017
comments: Gluten free menu!!!! Staff is kind and knowledgable. Food is DELICIOUS. Selection of wine is large, but not overwhelming. From the start to finish the Tavern was enjoyable. Tricia behind the bar was wonderful and a huge shout out to the server that's gluten free (I didn't catch her name!) and helped me with my food- you're the best! So so happy I came here. You made my night.

name: Customer_7457
comments: Absolutely awesome menu, the beer selection was fantastic and most importantly, Emily did a fantastic job taking care of us. I had the pork chop and loved it! Others at the table had the chimichanga, the Son of a Brown Bag and the Loco, all very well reviewed. Highly reccomend this place that's in a great area of town.

name: Customer_2185
comments:
Honesty hour, we went out in Nashville after 10pm. Apparently, there are limited options at that time, when it isn't the weekend. We decided to try out this place after walking to a couple of other places that were not like their descriptions. 
This place has a nice ambience, nice staff, and a ton of beers and ciders on tap. The prices weren't bad for the drinks or beer. Between 5-8 for the beer/cider. Around 10-12 for cocktails. Oh, and the kitchen closes at 11. 

Now on to the food, we got the burger and the chimichanga. We were splitting them so we went for something a little different with the chimichanga. We also got the cheesesteak egg rolls. Sounds fantastic, right? Unfortunately, the burger was the only highlight. Everything else got a HUGE FAIL! The chimichanga was super soggy. The rice and beans were ok. The cheesesteak egg rolls were just BAD! No taste at all.  

Now on to our drinks. We first ordered their take on a margarita. They used silver
Tequila so it had a very heavy tequila taste. It was ok.  He wound up with the punch. It was ok. Mind you, we were traveling all day and ate everything. So, it was edible. 

All and all, if you need somewhere to go late, then try it. Just  stick to very regular things. The staff is nice ,so, that is worth a visit based on that alone.

name: Customer_8999
comments:
We were staying right down the street from this place and it was recommended by the girl at the front desk of our hotel. We actually went to get a few drinks and bite to eat on a Friday night. The atmosphere is really nice and the bar is really big. Definitely a good bar to watch football game at or any sports game at. My girlfriend and I both had different signature cocktails which were really good. I had the fish tacos which were out of this world! So good I can't even tell you, you'll have to try them for yourself! My girlfriend had the seared tuna which was also great, a little spicy so watch out for that if you don't like spicy. 

We went back the next morning for brunch. I ordered the Benedict Uno which was eggs benedict with short rib and a tabasco hollandaise sauce. I also ordered a side of the white trash hash. First off all, the white trash hash was out of this world! So different and unique and so good it was amazing. The reason I'm giving this place 4 stars is because of the Benedict. I always order Eggs Benedict and no matter what kind of Hollandaise sauce it comes with I've never thought of ordering it on the side. For this Benedict I should of. It was drenched in the tabasco hollandaise sauce which wasn't bad but just was way way way too much. I couldn't even taste the egg or could see if I was eating egg or just all sauce. It honestly made me sick after we left. I wish there was half the amount they gave me or I should of got it on the side but like I said, I've never had a problem with too much hollandaise sauce. The picture below is deceiving because it doesn't look like a lot of sauce but there really was. Other then that everything was terrific! I just hope they over did my Benedict and don't do that for every Benedict dish they serve.

name: Customer_2182
comments: A good place. Kind of on the loud side, but a nice place. Fried chicken skins were superior. Rest of food was good and waitress was fairly attentive and kind of tuned in. Not a place to go if you're in a hurry.

name: Customer_6741
comments: Our food was pretty. The restaurant is decorated really nice and lots of seating. We got the mussels appetizer which was amazing! I got a wedge salad and my husband got the bbq ribs tacos. I liked talking to the server Zack, he was really nice and a good server. I would go back there just for the mussels!!

name: Customer_7175
comments:
Awesome brunch place. I think they must have put crack in their white trash hash. I'm still dreaming about it every now and then. I couldn't remember what I had. The white trash hash blew my mind and it's the only thing I remember. 
They also have 2-1 special drink during brunch. The only 2 things that prevent me from going there all the times, are my student loan and a long wait. We end up sitting at a bar.

name: Customer_7219
comments: This place was very modern and chic! Very cool look and feel of the restaurant. We only came in for a quick bite to eat and some drinks to start off the night. For a Saturday night around 7pm, it was pretty busy. Definitely a loud place because of all the people, but they played good music. Ambiance is casual but not too dressed down. I wouldn't wear a hoodie and sweats, but dressy casual. Service was good. We had the buffalo cauliflower and it was delicious! Will def be back when I'm in Nashville again!

name: Customer_6480
comments: My husband and I enjoyed a late meal here last night (Monday). It wasn't too crowded, but filled up before we left. We sat on the patio and enjoyed the warm Nashville night. My husband ordered the bucket of mussels and I had the beef short rib tacos. The tacos are small, so if you're hungry, order three! It was perfect for me, though. The meat was tender and delishous. It had sliced cucumber and a spicy sauce which was to die for. The bucket of mussels was a large portion of mussels in a broth, served with a large chunk of french bread for dipping. My husband enjoyed them to the end. I asked if they had a lot of garlic and he said not at all. He was delighted with the light sauce. Although our waitress, Jennifer, who might just be the best waitress in the world, suggested many desserts (including s'mores, which involved bringing a little fire pit to the table with hershey's chocolate, strawberries and reeses) we opted for the reverse root beer float: root beer gelato with creme soda over the top. It was deliciuos! (Had I been out with the girlfriends, we definitely would have tried the s'mores..next time!) As I said, Jennifer, our waitress was very attentive. She knew in detail about every item on the menu (as we ask a lot of questions!) and took great care of us. We would definately recomand this restaraunt to any one in the area.

name: Customer_4746
comments: We stopped here for lunch/dinner and wasn't disappointed.   We was seated and served drinks promptly. Had a difficult time deciding what to order cause everything looked delicious.  I ordered the brown bag meal.  Which is a thick cut grilled bologna and over-easy egg sandwich with homemade potato hips, with truffle oil.

name: Customer_5271

name: Customer_2040
comments: Great spot to come to if your in Nashville. The have one the best drink deals you can find on thursdays and Saturday's and Sunday's. Food is okay.

name: Customer_4995
comments: Awesome! Great food, great service! Our waitress Rebecca was wonderful! The Moco Loco was amazing!

name: Customer_9656
comments: Was in Nashville this past weekend with some friends. Decided to try this place as it was close to where we were staying. The place is very quaint on the inside. Dark lighting, the type of spot that could suffice a first date, a work event or a family get together. My friend and I showed up around 3pm and strangely there was a ten minute wait (Which is weird, because it's that awkward time in between lunch and dinner, but whatever.) Our server is super friendly and attentive. I order the pan seared tuna with a side of the sweet potato fries with jalapeno ketchup. My friend orders the tavern burger. Our food comes. I take a bite of my tuna and it appears raw, almost entirely uncooked. I try again and can't bare it. The waiter has no problem swapping my order for the salmon which is very kind of him. My friend appears to enjoy the burger. The fries are fine-- not seven dollar side worthy fine, but decent enough. The jalapeno ketchup tastes like regular ketchup. name: Customer_8871
comments: I've been here twice now, and the food is always great and the service is decent. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the food takes a while to come out, even when it's not super busy. I've gotten the fish tacos (they are HUGE), burgers, fries (also huge portions), and goat cheese and pistachio guacamole. Like I said, the food is always very good, but if you're coming on a weekend, be prepared for a very long wait. It has a super hip atmosphere and you'll find a lot of twenty-somethings there.

name: Customer_5098
comments: Great spot to come to if your in Nashville. The have one the best drink deals you can find on thursdays and Saturday's and Sunday's. Food is okay.

name: Customer_1242
comments: Gastropub delight! I have to stop here every time I come to Nashville for business. I haven't had a single thing from the menu that I did not love. The grilled cheese was amazing, the soup tasty, the drinks... Mmmmmmm. Try the one with agave. The truffle fries are perfect, and be sure to top it all off with s'mores you make at the table. I've enjoyed eating outside, inside, at the bar... and have taken food to go when I didn't have time to relax. The decor is rustic and interesting. Depending on the time of day, it can be a quiet spot to relax or it can get really noisy at happy hour. The one drawback is the prices. A bit on the high side, but okay for someone like me who only does this occasionally for a treat. If you were a local, it might set you back if you became a regular.

name: Customer_7641
comments: I really enjoyed this place. Very interesting menu, great drink selection, loved the decor/ambience and our kiwi bartender was great. I will definitely come back next time I am in town.

name: Customer_1866
comments:
We totally blew off all Nashville brunch recommendations just because the menu at Tavern looked so good.  Risky move, bucking the suggestions of former residents and frequent visitors, but I'm happy to report it paid off handsomely.  

I looove the set-up of the restaurant.  There's a covered/open air area, a bar area with some booths and high-top tables, then a cozy area "upstairs" overlooking the action so to speak.  It basically has a seating location for whatever your mood.  Very cool.

The brunch menu was almost impossible to choose from.  Our eyes went directly to the red velvet waffle with cream cheese drizzle.  We're not big sweets for breakfast folks but we do love our desserts.  But the inevitable was sure to occur, eat brunch and be too full - rule of thumb - order your sweets at the same time as your meal if you're determined to try something.  So we did....

I opted for the benedict uno which was fantastic.  Tender braised short ribs on an english muffin with perfectly cooked poached eggs and a Tabasco hollandaise.  Soooo incredibly good and the hollandaise was the perfect combination of buttery and spicy.  Excellent.  I will say, if you don't love hollandaise you would be put off - my plate was literally swimming in sauce (arm floaties and all...)  I gobbled it up but it turned my wife off from trying it (note to self, don't bath in hollandaise.)

My wife opted for the The Nooner which is an omelet with bacon, fried oysters and a
spicy sour cream, served with "white trash hash" (basically a heavily hashbrown casserole.)   So back to the red velvet wafftle....we didn't finish it....I know...I know....we tried and we did a pretty good job, but we just couldn't.  It was super good although almost not quite done in the middle, but tasty nonetheless.  

Good service, good food, great atmosphere (would love to watch a game here and snack my way through the day.)  Can't wait to return!

name: Customer_8073
comments: We stopped here for lunch/dinner and wasn't disappointed. We was seated and served drinks promptly. Had a difficult time deciding what to order cause everything looked delishous. I ordered the brown bag meal. Which is a thick cut grilled bologna and over-easy egg sandwich with homemade potato hips, with truffle oil.

name: Customer_3262
comments: I was visiting my kids in Nashville on Saturday and we decided to go to the Tavern for brunch. This was the first time for all of us. We sat outside. It was a beautiful sunny day. The atmosphere was wonderful. The service was fantastic. The food was great! We look forward to coming back when we visit our kids again.

name: Customer_1600
comments: What a fabulous new place to dine! The staff is extremely friendly, the food is creative and they have the BEST burger in town! Not only is the food great, but their use of social media is as well. I sent a tweet out about how great their burger is and received a nice card and gift certificate for my next dining expereince. Nicely done, guys!

name: Customer_3137
comments: Another brunch gem for Midtown! We went here to try a local place before we headed home and we were not disappointed! We started out with the White Trash Hash- holy smokes. They're basically cheesy potatoes but way better. I had the Pretzel Pancakes for my meal and they were the perfect flavor. They were drizzled with dulce de leche and served with a side of white chocolate mousse and they were so good! I also had a side of Texas toast (hello carb day). Ask for the coconut jam with it... UNREAL. My boyfriend had the biscuits with chorizo gravy and he said they were really good. He also asked for a hot chocolate. Our server (I can't remember what her name was but we were in the room that looks out onto the patio on Sunday 12/17) went to the back to check if they had it and it turns out she made it by heating up milk and melting chocolate.. they didn't have packets so she went above and beyond. Incredible food, incredible servic, and defintely one of our new regular spots when we visit!

name: Customer_2566
Customer_4425
comments: Tavern is a great place to grab a late night bite. The menu has a lot of variety. I really enjoy the kale salad and all their fries. The s'mores dessert is also really fun and unique! Definitely worth checking out if you're in midtown Nashville.

name: Customer_9470
comments:
You find yourself in an unfamiliar city, it's raining, and you need to duck in somewhere. You choose Tavern Midtown. The ambiance is modern rustic. Great music, and knowledgeable, friendly bartenders await. 

Per recommendation, I decided on the Tavern Burger and fries. For more detail, ribeye & filet beef blend with a perfectly toasted bun, two slices of red onion, thick cut tomato,  four evenly cut pickle chips, two slices of bacon, and three roasted green chilis.  Perfectly cooked throughout, it is the perfect dinner to satisfy the palate during this business trip.  The Belgian fries are not too soggy, not overly salted. As good served with roasted garlic aioli as they are with the Louisiana XX hot sauce.

Food: 5/5
Ambiance: 4/5
Staff: 5/5
Come back factor: 6/5

Thank you for a great experience!

Well done, Tavern. Well done.

name: Customer_5384
comments: The environment is great! It's a multi-level facility that puts a modern spin on the old "tavern" concept. I was impressed with the food I ordered as well as the cocktails. The waitstaff was quite personable and made the experince even more enjoyable. My only critique was the homemade ice cream I tried for dessert. It simply wasn't good. Of course, nobody's perfect. I would definately go back to Tavern again. :-)

name: Customer_8758
comments: Food was so good! Great music, good casual or event atmosphere. Came here for a group birthday dinner. Their white sangria was amazing

name: Customer_6906
comments:
The simply-named Tavern offers up some mighty simple comfort food pleasures (White Trash hash, anyone?) and elevated junk food game bites. 

That said, I'm not sure this is quite the weekend brunch place for me, due to the TVs providing all of the background noise. I'm not a fan of big TVs blaring games -- to me, this is the worst kind of ambiance. BUT... for those of you seeking a place to watch local sports and cheer on with a crowd, Tavern is the spot for you, especially if your tastes are a bit more high brow than your typical nachos. I mean, they have nachos, but Tavern's come with pistachio and goat cheese. Nice! 

I'd easily return on a non game day (or even to sit on the shaded side patio) for more of that White Trash Hash. Think tater tot casserole. I mean, really. Goodbye hangover. The egg white omelet I had was kinda blah, as the tomatoes made it seem extra watery.The "Wicked" Bloody Mary was hardly wicked, more like gentle, despite the vodka being infused with pickled things that you'd hope for on your glass. They don't automatically garnish the way you'd think. Or at least the way a New Orleanian would think. I mean... just a lime? Nu uh. Our very lovely server came out with some olives for us, which was nice. But a Bloody without beaucoup d' garnish is a naked Mary, indeed.

Extra props for three bottles of hot sauces on the table, marked X, XX and XXX. Go for the orangey habanero, as it's the tastiest of the bunch (it might be the XX). Don't be fooled by the warnings. They are there for the bland American palate.

name: Customer_6482
comments: Hmmmmm it's decent. Not sure about the 'rave' reviews to be honest. The prices kind of turned me off. They have a brunch item of Kaya Toast which is to out it bluntly ridiculously overpriced. I can get a jar of Kaya from the Asian market for 1/10the price of the dish. Not impressed.

name: Customer_1992
comments: Great place. Good food. Good prices, $30 for 2 people. Good service. Too loud on the inside but perfect for sitting outside. Try the pretzel sandwich with fries.

name: Customer_7053
comments: Yum! Mussels are excellent---get extra bread for dipping. Order small plates and share to try lots if items. Kale salad is very good but a small is enough for two people to share since the flavors are unique --- good balance among Parmesan, citrus and cranberries. Guacamole is indeed yummy and lobster hush puppies are a great twist on soul food. Jalapeño ketchup has a nice kick. Shortrib tacos are good, dependable food. They won't knock your socks off, but you won't be sorry. Drinks: 1920 is a little more bitter than I anticipated, but still good. Existentialist is very refreshing as a summer drink.

name: Customer_5436
comments: Terrible wait (unnecessary), average service, above average prices, and excruciating wait for food. Find someplace else. There's lots to choose from.

name: Customer_7680
comments: tavern is above average and the american food is pretty good here. I like the ambiance and the TV in the restaurant. The drinks are good as well. It's in a neat area that is right next to bars and the division places

name: Customer_7854
comments: Jalepeno margaritas. Grilled artichokes. Mac and cheese. Amazing.

name: Customer_9195
comments: Tavern has Nashville's best burger. I was sad when it was gone. Fantastic. The staff is friendly, and the service is great. They even brought our group free s'mores. (That's right: They have s'mores.) I have a new favorite Nashville resturant.

name: Customer_4872
comments: Went for brunch on Saturday and was extremely pleased to discover 2-for-1 drinks! Our group tried pretty much one of each drink and were extremely happy with each, particularly the Wicked Bloody Mary. The atmosphere was great-- trendy but very relaxed. I had the Singapore Stir fry, which was so flavorful and a wonderful change from the usual breakfast fare. As I dont eat meat or cheese, breakfast can be a little boring and standard, but this was a delicious option that strayed from the ordinary. Others had two different omelet varieties and the eggs benedict uno, all of which made the table very happy and satisfied. Would defintely recomand for brunch.. My only wish would be that they had more vegetarian options. The bloody marys by far made up for that though!

name: Customer_4679
comments:
So my girlfriend and I wanted to have a low key night. We went in around 8pmon a Friday night and the wait to get a table was about an hour. 

We decided to go to the bar and have a drink while we waited. 
A spot at the bar came open, so we took that instead.  Good thing, because almost 2 hours in,  they still wouldn't have called our name?

At first I loved the crowd.  It was a tad older.  It was a nice "after work" 30 something crowd. NONE of the local "socialites" were there.  However as midnight approached, that changed. It turned into the Virago/Whiskey Kitchen crowd.  Which I know many people don't go to WK for that very reason.  

Onto food and drink.  I had the Nacho's and my friend had the fried fish.  Neither one of us were the least bit impressed with the food. She said her's was very bland and mine was not impressive at all. However she did give props to the spicy ketchup that comes with the fries!   

As for our drinks.  Fancy names and high prices sum it up. I was brave and tried the "preserves" drink.  I went with Gin and the pinapple and honey preserves .. i think that is what it was.  
It was very strong.  The bartender told me that it would start to taste different with time. Um, no.   It tasted like gin with a little jelly.  I don't care how "new york" and trendy it is suppose to be (that is how it was described to me) it was gross. 

It was nice. A bigger Whiskey Kitchen is the best way to describe it. 
I'm sure I'll go back, but I will stick with drinks I know and try to leave before the pretentious crowd arrives. 

One other note.  The manager kept coming over to us numerous times to make sure we were happy.  I though that was nice!

name: Customer_4223
comments: We came here because of all the great yelp reviews, I can't believe this is 4-stars.. Good beer selection, good atmosphere, and decent service.  The food, however, was bla.. We really wanted to try the fried chicken skins, they came out very hard and very stuck together.  The sauce had good flavor but the skins came in a clump that we could hardly break apart. Our food came out about 4 minutes I into our attempt to chisel the skins apart. Kaya toast was weird and really lacked anything to bring the dish together.  After scraping off the sauce it was basically Texas toast and an egg.  The 2 sets of tacos we ordered were both overcooked and VERY dry. Come here for drinks, skip the food!

name: Customer_8765
comments:
What I liked:
1. White Trash Hash- With a name like that, what's there not to like?  While I'm sure I could re-create this for about $2 (smashed fried hashbrowns smothered in cheese), it was well worth the extra cost to enjoy at brunch.  YUM!
2. Brunch Menu- There were too many delicious options to choose.  I went with a salad, but everything (especially the burger and french toast) looked and smelled fantastic.
3. Bloody Marys- They served my favorite, Zig-Zag mix and you get 2 for the price they charge.

What I didn't like:
1. This place gets VERY crowded on the weekend during the brunch rush.  We were quoted at hour+ wait shortly after they opened and ended up just snagging a seat at the bar.
2. Service- The bartender was understaffed and a bit slow to respond to requests.  They also forgot about part of our order and had to be reminded.

Overall Verdict: Make a reservation or show-up early and prepare to wait.  Get the white trash hash and enjoy delicious brunch!

name: Customer_3006
comments: my favorite brunch spot on nashville! the drinks are amazing and they have a wide range of items on the menu. my favorite brunch items are probably the benedicts and white trash hash. my favorite items served all day are the sweet potato fries and tuscan kale salad! the only complaint I would have is that they usually have a long wait, especially for brunch so come early and be prepared to wait! it's certainly worth it. other than that, the atmosphere and food are some of the best in nashville!

name: Customer_5924
comments:
Service was ok, but the food was excellent.  Nothing against our sweet server, but she was alone on a 20 person table - really? I completely blame that one on management! 

Buffalo cauliflower was awesome and the chicken skewers were so so good!  Everyone had a wonderful time! 

Ambiance was so fun!

name: Customer_2799
comments:
I really enjoyed my mussels and the atmosphere in Tavern, but this place wasn't the homerun I expected. We had a 20 minute wait on a game day, so I thought that was very reasonable. Tavern has a ton of TVs, so it's great for watching a game. The bartenders were pretty quick to provide drinks as we waited, and the craft brew and cocktail menu is good. There isn't a very expansive selection, but what's available is diverse. The food is pretty stellar as well. My mussels were delicious and our nacho appetizer was great without any meat. Fresh jalapeños, black beans, and the perfect amount of cheese made them a delight. Our server is what missed the mark. She was courteous for sure, but her timing was really off. It took a while for us to order once seated and she altered between smothering us or ignoring the table. I also wasn't impressed with my friends' lamb tacos. The tacos come in an order of two or three, and this place seems to be stingy with the meat filling. I'd definitely recommend a side an order of three. 

All and all, I'd come back. This place is tasty, but it's not the pinnacle of dining.

name: Customer_4673
comments: Let's start off with positives, on a Saturday night around 8pm we didn't have a wait and the restraunt looked very nice an upscale sports bar basically. The srvice was good and the server was very attentive until the end when we wanted our check. I ordered the fish tacos. The tacos were extremely small and did not have a lot of fish or anything else. We ordered the buffalo cauliflower which was very good. We also ordered the chicken skewers which tasted average but once again a smaller portion. Somebody else at the table ordered the Tavern burger which looked really good (even though they forgot the bacon), she said it was delicious.

name: Customer_2760
comments: We walked in without a reservation on Father's Day  Sunday at 11 in the morning. We had a flight to catch at 3, so didn't have time to wait and luckily were able to sit at the bar right away. Looking at the menu didn't see anything that looked intriguing or exciting. I was upset that we may have been stuck with some boring brunch on our last day in Nashville. Oh my, was I wrong or what? I ordered the big daddy omelette and my husband got the Huevos Rancheros. I got a big omelet and I couldn't finish it. My omelette  was flavorful and the white trash hash was out of this world. I got a fried egg on top of my omelette. What else can you ask for? They also had buy one get one mimosa. Not sure if that was a Father's Day promotion or they do that every Sunday. We also ordered the red velvet waffle for dessert which sounded and looked creative but wasn't that impressive. Overall a great experience and definitely recommend it!!!

name: Customer_5045
comments: This place was AMAZING! I found it on yelp and saw the reviews, knew my dad and I had to check it out. We immediately got a killer spot at the bar and was greeted by the nicest bartender we've come across in Nashville this far. I had some white wine and my dad had beer on tap. We split (demolished) the nachos- I highly recommend adding chicken!! I could have ordered everything else on the menu but the nachos were super filling. Very hip place, highly recommend

name: Customer_7869
comments: Don't order the fish tacos- they were very disappointing. I didn't even want to eat them. Order the burger. It was very good. Restaurant is a little overpriced for what it is.

name: Customer_9937
comments: I have never been so insulted and talked down to in my life. Michelle, I think that's her name it's on my receipt but she never introduced herself, was the rudest person I have ever given my money to in my life. When we sat down she was talking about personal issues with the barback loud enough for us to hear and I thought that was odd in and off itself. When she gave us our menus she said a few times "these menus are good for the next 30 seconds." Sorry but either give us brunch or give us dinner menus and explain that the kitchen is in the midst of a shift change, don't make us feel pressured because you dropped menus that have an extremely short time limit. Instead of eating we decided to just get drinks. She let us know that the brunch menu libations were, her words, 2 for 1. We ordered a mimosa off the list and hung out. When we got get drinks they set two wooden tokens down but didn't reference the at all, so we didn't know what they were for. Eventually ordered some food off the dinner menu to go. She was very non existent the whole time we were sitting at the bar, not attentive at all. When we asked for the bill I saw that both our drinks were on there. I asked about them and let her know about the 2 for 1 statement she said. She then proceeded to tell me it was buy one, get one and that's what the tokens are for. I told her that "buy one get one" and "2 for 1" are different and if we knew it was BOGO we would have ordered another drink (if she would have even paid attention to us). After a little back and forth she said she would take care of it and that "they weren't trying to screw us." She talked to us like we were the worst people on earth because she doesn't know how to explain her own restaurants policies. I work in an industry that has me visiting 10-15 bars/restaurants/hotels a day and I have never had a worse hospitality experince in my life. Tavern Management - this employee is losing you revenue left and right. Not only is she not taking care of customers and grabbing reorders, she is turning people away for good. This treatment was so horrible and off putting that I am going to go out of my way to recommended against going to Tavern due to the disrespect we felt. Hopefully your floor managers recognize how bad she is and theyo do something about it because she is taking money out of your pocket every shift she works.

name: Customer_2360
comments: The next day we had burgers at Tavern. We really enjoyed the house cheese burger, cooked medium rare just as ordered, flavor filled and juicy. The fish tacos were good, but lacking somewhat in flavor. We has a draft Blackstone Fancy Boy and a draft Muchaco. Good service also.

name: Customer_4286
comments: Food was great. Sweet potato chips were amazing. Great vibe too. Seating indoors or out and a huge variety of menu options.

name: Customer_1981
comments: One of my favorite spots in town. Burger is amazing, good vibe, nice staff. Go-to gastro pub for sure.

name: Customer_2575
comments: I came here for my birthday brunch and was pleasantly surprised! Our server was wonderful and she talked a lot with us and made the experience even better! Every single dish ordered from our table was delicious! Definitely one of he best brunch places in Nashville!

name: Customer_1070
comments:
Tavern is great for brunch, lunch or dinner. The atmosphere is casual, yet classy, with dim lighting as well as some natural light above the bar and in the front room of the restaurant. There are TVs for watching sports as well. In the Midtown area of downtown, this M Street restaurant has a nice bar and cozy half-moon booths. There is also a street-side patio (with very uncomfortable, wrought iron circle tables that do not fit well with the permanent wood bench) and valet parking.

For brunch, the white trash hash is a must with any dish. The cheddar cheese biscuits with chorizo gravy and turkey BLT were great savory dishes, but I have heard amazing things about the red velvet waffles.

For lunch and dinner, don't go with the grilled cheese. The menu has so much more to offer, and it's not the greatest grilled cheese I've ever had. The guacamole was a small serving, but fresh and with great flavor. The sweet potato chips with blue cheese fondue is to die for! I'm not a huge blue cheese fan, but this is the best cheese dip/fondue I've ever had! The chips are served fresh and warm. The mussels are also amazing, with bacon adding a unique taste. 

As for drinks, the strawberry balsamic martini is my favorite drink (on their menu and in the world).  Its sweet, with a small kick from the balsamic. Their whiskey drinks are strong and the berry julep is a good choice.

Overall, this is a great restaurant for any occasion from a business lunch to a hungover Sunday brunch. Be aware, they do NOT take reservations, which can be very frustrating, but the wait is worth it.

name: Customer_8526
comments: This is an awesome place to come for a boozy brunch and a good time! It is a very lively atmosphere with a lot of TVs so also a great place to watch sports while grabbing a few drinks and some delish food. I would highly recommend the chorizo biscuits and gravy - there is a cheesy goodness to this dish that will cure any hangover and leave you with a happy tummy. They also have a great mix of cocktails and beer that makes for great day drinking!

name: Customer_9042
comments: Great food!  The menu is full of interesting, and unique items.  I tried the smoked salmon eggs benedict, and it was phenomenal.  The interior is very well decorated, and the servers were helpful and prompt.  Though it was a little on the expensive side, it was well worth the cost for such a great experience.

name: Customer_9180
comments: I went to Tavern on a Saturday night and waited about 20 minutes for our table for 2, which really is pretty good! We ordered a few plates to share- egg rolls, fish tacos and Tuscan fries. The egg rolls were served with queso and salsa... for a Chinese food... that was weird. When I've had garlic Parmesan fries in the past, they're usually served with a dipping sauce of some kind, but these were not. We were given a heaping serving of them that 2 of us couldn't finish though. The fish tacos were by far the best dish we had- HIGHLY recommend them! Our waitress was very nice, though it took her quite a few minutes to actually come over to us initially to take drink orders. Other than that she was wonderful. We each ordered a cocktail and they were strong for sure- I was just unimpressed with both. The julep was decent. The second drink was a grapefruit/lemon lime/ vodka drink that tasted like I drank straight grapefruit juice instead of a mixed drink... to be fair, the waitress did ask if I wanted it remade. The ambiance was great, and it was defintely crowded. They had a DJ playing music and it was a younger crowd.

name: Customer_2247
comments: We waited an hour and a half to eat at this restaurant for a party of 3. We sat at the bar where they offered 2 for 1 drinks. 2 drinks for the price of 1!! What could be better? Towards the end of our hour and a half wait we began to get to hungry so we ordered some fries. They were very yummy!! Since eating the fries, by the time we got our table and ordered a meal, I wasn't very hungry. So I didn't  eat much of the omelette I ordered. So I don't have much feedback for that.

name: Customer_8099
comments: Excellent service, has air conditioning which is great in the south, my favorite was the chicken chicharrón "chicharrón" good location in the block is the best one!

name: Customer_6523
comments: Waited 1.5 hours in the bar next door to eat at this overhyped egg factory. Not worth it what so ever. Go to Hattie bs or princes and skip it.

comments: First and foremost, this place is worth the wait. If you are planning to eat here, and didn't come before opening, expect at least a 20-30 minute wait if you're lucky. We got here right when the doors opened and only had to wait 20 minutes to get seated. The food is everything it's hyped up to be, and the service was really great. So, as said earlier, this place is worth the wait.

name: Customer_7584
comments: From service to taste this restaurant had it all. Their mahi sandwich was cooked and seasoned perfectly. Their drink selection was vast and test

name: Customer_6924
comments: My vegan friend had the kale salad and loved it. I had one of the taco options -- pretty good too. Wine list was short but reasonably priced. Service was friendly. Better than many of the other options near campus.

name: Customer_7897
comments:
Service was ok, but the food was excellent.  Nothing against our sweet server, but she was alone on a 20 person table - really? I completely blame that one on management! 

Buffalo cauliflower was awesome and the chicken skewers were so so good!  Everyone had a wonderful time! 

Ambiance was so fun!

name: Customer_5455
comments: Meh. I don't see how this place got such high marks. We started off with the cauliflower buffalo bites and steak and cheese egg rolls. The cauliflower bites were kind of soggy/a little overdone. The cheese steak egg rolls were nothing to write home about either. They were served up with what tasted like a hunts ketchup dip and a cheese dip straight out of a jar. I ordered the turkey BLT and asked for an extra side of the avocado aioli. The aioli did not taste like avocado. The turkey BLT should just be called a turkey sandwich because BLTs should contain a decent amount of bacon and lettuce. My sandwich came with a sliver of bacon and even less lettuce. It was stacked with turkey but it needed way more lettuce to help freshen it up. It was served with sweet potato chips that were soaked in oil. 1/4 were edible and the rest were to drenched in oil to even think about eating. I don't know why our food took so long. For sure they weren't back there frying up fresh chips for me.

name: Customer_4148
comments: Looks, from the street, like it would be good, but it was just okay. Our waitress pretty much forgot about us the entire time we were there. Not sure what that was all about. We tried practicing mindfulness to make the time pass while we were waiting for her to come back out and take our order. My nachos were disappointing--basically felt like a slice of cheese was melted over chips with globs of black beans. The kale salad was a warm mound of wilted kale mixed with parm cheese. My son liked his burger, so that was good.

name: Customer_5651
comments: I was visiting my kids in Nashville on Saturday and we decided to go to the Tavern for brunch. This was the first time for all of us. We sat outside. It was a beautiful sunny day. The atmosphere was wonderful. The service was fantastic. The food was great! We look forward to coming back when we visit our kids again.

name: Customer_5390
comments: My vegan friend had the kale salad and loved it. I had one of the taco options -- pretty good too. Wine list was short but reasonably priced. Service was friendly. Better than many of the other options near campus.

name: Customer_2891
comments: Not much to say that hasn't been said.  I had the burger, which I suspect they use truffle oil on, and it was very tasty, along with an order of the philly cheesesteak eggrolls (you only get 2 for 10 bucks).  My only critique of the food was that the eggrolls had this thick, doughy wrapping that reminded me of some of the really cheap egg rolls I used to eat at my high school cafeteria.  Pretty happenin' place, though.

name: Customer_8258
comments: Great food, great atmosphere.  I had the mac and cheese, which was a special and it wasn't on the menu, but it was AMAZING.  I also highly recommend the egg rolls.  Not your normal egg rolls.

name: Customer_6888
comments: I liked this place a lot, a more refined food/beverage option among a sea of walkable college dive bars. Modern well-designed multi-level interior filled with natural light by day, soft mood lighting at night. Nice looking and well-dressed mixed-age crowd both times I was here. Excellent 2-for-1 Thursday Happy Hour 2-10 PM with a solid selection of pours. This neighborhood likes its drink . . Food reasonably priced and a good mix of options, not perfect, but for essentially up-scale " bar food", it's good.  I bet brunch on weekends here would be fun. My "Ham-Jam-Bread & Butter" was delicious.  Awesome lettuce wraps, at $14.50. Lobster Sliders at twice the price were a letdown, but as in life: Shit happens. Hard working friendly bartenders. I recommend it if you're near Vanderbilt.  Walking distance to many hotels (Courtyard, Hampton Inn, A-Loft, Hilton Garden, The Hutton). A little loud inside, but you're still able to hold a conversation, and the up-tempo music adds to the vibe.

name: Customer_1281
comments: Great vegetarian options (I got the Buffalo cauliflower - amazing), healthy options (chopped kale salad with almonds and dried blueberries with light dressing), as well as favorites like tacos, nachos, fried chicken and burgers. Lots of tvs but also more secluded tables. Would definitely come back!

name: Customer_6397
comments: My husband and I are visiting Nashville from Chicago (go cubs). We have been to tavern once before last year and my husband fell in love with the  chickenooga drink. So in love that tavern was our first stop back in town. Well, one chickenooga into the night and there was an issue with the keg equipment making this drink unavailable. The manager soon came over with a substitute option replacing the beer. They very well could have just said "too bad" but went way above and beyond and made my husband content. Great food too but the service is well above the rest!

name: Customer_8440
comments:
Oh hell yeah!!  Came in for a simple burger and fries.  

Great food! Even better service!  

Will definitely be a stop on any trip to Nashville.

Make sure you try the Tuscany fries!

name: Customer_4658
comments: Very nice place for a white collar after work drink and dinner. I was in town for a football game and looking for a bit of a different atmosphere, but this is a nice spot that I would frequent otherwise. They have a nice whiskey selection at the bar too.

name: Customer_8284
comments: Good stuff for brunch if you are drinking. Recommend getting there early as it was packed when we got there around 11 and there was a ton of people waiting when we left.

name: Customer_6294
comments:
We wanted to check this place out after seeing the great reviews. 
Arrived on Thursday (New Years Day) around noon and the place was packed with a hour and a half wait. We put our name in and went next door for a drink, 
The restaurant texted us when our table was ready and also had a cool app that you can check your place in line. 
Only had drinks and a few apps. The tuscan fries were good but had a LOT of garlic.
My friend loved her Kale salad. 
If you like a bloody mary, try the cucumber mary made with cucumber vodka. It was unbelievable. 

This was hands down out favorite place in Nashville and this place had the BEST service we got our whole trip. A+ to the staff. We were really really impressed. 
We went back on Friday night around 1am and it was pretty empty. The guy sitting next to us said its really a better brunch or Sunday Funday bar and not busy at night.

name: Customer_5558
comments: Jalepeno margaritas. Grilled artichokes. Mac and cheese. Amazing.

name: Customer_1800
comments:
Overpriced.  

That's the best way to describe it.  Everything was FINE.  Just fine.  But when our bar tab is $60 for a few drinks, and I felt like I needed to go over the menu about 8 times to find something exciting to try (I landed on the burger), I felt let down.  

All of the reviews of this place made me want to come visit.  I think these must all be Vandy kids or tourists who don't know where the better quality places are with better prices.  

I just felt, well... so meh about the whole thing.  

Again, everything was fine, decent, even.  But by the time to pay the bill came, my husband and I thought of at LEAST 5 or 6 different places we could have gone for BETTER drinks with CHEAPER prices and a much better menu.  

Obviously, this is probably for the hip crowd.  So, if you're hip, go for it.  If you were once hip, and you know better... be prepared to be underwhelmed.

name: Customer_1794
comments: Tavern has a great brunch situation if you are looking to have drinks. 2 for 1 mimosas, bellinis, bloody Mary's and sangria make for a great start to the day. Brunch can get very packed during peak hours so you want to get there early on Saturdays and Sundays.

name: Customer_1522
comments: We went here for dinner last night with our Yelp Elite spring break friends and the food was great. I ordered a burger medium well with white cheddar, and I substituted for the Tennessee sweet potato fries with the garlic aioli which were fantastic. My friend got a Jalapeño-infused strawberry margarita, which was yummy, as well as the chimichangas, which were also very good. The chimichangas were soft, rather than deep fried, which was interesting. I will say that they don't do any happy hour specials here, which was disappointing. I got an angry orchard cider in a can, which I had never seen before because usually I get bottles, and it was $5.50 which is a little expensive. Food was great though like I said, and food prices were reasonable.

name: Customer_5040
comments:
Tavern was in walking distance from our hotel, and we had read it was a good place to watch a game, so we were there! I really liked the feel of this place. It was really modern and even the waitstaff complements the look with their matching grey v-necks. We were famished after a long day and got down on so many dishes! 

-grilled artichokes. promised with a "comeback sauce" which we got to help my friend push ahead past her hangover, it didn't really do that.
-lamb tacos and pork tacos. the lamb tacos were great but nothing could compare to the pork tacos. I have never been more sad to see the end of a taco.
-salad of little gems. hello? little gems describing anything? I'm in! It was a great, little refreshment from my all-meat diet, with cranberries and fresh mozzerella.
-chicken and waffle. The fried chicken was great, but the cheddar and jalepeno waffle was almost too overpowering with the sweey syrup.
-loco moco. too much meat but the rice and egg were just what my friend needed to get back on the drinking horse so props for that!

The drink list was also amazing here, great whiskey cocktails and they make a mean martini as well! I also liked the mix of people here. It was the perfect Friday night crowd. Prices were pretty reasonable, unless, of course, you are posted up watching Michigan beat Kansas in overtime, then the bill might be a bit higher to taste victory ;)

name: Customer_5616

name: Customer_7206
comments: Awesome! Great food, great service! Our waitress Rebecca was wonderful! The Moco Loco was amazing!

name: Customer_4631
comments: Nice little cozy spot. Atmosphere is casual and classy. I had the chicken skewers with rice. It was very tasty and light. Also had a margarita that was fantastic! I only like fresh margaritas and this one passed the test. Recommend checking it out.

name: Customer_2352
comments:
*** BUFFALO CAULIFLOWER ***

Need I say more? : )

Friendly staff. Fun atmosphere. Trendy but casual at the same time... ooo and the outdoor patio is a must when the weather is nice.

name: Customer_7427
comments: This joint was recommended by a waiter who served us supper, said the red velvet waffles were to die for....ummm no suicidal thoughts here...totaly not worth the 1hr wait and is extremely loud....forget about conversation. We had the breakfast fondu....where is the fondu pot and skewers? And the $3 coffee was yucky! Service wasn't the best either. I'm getting the feeling that the waiters around here think because they probally won't ever see you again they don't have to give good customer servic. You basically have to ask to be waited on.#RoadtripUSA

name: Customer_3274
comments: My favorite place to eat and/or drink in Nashville. It's in midtown, which is local and away from the honky tonks. The ambiance, food, drinks, and servise is great. And if anything, there is always good people watching. I come to Tavern after church for brunch, out with my girlfriends for drinks, or out to a nice fun dinner with my boyfriend. My birthday was on a Wednesday last year, which is 2-for-1's night. I came with my girlfriends and had my favorite dessert, their S'mores! So much fun! When asked where do I want to go for brunch? Lunch? Dinner? or just a night out...I always pick Tavern.

name: Customer_3897
comments: PSA: Just go for the 2 for 1 drink special at brunch and white trash hash.  The atmosphere is trendy. Everything else is not worth the wait! We arrived at 11am on a Friday for brunch, was told the wait was 20 mins. We did not get seated until 11:50a. Food is average. I will say the nachos were good but nothing outstanding. The biscuits came out cold. A "side" of bacon is $5 dollars and you get seriously 2 slices. Service was very very slow. Wouldn't recommend unless you have 3.5 hours or more  to kill for brunch.

name: Customer_4529
comments: We came here because of all the great yelp reviews, I can't believe this is 4-stars.. Good beer selection, good atmosphere, and decent servise. The food, however, was bla.. We really wanted to try the fried chicken skins, they came out very hard and very stuck together. The sauce had good flavor but the skins came in a clump that we could hardly break apart. Our food came out about 4 minutes into our attempt to chisel the skins apart. Kaya toast was weird and really lacked anything to bring the dish together. After scraping off the sauce it was basically Texas toast and an egg. The 2 sets of tacos we ordered were both overcooked and VERY dry. Come here for drinks, skip the food!

name: Customer_6870
comments:
We wanted to check this place out after seeing the great reviews. 
Arrived on Thursday (New Years Day) around noon and the place was packed with a hour and a half wait. We put our name in and went next door for a drink, 
The restaurant texted us when our table was ready and also had a cool app that you can check your place in line. 
Only had drinks and a few apps. The tuscan fries were good but had a LOT of garlic.
My friend loved her Kale salad. 
If you like a bloody mary, try the cucumber mary made with cucumber vodka. It was unbelievable. 

This was hands down out favorite place in Nashville and this place had the BEST service we got our whole trip. A+ to the staff. We were really really impressed. 
We went back on Friday night around 1am and it was pretty empty. The guy sitting next to us said its really a better brunch or Sunday Funday bar and not busy at night.

name: Customer_2740
comments: My 8 friends and I came here during our visit to Nashville because of good reviews we heard from friends who visited - they did not disappoint.  Tavern was a great brunch spot and they were able to accommodate our large group fairly easily.  The service was awesome, relaxed and friendly staff all around.  The food was phenomenal - We split almost every app on the menu, all very good.  I had the special taco scramble and it was one of the best egg dishes I've had in a while.  The "white trash hash" that came with it was delicious and a twist on the classic hashbrowns.  All in all I would come back here and would recommend to anyone visiting.

name: Customer_1033
comments: My family ate here last night and thought the food and service were excelent.

name: Customer_4018
comments: Another brunch gem for Midtown! We went here to try a local place before we headed home and we were not disappointed! We started out with the White Trash Hash- holy smokes. They're basically cheesy potatoes but way better. I had the Pretzel Pancakes for my meal and they were the perfect flavor. They were drizzled with dulce de leche and served with a side of white chocolate mousse and they were so good! I also had a side of Texas toast (hello carb day). Ask for the coconut jam with it... UNREAL. My boyfriend had the biscuits with chorizo gravy and he said they were really good. He also asked for a hot chocolate. Our server (I can't remember what her name was but we were in the room that looks out onto the patio on Sunday 12/17) went to the back to check if they had it and it turns out she made it by heating up milk and melting chocolate.. they didn't have packets so she went above and beyond. Incredible food, incredible service, and definitely one of our new regular spots when we visit!

name: Customer_6798
comments: We stumbled onto this restaurant after seeing the very long line at Hattie B's. The atmosphere seemed really nice and the wait for a table much more manageable-only 10 minutes. The menu choices were appealing and we put in an order for two burgers, fries, a fish sandwich and trail salad.  Then we waited, and waited and waited some more.  Fifty minutes later our food still did not arrive with no real explanation (or apology) from our server.  The manager was pleasant and after she was alerted our food did arrive. The burgers were tasty as were the Belgian fries. The trail mix salad had too many dried cranberries for my liking making it much too sweet.  I think with a different server the experience may have been more positive, but with so many great restaurants in Nashville I won't be going back to find out.

name: Customer_4558
comments: Oh hell yeah!! Came in for a simple burger and fries. Great food! Even better service! Will definitely be a stop on any trip to Nashville. Make sure you try the Tuscany fries!

name: Customer_9756
comments: Only had drinks here, but it was great! They have a two for one happy hour from 2pm until 10pm. The bartender was super friendly and made a great drink!
