comments: On a girls trip to nashville the gentleman on the plane ride into town suggested this restaurant. We went during Brunch time on Saturday. Reasonable wait, but they text you when the table is ready. Everything was amazing. Highly suggest the stir-fry and tavern burger and obviously you have to try the white trash hash. Highly recommend for visitors and locals alike.

name: Customer_7849
comments:
I've only been to Tavern once and it was for Sunday brunch. 
My friend and I wanted somewhere close to our church (Midtown 12South) and she suggested Tavern because she said the brunch food was good. I wasn't too sure about the meal I ended up ordering...you know how you have those days where you teeter back and forth between what to order and then end up just blurting out a choice and don't really know if you're ok with what you said? Well...this one of those times, so it might have skewed my verdict. The food was good, but it wasn't my favorite. The 2for1 brunch drinks helped a bit. 

I might would go back and try some lunch food and see how that is. But for now, it's just A-ok in my book.

name: Customer_6261
comments: This place is amazing! In every way! Great location, great ambiance & atmosphere. The people there, especially our bartender Sarah, were super nice and helpful. She was great! But.... the food. Oh wow the food. Best burger I've ever had ever! If they ask you if you want to upgrade your fries to he seasoned ones (for a mere 50¢) say YES YES YES. Those things are sprinkled with crack, I swear. So good. And the garlic aioli is no joke. The beer list is awesome. Lots of local options. And 2-4-1's on Wednesdays of things like Jack Daniels, other liquors, wine, and some mixed drinks (libations). great place! We'll be back every time we're in Nashville.

name: Customer_8238
comments:
The 45 minute wait was well worth it, especially since you have drinks while you wait! The staff here at Tavern were super attentive and really helpful in giving suggestions on what to order. We got the maple fondue and it was incredible, you got to try a little bit of everything. The red velvet waffles were out of this world, the blueberry cornmeal waffles were a slam dunk, the Frosted Flakes crusted French toast was life changing. The sausages were great, the chicken was very spicy but overall great and the fruit was super fresh and sweet. The eggs benedict were really good but very large. All in all I would come back again in a heartbeat!!

WE LOVE TAVERN BRUNCH

name: Customer_6828
comments: Everything is wonderful at The Tavern!!!!. The srvice is outstanding. The seafood choices are plentiful. The skillet bread is so so good! I love the portion size..just right. The Chocolate chip cookie skillet dessert is super super delishous! We have gone on a Sunday night a few times a it's semi- quiet and it's a delightful Sunday meal.

name: Customer_2372
comments:
*** BUFFALO CAULIFLOWER ***

Need I say more? : )

Friendly staff. Fun atmosphere. Trendy but casual at the same time... ooo and the outdoor patio is a must when the weather is nice.

name: Customer_5011
comments: The girls and I always go to Tavern for Sunday night dinners. Our favorite waitress Sarah Michelle delivers the best service. She knows our drinks and never steers us wrong on what to try to eat next. The buffalo cauliflower is so yummy but nothing compares to the S'mores for dessert.

name: Customer_7354
comments: Yum! Mussels are excellent---get extra bread for dipping. Order small plates and share to try lots if items. Kale salad is very good but a small is enough for two people to share since the flavors are unique --- good balance among Parmesan, citrus and cranberries. Guacamole is indeed yummy and lobster hush puppies are a great twist on soul food. Jalapeño ketchup has a nice kick. Shortrib tacos are good, dependable food. They won't knock your socks off, but you won't be sorry. Drinks: 1920 is a little more bitter than I anticipated, but still good. Existentialist is very refreshing as a summer drink.

name: Customer_4609
comments:
Nashville for the weekend--Brunch on Saturday! (July 14, 2012)

First off I LOVE that they have a Saturday brunch.  Avoiding the crowds of Sunday and having yummy brunch food is awesome.  I don't know why we can't have brunch everyday and brunch for dinner menus should exist---but I digress.

DRINKS:
We ordered cocktails (2 for 1!!!!!!): cucumber bloody mary, sangria, and champaign drink.  The sangria was great and I loved the bloody mary---champaign drink was tasty but paled by comparison.  Also--our incredibly awesome server gave the helpful tip that the sangria is the most booze for the buck.  Not really my most important thing to know when ordering a cocktail, but I appreciate that she willingly shared the info.

FOOD: 
Chorizo gravy and cheese biscuits =yummy but very rich!
Singapore stir fry thing =FANTASTIC--watch out for the spice but totally worth the burn
Benedict w/tabasco =don't remember the name.  I am not one for benedicts but my friends both said it was quite good.
Sweet Potato chips with blue cheese dip =super awesome, need to figure out how to make that dip.
White Trash Hash =very yummy

Service was great and we were seated right away.  If I lived in Nashville this place would be in heavy rotation.

name: Customer_6176
comments: Great place to watch sports and try the good food selection. Brunch is great on the weekend and have something special always. Just get ready for the line so my ght as well get a spot on the bar or wait forever.

name: Customer_5718
comments: I don't get it. 4 and 5-start reviews abound, and the weekend brunch line is absurd, but I'd have to describe my experience at Tavern as "just okay." I went here on a Sunday morning ambigudate a month ago. We managed to get bar seating after waiting about 10 minutes, which seemed pretty good compared to the lengthy wait for a real table. The place was bustling, but we didn't have to wait too long to get in our drink orders. That said, while I love deals--and 2-for-1 mimosas and the like qualify--I wasn't bowled over. It tasted like a cheap cava and was heavy on the orange juice. I ordered a burger while my dining companion decided to go with the traditional brunch. My burger was decent but not mouthwateringly amazing, which makes it a far cry from many of the reviews claiming this to be the "best burger in Nashville." Similarly, despite the attempts to make the brunch fare a bit fancier, I wasn't bowled over by any of the flavors. While the prices aren't crazy expensive, they aren't cheap either. Overall I'd describe Tavern as "fine." I'd have no qualms about returning, but the foodie within me doesn't get the hype. Nashville, just because something is dressed up to look fancy and act fancy doesn't mean it's *actually* fancy.

name: Customer_6159
comments: Evan the doorman was as friendly as his beard is burly. Jenna the hostess got us a table wiki wiki even though the place was packed. Amy our server professed her love for us because we ordered 8 items at once and handed her the menus back. Specialty cocktails were fantastic and the fish tacos were off the charts delicious. Well done, Tavern. Well done.

name: Customer_7909
comments: Don't order the fish tacos- they were very disappointing. I didn't even want to eat them. Order the burger. It was very good. Restaurant is a little overpriced for what it is.

name: Customer_4530
comments: Was not too much a fan of some of the food. The Lamb was not lamb have no clue why it was.  However the staff is very nice and the drinks were great.

name: Customer_7082
comments: Went to Tavern for the first time last night after hearing many of my friends rave about it. Got there at 6 p.m. for a friend's birthday gathering and it was not crowded then. We had a big group and the staff was accommodating about our taking two of the big booths in the bar and spilling out in the aisle. The wine list is very modest but I found something that worked. Service was good. Now, I gotta say, the server didn't seem like she loves her job - she didn't look all that happy about serving us, but she was timely and checked back often, so who am I to complain? I didn't order food myself, but grazed off my friends' appetizers. The nachos with 'angry chicken' were really, really good. I've never met a nacho I didn't like, but these rank in the top two or three I've ever had. I was suspicious about the guacamole - who puts goat cheese and pistachios in guac? Why gild the lily? But once I picked off the nuts and cheese, the guac was also superlative: had a really nice garlicky kick. There wasn't a whole lot on the menu that didn't look appealing, so I am looking forward to going back soon and having a real meal. On the whole, I like it a lot better than its sister, Whiskey Kitchen.

name: Customer_1850
comments: So cute! A must stop on your Nashville adventure!!! Cutest drinks and brunch spot. I got the red sangria and an egg white and fruit brunch. My friends for mimosas. We are all so happy!

name: Customer_3359
comments:
The food here is outstanding. I generally get the Tavern Burger, which is legitimately one of the best in town. The desserts are great as well; for instance, they let you make s'mores at your table. Furthermore, the beer selection is fairly robust, usually with several local breweries on tap. 

The downside here is the service. First, it's usually quite slow, even when the dining room is not too busy. It's taken over an hour to get my lunch before, and not during peak hours. However, the pace does not bother me as much as some of the staff's snooty demeanor. The hostesses in particular are generally a bit condescending, which is off-putting. The wait staff themselves are usually a bit better; you can tell they work for tips, whereas the hostesses quite clearly do not. All in all a good spot for lunch or supper, though.

name: Customer_5419
comments: I visited tavern for lunch looking to try their burger.  I had been told they have one of the best burgers in Nashville.  I thought it was a pretty good burger but I can think of several burgers better in a 5 mile radius.  I will say as a dining venue it is top notch.  Staff was excellent and the layout is very cool.  The menu has several unique items that might bring me back to try like the fried chicken skins...    A tip would be you will probably need to valet since parking is scarce in the area

name: Customer_1192
comments: Went today with a group for brunch. We had no complaints. Great-cucumber Bloody Mary, coffee, lobster gumbo, grilled artichoke, white trash hash and service. The decor was tasteful and semi modern. I definitely felt like we left Nashville for a couple hours which was great! Will definitely be back!

name: Customer_4334
comments: Excellent food and service!!! They even put my Mets game on the big screen. Order the chicken skins for an appetizer - freaking yummy!!! Burgers were great - Service is 5 star!!! Friend had the Lobster sliders - very good!!!

name: Customer_5148
comments:
After a failed attempt at a much busier and more popular restaurant nearby, we found the Tavern to be the perfect spot to start off our Nashville trip. 

There was no wait on a Friday night around 11pm. We were starving and impatient for something satisfyingly unhealthy and delicious. 

The two of us definitely over-ordered. After we received our beer and cider orders, we placed our gargantuan order for two: the Tuscan style Tavern fries, which was HUGE, the chips and guacamole and the fish and chips. Obviously, the healthy factor was not an issue.

Everything was tasty, just in huge portions. The Tavern fries were easy to munch on, although there was way too much. We probably could have ordered this alone. But I guess if an order of fries cost $6.50, I wouldn't expect just a small tin.

The guacamole was interesting. The goat cheese gave it a different flavor - but I liked it. There were so many chips but at the same time, there was a lot of guac. 

The fish and chips wasn't bad, not mind blowing either. It was so greasy I could only take several bites before calling it quits. I love when my fried fish is super tender and juicy, but this was a bit much. When each bite you take the grease seems to flow out into your mouth, it may be too much.

Overall, a delicious late night meal for ones who were unable to wait 45 minutes for a table at 9:30pm elsewhere... I'd definitely come back here for a couple beers and an order of their Tavern fries.

name: Customer_7869
comments: We normally love the tavern and eat here often. Cooks really are responsible for the customer experience as much as front of the house. When something is improperly cooked, the kitchen's job is to fix it. When I asked for my raw dish to be cooked a bit more, I received it incredibly overcooked. A translucent egg is raw. That is not sunny side up. A cool red center is not medium. That is medium rate. There are so many wonderful choices on Nashville, that kind of kitchen attitude is certainly bad for business.   At the very least, the waitress could have sent a manager over at my obvious displeasure. Perhaps customer service is not important with the "midtown" crowd.

name: Customer_1014
comments: Go for the buffalo cauliflower! What better combination could you ask for?! The drinks also are delicious. The space is large and draws a mix after work - a great place for happy hour.

name: Customer_9693
comments: Bartender needs to go back to bartenders and hospitality school. Would not let us share two for one happy hr drinks . What does she care and why try to force us to buy more than we wanted . Rude and does not belong in the restaurant business . Never had this happen anywhere not even in front be star restaurants inNY , LA or Miami . Lazy greedy people who don't want to work and know nothing of taking care of customers . Good luck your gonna need it if you intend to survive much longer . All these places are empty but still the service is shoddy .

name: Customer_9348
comments:
We were scouting for a place to rent out for a company retreat dinner.  Unfortunately, they don't allow dogs on the patio, and I has my 2 small dogs.  I'd understand this if you couldn't access the patio, but theirs is easily accessible from the front door and the street.  I don't know what moron made the no dogs on the open air patio rule, but they should reconsider.

That said, I did not eat here, went up the street to eat.  The two stars were earned by the hostess, who was lovely and apologetic.  I wish her the best and hope she finds employment at a better run establishment.  

We will be spending our decently sized budget elsewhere.  Gracias por nada Tavern.

name: Customer_4964
comments: Good stuff for brunch if you are drinking. Recommend getting there early as it was packed when we got there around 11 and there was a ton of people waiting when we left.

name: Customer_2688
comments: Tavern (used to be Lime, which has moved) is great! It is an M Street restraunt, along with Whiskey Kitchen, Virago and (their "crown jewel") Kanye Prime steakhouse. First of all, I love the location. It's right on Broadway - near Patterson, 12th South, Red Door, etc. Second, it's trendy enough without feeling overly pretentious. I dig the layout - there are two outdoor seating area options (which we didn't do because of the cicadas), and the inside is very well done. There are TV's all over the place, the bar is stocked, and there is a decent amount of tables. Third, the service (for us) was very good. Granted, we went on the Sunday before Memorial Day - so it was relatively empty, but still. Our server was attentive, but not overly so where you feel like you couldn't enjoy your meal in peace. And forth, the cuisine. I would describe their menu as all over the place goodness. :) It's so varied, but it all sounds great. APPS: We've heard many good things about the guacamole, so we tried it: The Bazooka Guacamole - with avocado, goat cheese and pistachio. I liked the creaminess of the guac, but wanted more spice / flavor. Luckily for me there were three different hot sauces available labeled as X, XX, and XXX. Yum. (PS - there is also homemade BBQ sauce.) A lot of other app options sounded great, too. We'll probably try something else next time like the Lobster Hushpuppies or the Eggrolls. ENTREES: I was so overwhelmed with the variety on their menu, that last minute I went for the Tavern Burger with White Cheddar - and I switched the Belgian Fries for the Tennessee Fries (sweet potato with jalapeno ketchup.) . The fries were great, and the burger was one of the best burgers in N'ville. My husband was deciding between three completely difference options as well: The Basket of Fish, the Nachos with Pork or one of the Taco options. Like me, he ordered last minute and got the Pork Nachos. I doubt he would have if he had thought about it for even a second since we already ordered the guac which came with a bag of chips...but c'est la vie. They were delish. LIBATIONS: Some of their drinks were pricey, some were reasonable. Just be cautious when you order because your bill could add up quickly if you get the specialty cocktails... I got a $7 glass of wine, and my husband got a beer for $4.75. Comparing Tavern to similar places, it seemed okay to me. :) LATE NIGHT: From 11PM to 1AM they have a late night menu. WEDNESDAYS: 2-4-1's. I'll be returning to Tavern for sure.

name: Customer_9285
comments:
I've been to Tavern a variety of times since it opened and have had a lot of fun trying their dishes.  Really delish food and great atmosphere.

For brunch, my favorite would be the Singapore Stir Fry - yum!!  I also love their brunch drinks - my two favs are the Bellini Sparkle and the Blood Orange Mimosa

Lunch/Dinner: The Bucket of Mussels, Mahi Sandwich, and the Tuscan Kale & Parmesan Salad

Dessert: hands down the S'mores - had some out of town guests in recently and took them just for s'mores and drinks late night, and it was such a blast - I felt like a kid roasting marshmellows all over again but in a much classier manner :)

Late night weekends is also really fun at Tavern with the music, but definitely hard to hold a conversation with anyone if you are eating during that time.

name: Customer_8700
comments: Great vegetarian options (I got the Buffalo cauliflower - amazing), healthy options (chopped kale salad with almonds and dried blueberries with light dressing), as well as favorites like tacos, nachos, fried chicken and burgers.  Lots of tvs but also more secluded tables. Would definitely come back!

name: Customer_4308
comments:
So my girlfriend and I wanted to have a low key night. We went in around 8pmon a Friday night and the wait to get a table was about an hour. 

We decided to go to the bar and have a drink while we waited. 
A spot at the bar came open, so we took that instead.  Good thing, because almost 2 hours in,  they still wouldn't have called our name?

At first I loved the crowd.  It was a tad older.  It was a nice "after work" 30 something crowd. NONE of the local "socialites" were there.  However as midnight approached, that changed. It turned into the Virago/Whiskey Kitchen crowd.  Which I know many people don't go to WK for that very reason.  

Onto food and drink.  I had the Nacho's and my friend had the fried fish.  Neither one of us were the least bit impressed with the food. She said her's was very bland and mine was not impressive at all. However she did give props to the spicy ketchup that comes with the fries!   

As for our drinks.  Fancy names and high prices sum it up. I was brave and tried the "preserves" drink.  I went with Gin and the pinapple and honey preserves .. i think that is what it was.  
It was very strong.  The bartender told me that it would start to taste different with time. Um, no.   It tasted like gin with a little jelly.  I don't care how "new york" and trendy it is suppose to be (that is how it was described to me) it was gross. 

It was nice. A bigger Whiskey Kitchen is the best way to describe it. 
I'm sure I'll go back, but I will stick with drinks I know and try to leave before the pretentious crowd arrives. 

One other note.  The manager kept coming over to us numerous times to make sure we were happy.  I though that was nice!

name: Customer_6453
comments: great amosphere and wonderful food! highly recomend but expect a long wait. well worth it though.

name: Customer_2097
comments:
This is an awesome place to come for a boozy brunch and a good time! It is a very lively atmosphere with a lot of TVs so also a great place to watch sports while grabbing a few drinks and some delish food. 

I would highly recommend the chorizo biscuits and gravy - there is a cheesy goodness to this dish that will cure any hangover and leave you with a happy tummy. They also have a great mix of cocktails and beer that makes for great day drinking!

name: Customer_9342
comments: The girls and I always go to Tavern for Sunday night dinners. Our favorite waitress Sarah Michelle delivers the best service. She knows our drinks and never steers us wrong on what to try to eat next. The buffalo cauliflower is so yummy but nothing compares to the S'mores for dessert.

name: Customer_8896
comments: Gluten free menu!!!! Staff is kind and knowledgable. Food is DELICIOUS. Selection of wine is large, but not overwhelming. From the start to finish the Tavern was enjoyable. Tricia behind the bar was wonderful and a huge shout out to the server that's gluten free (I didn't catch her name!) and helped me with my food- you're the best! So so happy I came here. You made my night.

name: Customer_8944
comments: Fantastic brunch, bloody Mary's and blood orange mimosas were superb. The Red Velvet waffles, cheddar cheese, chorizo and gravy biscuits were great too and you must try the huevos rancheros, they will not disappoint. The srvice was also great.

name: Customer_6586
comments: Great brunch and cocktails! The Nooner, Roasted Peppers and Squash, and Blueberry Waffles were great. Very good Bloody Mary, red sangria, and signature craft cocktails.

name: Customer_4636
comments: Got the turkey blt. Excellent! Service was a little slow but we weren't in a rush.

name: Customer_7987
comments: So happy we found this cool little spot in the heart of West End during a one-night stay in Nashville. To be concise, here's a rundown of pros/cons: Pros: - My boyfriend and I went here around 7 PM on a Tuesday night. It was decently busy, but not overly crowded. We were seated right away. Like. - The kale salad was life-changing. I waffled for a long time on what to order, and I was NOT disappointed. I couldn't stop eating it! Best salad I've ever had in a restaurant. Get it topped with salmon too. mmm! - The bf got the fried chicken skins and the beef short rib tacos. He said the tacos were small and not much to them, but overall good flavor and tasty. - Wine list is great! I got some bubbly and it was reasonably priced. Cons: - Service was a bit lacking in my opinion - I get that this is the trendy area, but the vibe seemed a bit pretentious and not very welcoming. [NOTE: If you're from/have spent a considerable amount of time in Chicago, this is a very River North-esque bar. End of story.] - Beer menu needs some SERIOUS attention. I was shocked there wasn't more quality stuff on that list, hence my choice for wine. Bud and High Life? Come on, man. Notes: - A little loud and dark in general - not the best for conversation. - A lot of TVs all around, so might be fun for gameday, but I can't say for sure.

name: Customer_4250
comments: Great spot to come to if your in Nashville. The have one the best drink deals you can find on thursdays and Saturday's and Sunday's. Food is okay.

name: Customer_2199
comments: Great spot to come to if your in Nashville. The have one the best drink deals you can find on thursdays and Saturday's and Sunday's. Food is okay.

name: Customer_9009
comments: Only had drinks here, but it was great! They have a two for one happy hour from 2pm until 10pm. The bartender was super friendly and made a great drink!

name: Customer_7999
comments: Delicious! I had a burger and my wife got the eggs with short ribs, both of which we loved. For dessert we had an orange float, which we also quite enjoyed. The service was excellent, and the food was really quite cheap. Definitely worth a visit!

name: Customer_8118
comments:
My friend and I were visiting Nashville and found this place through a quick google search. We were staying downtown, so it was a quick and cheap cab ride away (5 minutes/$7 ride). We went on a Saturday night, so there was about an hour wait. We decided to grab a drink at the bar (no wait there) and stood around chatting/playing a charades game on our phone...which helped pass the time! The drinks were avg. $10/piece. Not cheap, but normal for this kind of restaurant. 

Once we were seated, we knew we wanted to try their french fries (we had previously scoped out the menu) and quickly ordered the sweet potato ones. She ordered the mahi sandwich and I went with the chicken tikka masala, Both were very good.

Would recommend and return!

name: Customer_4842
comments: Went for brunch on Saturday and was extremely pleased to discover 2-for-1 drinks! Our group tried pretty much one of each drink and were extremely happy with each, particularly the Wicked Bloody Mary. The atmosphere was great-- trendy but very relaxed. I had the Singapore Stir fry, which was so flavorful and a wonderful change from the usual breakfast fare. As I dont eat meat or cheese, breakfast can be a little boring and standard, but this was a delicious option that strayed from the ordinary. Others had two different omelet varieties and the eggs benedict uno, all of which made the table very happy and satisfied. Would definitely recommend for brunch.. My only wish would be that they had more vegetarian options. The bloody marys by far made up for that though!

name: Customer_3495
comments: I love the atmosphere of this place. The bar is kind of open to the outside and it's a really unique, modern setup. The service was a bit slow for a half-full restaurant but the bartenders were very nice. I ordered the buffalo cauliflower and mussels. The mussels were delicious but the cauliflower was so spicy and overpowering that the spice hung in your mouth for so long that it kind of took away from the mussels. Overall would  definitely recommend a visit if you're staying in the midtown area, but would recommend trying a different appetizer than cauliflower.

name: Customer_3986
comments: I had high hopes after hearing good things and reading good reviews from numerous sites. A friend and I went for brunch and while we waited 45 minutes for a table, that was expected. After being seated our waitress took our drink orders and came back about 5 minutes later with waters and another 10 with my friend's blood orange mimosa. We ordered and waited over an hour for our food. When the waitress finally checked on us I asked about the toast for my son because I knew he was hungry. She came back 10 minutes later with our meal which, to my dismay, was disappointing. I've had better food at a local diner in town and for half the price. I have no idea how long our food sat under heat lamps but my white trash hash was cold and the eggs on the  nooner I ordered were overcooked. My friend ordered the roasted peppers and squashes and said hers was good but she couldn't eat the hash. The service was pretty crummy. We had to ask for our check and then we had to ask the hostess for someone to check us out because our waitress must have forgotten about us. Overall it was a dismal experience and while I was excited to take my husband the next time we are in Nashville, I think we'll be eating elsewhere.

name: Customer_6481
comments: I have heard about this place from a few different people, finally made it in and it lived up to the hype. Ate here with a friend, realized she had lost her wallet as soon as we sat down. Valet was super polite, brought the car up for us to check it, it wasn't there. Ended up having to run home (found it in the drive way) and came right back. The host and server were very patient and polite about it. Food was awesome, we got multiple apps to share. Servers name was Kath, she was great! From the hosts to the food and service, we'll definately be back!

name: Customer_1608
comments:
After a failed attempt at a much busier and more popular restaurant nearby, we found the Tavern to be the perfect spot to start off our Nashville trip. 

There was no wait on a Friday night around 11pm. We were starving and impatient for something satisfyingly unhealthy and delicious. 

The two of us definitely over-ordered. After we received our beer and cider orders, we placed our gargantuan order for two: the Tuscan style Tavern fries, which was HUGE, the chips and guacamole and the fish and chips. Obviously, the healthy factor was not an issue.

Everything was tasty, just in huge portions. The Tavern fries were easy to munch on, although there was way too much. We probably could have ordered this alone. But I guess if an order of fries cost $6.50, I wouldn't expect just a small tin.

The guacamole was interesting. The goat cheese gave it a different flavor - but I liked it. There were so many chips but at the same time, there was a lot of guac. 

The fish and chips wasn't bad, not mind blowing either. It was so greasy I could only take several bites before calling it quits. I love when my fried fish is super tender and juicy, but this was a bit much. When each bite you take the grease seems to flow out into your mouth, it may be too much.

Overall, a delicious late night meal for ones who were unable to wait 45 minutes for a table at 9:30pm elsewhere... I'd definitely come back here for a couple beers and an order of their Tavern fries.

name: Customer_3480
comments: I was visiting my kids in Nashville on Saturday and we decided to go to the Tavern for brunch. This was the first time for all of us. We sat outside. It was a beautiful sunny day. The atmosphere was wonderful. The service was fantastic. The food was great! We look forward to coming back when we visit our kids again.

name: Customer_4423
comments: Tavern is a local food hangout with nightly live country music. Our country music singer was from Australia but she has Nashville voice. It shows the love of county music is universal.

name: Customer_4330
comments: Food and service was great! Try the BLT and the egg rolls! The drinks are so good as well.

name: Customer_4062
comments: Best brunch in Nashville. Amazing lunch. During brunch drinks are 2 for 1 and they are delicious. The wicked Bloody Mary and blood orange mimosa are my favorites. Red velvet waffle, white trash hash, cheddar biscuits and gravy, eggs benedicts, and Singapore stir fry are all so excellent it makes it hard to decide what to order each time. The burger and fries are amazing for lunch, as are the Philly cheesesteak egg rolls, and fried chicken skins with honey Sriracha sauce as apps. They also have a midtown quickie on the menu that changes every day. Tavern never gets old and never disappoints.

name: Customer_7298
comments:
Tavern (used to be Lime, which has moved) is great!  It is an M Street restaurant, along with Whiskey Kitchen, Virago and (their "crown jewel") Kanye Prime steakhouse.    

First of all, I love the location.  It's right on Broadway - near Patterson, 12th South, Red Door, etc.  

Second, it's trendy enough without feeling overly pretentious.  I dig the layout - there are two outdoor seating area options (which we didn't do because of the cicadas), and the inside is very well done.  There are TV's all over the place, the bar is stocked, and there is a decent amount of tables.         

Third, the service (for us) was very good.  Granted, we went on the Sunday before Memorial Day - so it was relatively empty, but still.  Our server was attentive, but not overly so where you feel like you couldn't enjoy your meal in peace.    

And forth, the cuisine.  I would describe their menu as all over the place goodness.  :)  It's so varied, but it all sounds great.  
APPS:  
We've heard many good things about the guacamole, so we tried it:  The Bazooka Guacamole - with avocado, goat cheese and pistachio.  I liked the creaminess of the guac, but wanted more spice / flavor.  Luckily for me there were three different hot sauces available labeled as X, XX, and XXX.  Yum.  (PS - there is also homemade BBQ sauce.)  A lot of other app options sounded great, too.  We'll probably try something else next time like the Lobster Hushpuppies or the Eggrolls. 
ENTREES:
I was so overwhelmed with the variety on their menu, that last minute I went for the Tavern Burger with White Cheddar - and I switched the Belgian Fries for the Tennessee Fries (sweet potato with jalapeno ketchup.)  .  The fries were great, and the burger was one of the best burgers in N'ville.  My husband was deciding between three completely difference options as well:  The Basket of Fish, the Nachos with Pork or one of the Taco options.   Like me, he ordered last minute and got the Pork Nachos.  I doubt he would have if he had thought about it for even a second since we already ordered the guac which came with a bag of chips...but c'est la vie.  They were delish.  
LIBATIONS:
Some of their drinks were pricey, some were reasonable.  Just be cautious when you order because your bill could add up quickly if you get the specialty cocktails... I got a $7 glass of wine, and my husband got a beer for $4.75.  Comparing Tavern to similar places, it seemed okay to me.  :)  
LATE NIGHT: 
From 11PM to 1AM they have a late night menu.
WEDNESDAYS:
2-4-1's.

I'll be returning to Tavern for sure.

name: Customer_7679
comments: This place was very modern and chic! Very cool look and feel of the restaurant. We only came in for a quick bite to eat and some drinks to start off the night. For a Saturday night around 7pm, it was pretty busy. Definitely a loud place because of all the people, but they played good music. Ambiance is casual but not too dressed down. I wouldn't wear a hoodie and sweats, but dressy casual. Service was good. We had the buffalo cauliflower and it was delicious! Will def be back when I'm in Nashville again!

name: Customer_5323
comments: Food was fantastic, service was so bad I wouldn't come back. They are severely understaffed, we finished eating 45 mins before we got the check. The hour and a half wait is completely unnecessary!

name: Customer_3314
comments: I have heard about this place from a few different people, finally made it in and it lived up to the hype. Ate here with a friend, realized she had lost her wallet as soon as we sat down. From the hosts to the food and servise, we'll definitely be back!

name: Customer_1286
comments: One of the best burgers in Nashville, definitely the best 'upscale' burger I've found, and some really nice well-mixed drinks to go with them.  The crowd gets a bit overrun with frat-types on Friday and Saturday nights, but it's a great place for a lunch or weeknight drink/dinner.

name: Customer_9118
comments: My 8 friends and I came here during our visit to Nashville because of good reviews we heard from friends who visited - they did not disappoint.  Tavern was a great brunch spot and they were able to accommodate our large group fairly easily.  The service was awesome, relaxed and friendly staff all around.  The food was phenomenal - We split almost every app on the menu, all very good.  I had the special taco scramble and it was one of the best egg dishes I've had in a while.  The "white trash hash" that came with it was delicious and a twist on the classic hashbrowns.  All in all I would come back here and would recommend to anyone visiting.

name: Customer_4289
comments: The atmosphere is very clean, modern, and slightly upscale. They offer a brunch and a large selection of drinks. They are very packed for brunch though. Their brunch runs pretty late. I got there around 2pm and they said brunch was ending soon. Their brunch menu items cost around $10 each. Their normal dinner menu gets a little pricier, but you don't have to spend a lot of money here.

name: Customer_2867
comments: Nice bar with good music and lively atmosphere. The beef Tacos were so Yummy, and so were the fries. Went if there happy

name: Customer_4778
comments: Excellent service, has air conditioning which is great in the south, my favorite was the chicken chicharrón "chicharrón" good location in the block is the best one!

name: Customer_3944
comments:
Not my kind of place but I think if it was it would be fantastic! 
Loud music, sports on big TV s, huge bar, inside or outside seating. Friendly attentive staff, food artsy. Served lightning fast. Very clean and beautifully decorated. Enjoyed my Burger very much. Micheal loved his Junk Salad... Great place for those who like what I described.

name: Customer_3299
comments: Horrible servic! Restaurant was recommended so we decided to check it out. First time in Nashville so we wanted to see what the downtown expereince was, and we were greatly disappointed; mostly due to our unfortunate experince at tavern. We waited for 20 minutes without any acknowledgement from our waiter. When we finally saw him in our area he greeted a table who had just arrived, skipped our table and went on to another. We ended up leaving the establishment. I repeat...horrible service!!!! I guess I can take that back, it wasn't horrible, there WAS NO SERVICE!

name: Customer_5965
comments: This place was AMAZING! I found it on yelp and saw the reviews, knew my dad and I had to check it out. We immediately got a killer spot at the bar and was greeted by the nicest bartender we've come across in Nashville this far. I had some white wine and my dad had beer on tap. We split (demolished) the nachos- I highly recommend adding chicken!! I could have ordered everything else on the menu but the nachos were super filling. Very hip place, highly recommend

name: Customer_3044
comments: Amazing food, great srvice! Melissa was so accommodating! We got seated right away too.

name: Customer_6832
comments:
Overpriced.  

That's the best way to describe it.  Everything was FINE.  Just fine.  But when our bar tab is $60 for a few drinks, and I felt like I needed to go over the menu about 8 times to find something exciting to try (I landed on the burger), I felt let down.  

All of the reviews of this place made me want to come visit.  I think these must all be Vandy kids or tourists who don't know where the better quality places are with better prices.  

I just felt, well... so meh about the whole thing.  

Again, everything was fine, decent, even.  But by the time to pay the bill came, my husband and I thought of at LEAST 5 or 6 different places we could have gone for BETTER drinks with CHEAPER prices and a much better menu.  

Obviously, this is probably for the hip crowd.  So, if you're hip, go for it.  If you were once hip, and you know better... be prepared to be underwhelmed.

name: Customer_3052
comments:
We went here for dinner last night with our Yelp Elite spring break friends and the food was great. I ordered a burger medium well with white cheddar, and I substituted for the Tennessee sweet potato fries with the garlic aioli which were fantastic.

My friend got a Jalapeño-infused strawberry margarita, which was yummy, as well as the chimichangas, which were also very good. The chimichangas were soft, rather than deep fried, which was interesting.

I will say that they don't do any happy hour specials here, which was disappointing. I got an angry orchard cider in a can, which I had never seen before because usually I get bottles, and it was $5.50 which is a little expensive.

Food was great though like I said, and food prices were reasonable.

name: Customer_3645
comments:
Excellent food and service!!! They even put my Mets game on the big screen. 

Order the chicken skins for an appetizer - freaking yummy!!! 

Burgers were great - Service is 5 star!!!

Friend had the Lobster sliders - very good!!!

name: Customer_8272
comments: My husband and I came to have some food before the Georgia football game. I will say that they have a drink special for brunch where it is 2 for 1 (around $9 or $12 total). I ordered the eggs benedict and honestly couldn't see the food because of how much hollandaise was on there. My husband ordered the Asian breakfast and was not impressed. Very packed and not really able to enjoy the game so we went elsewhere. Overall not bad- service at the bar was great but a little overrated in my opinion.

name: Customer_8332
comments: I usually love this place, but stopped in tonight to place a take out order, and the hostess shewed me off to the absolutely PACKED bar, to try to hail a bartender, on my own, to place an order. This is seriously how you are doing business? We walked out... Ridiculous...

name: Customer_9810
comments:
could get to 4 or 5 stars; maybe it was just a slightly off night.  It might be better next time but not sure if i will make it back; lots of other restaurants to try instead.  just disappointed by the execution for a place that has uses the tagline as a pub for chefs on their website.  

we got a drink at the bar; the bartender was very responsive and helpful, drinks were excellent.

ordered food; waitress didn't mention they were out of items until I tried to order them.  Asked for fried chicken skins, they were out.  tried to upsell me to their cauliflower app as a result.  We placed our order, waitress then has to come back and tell me that they are also out of the catfish i just ordered.  i realize places run out of food at times but they went 0 for 2 with my choices and they didn't tell me upfront.  annoying the waitress didn't say this upfront.  

also, this may have been due to being out of items, the waitress never came back and asked how our food was.  the short rib tacos i ordered were cold, my sister's tacos were also cold.  Even more disappointing is that the tacos i ended up buying and not really enjoying were more money than the catfish.  
Everyone else's food was appropriate temp but yeah the waitress never asked so I only get to tell you here.  everyone else's food was good; nothing spectacular but all around solid.  

also I saw other reviews mention drink specials on Sundays?  I went on a Sunday no mention of drink specials was made.  

The bar service, and overall atmosphere keep me from ranking it lower, like I said maybe I just caught them and the waitress on an off night.

name: Customer_9126
comments: Great food! The menu is full of interesting, and unique items. I tried the smoked salmon eggs benedict, and it was phenomenal. The interior is very well decorated, and the servers were helpful and prompt. Though it was a little on the expensive side, it was well worth the cost for such a great experince.

name: Customer_4087
comments:
I've been to Tavern a variety of times since it opened and have had a lot of fun trying their dishes.  Really delish food and great atmosphere.

For brunch, my favorite would be the Singapore Stir Fry - yum!!  I also love their brunch drinks - my two favs are the Bellini Sparkle and the Blood Orange Mimosa

Lunch/Dinner: The Bucket of Mussels, Mahi Sandwich, and the Tuscan Kale & Parmesan Salad

Dessert: hands down the S'mores - had some out of town guests in recently and took them just for s'mores and drinks late night, and it was such a blast - I felt like a kid roasting marshmellows all over again but in a much classier manner :)

Late night weekends is also really fun at Tavern with the music, but definitely hard to hold a conversation with anyone if you are eating during that time.

name: Customer_6915
comments: We walked in without a reservation on Father's Day Sunday at 11 in the morning. We had a flight to catch at 3, so didn't have time to wait and luckily were able to sit at the bar right away. Looking at the menu didn't see anything that looked intriguing or exciting. I was upset that we may have been stuck with some boring brunch on our last day in Nashville. Oh my, was I wrong or what? I ordered the big daddy omelette and my husband got the Huevos Rancheros. I got a big omelet and I couldn't finish it. My omelette was flavorful and the white trash hash was out of this world. I got a fried egg on top of my omelette. What else can you ask for? They also had buy one get one mimosa. Not sure if that was a Father's Day promotion or they do that every Sunday. We also ordered the red velvet waffle for dessert which sounded and looked creative but wasn't that impressive. Overall a great experience and definitely recomand it!!!

name: Customer_3964
comments: Delicious food in a fun setting.  Great helpful and friendly service.  Two levels of seating near the bar.  We had awesome buffalo cauliflower, egg rolls with philly cheese steak and amazing kale salad.  highly recommend the Tavern.

name: Customer_1815
comments: One of my favorite spots in town. Burger is amazing, good vibe, nice staff. Go-to gastro pub for sure.

name: Customer_2045
comments: This may seem like a standard American burger joint, but they actually have taken pains to create a thoughtful and surprising menu. There are options ranging from middle eastern to Mediterranean to Indian to new American and I had a sampling of them all. Everything had a distinct flavor profile, regardless of whether I liked it, and the burger was one of the best I've had in Nashville. Oh, and for dessert you can roast your own marshmallows at the table. Service wasn't the greatest, but not terrible as other reviews have noted and overall this is a spot I'd recomend.

name: Customer_1376
comments: Sunday Funday !!!! Best place to go on Sunday!!!! Excellent breakfast/brunch! If you got to watch your football/ ice hockey playoffs- any sports! This is the place!

name: Customer_1256
comments: Tavern is probably one of the better brunch places in Nashville IF (and only if) you go with friends. This is not the place to go for a brunch date or to go with any person that you actually want to have a conversation with. Both times that my wife and I have gone (once by ourselves, and the other time with some friends) the music has been extremely loud - like to the point where we have been yelling just to hear each other. Not kidding. Look, I like my music loud... and their playlist was actually on point (late 90's/early 2000's hits)... but going out to eat is a social experiance. Part of sharing a meal is enjoying the company of the people you're with. Don't blast music in my face and force me to lean in just to hear what the person next to me is saying. C'mon. On to the food! It's GREAT. I highly recomend the Benedict Uno - a short rib benedict topped with tabasco-infused hollandaise. Wow. So much amazing flavor in every bite. I savored it right down to the end. I also recommend the maple fondue if you're with a group. It's a fun dish to share and has assorted fruits and some french toast and sausage... all to be dipped in a delicious warm maple syrup mixture. Can't go wrong. Also, don't sleep on the 2-for-1 libations. The blood orange mimosa and the red sangria are my favorites (although the last time I went, I just doubled up on the sangria... easily my favorite). This place deserves respect for the quality of food they put out and their decent pricing (average about $12-$15 per entree). The only things that keep this from being a 4-star review are the noise level, the lack of parking (bring cash because you will need to use the valet), and the fact that you will undoubtedly have a wait. When we went with our friends, we got their 10 minutes after they opened and were told there was a 20-30 minute wait. We ended up actually waiting almost an hour. Not really a complaint, since you have to factor in a wait at popular places... but still. Just a warning - you will have a wait. Give this place a shot if you like good food for brunch, just go in knowing that there are some pitfalls with this place.
